places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Aditimpa
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The is home to the Xan’yunta, a great hole to the elemental plane of water that exists 1 km above the city. Rain falls on the city in a torrent in its center and causes continuous rain throughout its other areas.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Annwn
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The Rich Bar flowing with golden light in an Aetherion Corporation model. Upper middle class. Walkways made out of refined hardlight constructs and water flowing downwards into the ocean below. A floating district in technicality on one of the few oceans.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Arawen
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The wealthy side of the bay, filled with underwater guards and above air defense systems. Popular in movies it also became filled with homeless people who entered the city to get their big break.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Bran
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: A very thin sheet of water covers this land (<10 feet) resulting in structures that have their bases covered in water, when valuable materials such as credit deposits were found under the water drainage operations started taking place. Buildings were made to block out water and to continually pump the water out in order to make mines feasible. The water in a show of wealth is often expelled out through the roof and onto other buildings in a practice that prior to the scarring had yet to be outlawed.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Closwick
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The swamps contains plenty of crude oil to dig up for plastics people still live here due to the high profits from manufacturing. The entire region smells of Mazut.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Clouds
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The riches of the rich, located floating on suspended islands it is accessible by elevators allowing one to live among the clouds. The islands managed to bribe their way into obtaining artillery cannons and fire them down upon others in order to satiate their marks. A magical anomaly in the atmosphere allows the clouds to be solid. Certain groups here have found out how to build on the clouds and stop them from raining. This brought great ecological devastation to the poorer lower classes as the places underneath the solid clouds shriveled from lack of rain. Creating a beautiful high society and a poor dried out underclass.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Courfield
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: A megabarge that floats trolling the waters below, this area has a rough current similar to the planets Nsuoba and Branthai. The civilization is able to survive off of a crashed colony ship that was able to be repurposed for this exact task. The train connects by way of hanging lines and a cable car.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Dili
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The canals, the water is not condensed enough to be properly used for anything yet it’s too wet to do anything mud covers the ground and those who can afford to live elsewhere.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Ere
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The plains of soft grass that give way to low trees. One of the prime luxurious places to live and home to safari games where the wealthy import dangerous animals to hunt.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Fortshim
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The deep sea megacity built like layers of barnacle on strong pillars that were placed there the city looks a bit like buoys in the water. The nearby currents give it an ‘artificial’ tide meaning the buildings close to the waterline have a underwater and above water mode.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Fusagay
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: Built on the other side of the square, it used the natural pillars to create a crosshatch community where people live in the vertices and edges of interconnected cubes.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Gestukos
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: Snow laden peak area that fills with rushing water due to the hot wind tunnel, resulting in a slurry zone.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Grandmido
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: Living in fear near clouds wondering if they’re next, the golden city has been left abandoned by most, some gangs made with way into the city and have taken over critical points living as god kings in its abandon

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Innasuo
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: Mountain Forest hills that contain small settlements in the flat lifts but the terrain on the outskirts of the flat lift is too rugged to terraform for anything other than small cities. Still the line continues

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Kunru
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The sheer face the train itself is built on a direct ascent near the border if you were walking it would appear as a square along the line the inside of which is hallowed in order to allow the train to pass through but the stone is thick enough that even Talphi have trouble piercing it making it unsuited for building. All other people live somewhere on the square.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Lokakaru
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The large city nearby is home to a single rapid river that goes down its main district. The buildings here were bombed out by the clouds district in order to satiate their marks. A second round of bombings proceeded to fall down on the people here resulting in nuclear fallout.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Moriva
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: A hilly region with odd gravity that is always perpendicular to the natural curve of the landscape. Resulting the in the sunburst buildings being a popular motif in architecture, wherein buildings are built along a round curve causing them to stick out like a sunburst. This appears to be the result of pinpoint gravity wells.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Namtsola
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: Built on a small island chain all the nature of the darkside has been fully industrialized for fishing the cold water fish. The sun side has in contrast been renovated to high class resorts at the cost of the locals living there.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Namutep
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The bay stripped of all its natural glory all of it has been pushed to the more luxurious districts of Annwn and Arawen. All that remains are old fishing villages and abandoned shops tinted in neon.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Ninbata
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The rocky plains rolling with hard grass surrounding it, a pleasant town of autumn. The winds that kick up the area cause them to clank against the rocks. Generally the style there is to wear wind protections

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Prithvek
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: Attempted to push away the people of Grandmido resulting in a fierce war in which mercenaries used less than lethal rounds to secure hostage and bring them back to the side paying them. The outer districts are now slums and many of the Grandmido people live in the shadows of this district.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Pwyllan
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: A religious district founded by the settlers with a deep archive in it kept under lock and key by the monks that maintain it. Was a concentrated point of attack for the Solara Imperium during the war and many of the temples since have been retrofitted to include defenses.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Ratriko
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: A cold stream flows through the district making it the snow district. A flatland covered in snow that constantly falls, it appears as a white streak jutting from the dark side. Most transportation facilities are built underground and the towers first floors are in these hard rock tunnels then rise into the snow plains above.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Rhiannor
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: Home of two great roots to Ithex one that extends down into the dark side and one into the light side, they wind through the planet and are only enterable here though from them you can peer out to various parts of the world as it was. Electricity for the region is harvest from these roots and light that uses it tends to project faint dancing figures occasionally.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Rudrani
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The underwater section of the bay, where life still is trying to find a way, the entire city is not built to accommodate surface dwellers and has a general hostility to them after the ruining of this bays ecosystem.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Sainmat
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: Mountain Forest proper the major architecture here is known as hobbit holes due to cities being built in the hallowed mountain. An extremely populated region due to the artificial lights recreating the light streams of Tharkun-Zar.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Tialon
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The beginning of the Hjean Sea, the cubes vertices slowly descend into the water becoming an underwater city of a similar structure built into the coral reef. Occupied primarily by underwater people.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Tianmo
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The Chasm, this stretch of land gives way to a great canyon where buildings were places along its walls and a cable car passes in zigzagging patterns between them as the primary transport. A crack in the ground gives way to an updraft making it a popular place for flying ancestries.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Urveka
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: Deep forest zone the city is hard divided from the dense forest surrounding it with what are known as ecological zones in the middle. The tree canopies tend to make a sheer front like a flattop haircut along the curvature of the world.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Ushastan
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: One of the major administrations hubs. Houses one of the two space elevators and is widely considered a greeting area. The elevator here is unoperational leaving the lower city in the twilight once again. Built is the evergreen forests of the planet.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Valaris
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The major cities are built around 3 major lakes that cover the serve as freshwater seas. The entire perimeter has been built around and most of the wildlife have been removed due to overfishing. It now serves as a water basin and nothing else.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Valhar
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: Snow laden peak filled with evergreens that crawl up the mountains, average temperature is lower due to a cold wind tunnel in this region created by the Ningaroa Valley. The majority of the population lives underground though large scale elevators may ascend you to the surface.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Vritraja
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The water condenses and becomes full rivers here which can be used for electricity generation, turbines spin both water wheels and wind mills, the city glows with excitement.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Yusan
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: The riverlands built similar to Venice, personal boats are popular here and the canals were a sight to behold before they became stenched with blood. The once extremely luxurious zone is now a biohazard, the train doesn’t stop here anymore.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.title: Zhonmor
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/alph.description: Obsidian pillars caused by the active tectonic plates here mixing with the slurry of Gestukos results. The black district is distinct in its odd architecture; fireweed provides a purple contrast to black structures throughout the area and during turmoil ashfall coats the area white until rain comes.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Alchering
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: Marked by the cloud sublimation zone, this area is named for the Lashunta word for forest. The pink colored forest is met with traditional lashunta architecture.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Arsan
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: The buildings are kept smaller here and sprawled along the landscape due to military order with the exception of the Quomouk building which is allowed to stand higher than all others as a show of loyalty.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Ayresa
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: The local area rises too high to flood and thus it forms the start of the standard Ayresa Desert proper, the base of which is mostly still solid with a thin layer of dust that comes off from Wangata. Since the sand comes from one direction all buildings have shields built into them to stand the onslaught.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Barkhori
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: A glass land, the entirety of the land had been glassed by an unknown event, the layers on the glass also indicate that it had happened several times. The glass does though refract light from the sun occasionally causing small lived bursts of colored lights that erupt from the ground. People with epilepsy would be advised not to visit.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Beika
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: A land of gentle breeze, non-native species of trees are brought in and kept under conditions that allow the leaves to gently fall continuously through the year in fall colors.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Billanui
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: The sands that support the most life due to underground water being present here. Megafauna is present and thumpers are placed every 10 miles in order to trick the local wildlife into staying away from the buildings. Vehicles likewise have a thumping hydraulic that causes the wheels to ‘punch’ the ground in order to scare off wildlife. The Fuige Highway allows none equipped cars to travel across the desert safely. Travelers are advised to fuel up before traveling.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Dajar
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: One of the great mountain ranges start, the Indeval Mountains start in Dajar. Though small compared to later parts it is notable due to have two deep Cirques in the side which are used as natural amphitheaters as part of the culture many streets have silence spells placed on them with the sole exception of the music in the amphitheaters playing.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Dreamat
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: The mesa zone with large clouds that block their peaks, red mesas are contrasted by the purple sunset and white clouds. All people here live in the valley due to micro earthquakes that happen only at the top of the mesas. Even when buildings were brought in to withstand said earthquakes, the ground simply disappeared, causing the builders to plummet to their deaths. The remaining mesas have not been built on since.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Ginjar
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: The dark zone due to two sheer cliff faces blocking both the sunside and darkside going through the valley is still air and bridges made out of haste in order to cross into buildings. The entire area was unplanned but underwent rapid renovation due to Corpse Fleet funding as light fearing undead finally had a place they could rest on Senaria.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Grenthol
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: A casino district built following the disappearance of the serenade, it was at that point the most popular casino in the galaxy and large enough to accommodate. For a time, it seemed to become the future of gambling entertainment.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Haunet
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: The glass gives way to dry playas where formians live. Bringing their odd architecture that seems similar to metal ant mounds with them that cover the landscape.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Hikuran
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: A section of the planet colonized originally by Sarcesians it was later expanded to house many of the large ancestries. To the average person it appears as if they had entered a world of giants.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Huga
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: The start of the Ayresa Desert, though it appears as an arid mountain range with mild greenery growing down the sides of the city outskirts. It occasionally has a monsoon season which awakens dormant animals in the sand to arise and collect as much water as they can.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Ifont
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: An area defined by the harsh winds that cover the region. Towers are made double reinforced no more than 3 stories tall and with the ability to descend into the earth should a tornado pass through. The train here is entirely underground.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Katase
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: The flood basin at the base of the mountain which runs dry for the majority of the time. Buildings are made with their bases as flotation devices due to the infrequency of rain. They then float freely when the flood comes and wherever they settle automated robots build connective roads between them. This occurs roughly every 10 years.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Lonriv
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: Marked by a magic anomaly that results in there being no functional gravity except for at the start of the stratosphere and 10 meters below sea level. The buildings are shaped like bubbles with strings tying them together like balloons. Each building is made to alternate between a positive and negative magnetic charge in sync in order to stop them from crashing into each other or drifting too far outside of the anomaly.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Mangaweti
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: Gravity is present but at only half the expected value for any given point. The result is a jagged landscape of odd architecture that sprawls out upward as much as it does horizontal. Popular among the elderly community.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Murraw
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: The prairie rangers have to go out into the sunside in order to cull the grass with chemicals or else it can catch fire and spread to the city proper.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Potalex
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: A crater marked zone where the atmosphere is unusually (or more accurately: usually) thin. People live in the small craters that were dug up in order to gain access to the skymetals with each community being named after the asteroid that impacted there. Air is thin here resulting in shortness of breath for outsiders and air tanks are a popular commodity in the population.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Ratanawe
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: A rigid region where the mountains split into three distinct spines, building are follow along these curves and serve to functionally create three separate cities that maintain minimal contact. During the scarring the great highway between them was destroyed, meaning central is the only one of the cities able to be reached by the train station.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Rua
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: The rough waters that run cold from the dark side to the sun side in a constant stream of precipitation there are a series of hard rock islands along these streams that form eight tiger like stripes that people will live on manufacturing is typically found on dark side and goods are sent along the river to the sunside. Collectors gather at the end to gather goods that ended up where the rivers dry.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Sag
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: Named after the Kasatha word for peak, it’s unsurprisingly the peak of the Indeval Mountains. The top of which pierces stratosphere of senaria, resulting in towers backlit by a void sky

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Samyeho
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: A home for the bantrids, the entire city is set up like a motorway. The result was a tourist destination where nonbantrids road in go-karts alongside the majestic wheels of the bantrids.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Squeli
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: The natural light district, marked by odd prisms that reflect/refract light from the light side of the planet through the twilight causing light to dance around the area. Several points including the stadium are where the light coalesces.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Taranakay
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: A Mecinaic city that is built for these tiny creatures with numerous walkways and small entrance ways so they don’t have to go out of the way to get to places that the larger populations would have to. These accommodations served before the scarring to ease the time worrying population of mollusks.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Tashilka
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: Home to a Data-Temple like construct that was destroyed by the Solara Imperium following their takeover during the war. The resulting landslide destroyed numerous infrastructure critical to the regions city center. Restoration efforts were underway before the scarring happened.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Tashipen
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: A karst area where the gaps have all been filled in with artificial landscapes including the deep caverns which house wealthy panic rooms.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Tasol
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: An industrial hub mostly in charge of manufacturing android parts, though it recently fell into poverty following the anti android slavery laws that passed. Many of the plants have since focused elsewhere, though rumors have it that some still make blackmarket androids.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Tenzar
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: A location of great earthquakes, the rocky terrain often fractures leaving a fine layer of dust on the ground. The entire city is built on a stilt like system to absorb the impact and translate it into energy causing building to seem like tall bugs in a shaking terrarium.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Tingrim
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: Gravitational anomaly zone roughly 1.3 times gravity as expected on their planet.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Tju
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: The grand military spaceport able to launch thousands of spacecraft on a dime. Those in charge haven’t been given order to start bombing nearby communities and thus have stayed put. Though some civilian housing does exist in the region the primary feature of the plain are the 7 military bases. One large one in the center shaped like a hexagon and the other 6 on its vertices.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Tongariz
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: The hexagonal shore where beehive like hexagonal rocks dot the landscape and like someone playing a board game dart out into the violent ocean below. The slate rock is wet and smooth never losing its shape, the subdistricts are all determined by the individual hexagons, the longest of which is over 100 miles vertice to vertice the smallest recognized one is 10 feet.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Tse
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: A magocratic district that mixes old world power with new world tech, a dazzling display for those visiting and a hellscape for the nonmagical people who live here. Constantly being fined for arbitrarily requiring magic to access basic functions of city living

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Wangata
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: The deep desert hot sand continues to blow from sun side to the dark side, tracking devices showed this to be continuous and end in a spot 10 miles from the ‘livable limit’ but one device on the fritz was shown to teleport 10 miles from the ‘livable limit’ on the sunside before being blown along the life belt. Most buildings are built with shutters that allow them to adjust which parts are considered ‘ground level’ depending on how the sands land.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Whakarun
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: A cliff ascent out of the sea that is split in half leaving the center between sunside and darkside by the sea. Boats enter the center and are then lifted using a crane aqueduct system before being introduced to the Above cliffs rivers to continue their journey. Though the surface only shows a thing crack in the land, there is a vast spherical cavern of dark water underneath the surface. The people have business dredging for things below in order to avoid the wrath of the leviathans below.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.title: Yusol
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/delt.description: The calm sea where there exists towers that descend into the black depths below and rise to the top above sea level. People entering from Whakarun can enter through highways that go across the sea or dive into it.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Circuit Lab
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: Serath Ka

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Dying Light
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: Klutch

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Ogar Butchery and Produce
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: run by Onmagakar

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Petaslice Repairs
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: Rook-9 works here

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Save Point Convenience
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: maintained by a bored teenager named Al and his Aetherion Corporation mandated turrets

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Suimin
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description:
Circuit Lab
Dying Light
Ogar Butchery and Produce
Petaslice Repairs
Save Point Convenience
Second Earth Ramen

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Denpakant
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description:
The end of the Salzari Mountains and a once prosperous port that was left to die after both its space elevator and space port were bombed during the war and never recovered. The result was a district in slow but steady decline. The multiple elevations of ground level make it hard to tell where one is in the city if they’re not used to it.The temperature is always a flux between fall and spring depending on the time of year. It's a relatively poor district destroyed in the last large galactic war and never fully repaired due to damages to its space port which were deemed too costly. Though there is a some luxury buildings that remain, you live in the megabuilding Suimin all on the same floor of the same wing in the same hall on the 37th floor.
Suimin
Quanverium University
Tihaeash
Sexico-6

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Alacaho
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: Shroomcity, soil contents reveal that there was once a large creature which died there and deep fungal roots eat at the remains of said creature. The area smells unpleasant to human noses but certain ancestries quite like it. It is one of the few locations that allow whole body burials.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Araratk
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: Marked by the great waterfall, water slowly regains its gravity here resulting in a waterfall that is 1 km in depth and 100 km in height. Unknown forces keep the water from properly misting causing a roar that can be hear from the city center.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Are
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: Built around a central lake the majority of the residents live on the edge of it. The center known as the eye stares up and during times of power outages reflects the universe onto itself. The pupil is an island with a single tower built there owned by an individual of wide speculation though only government officials know their actual identity.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Brepipen
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: The Water basin where rainfall collects and stagnates, the water in upper levels is fresh but turns to salt in lower sections of the region. Home to many aquatic ancestries.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Byblosma
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: A district primarily populated by Madrosarai, the area presents as giant pyramids that form out of each other, the older ones are made of earth materials while the newer ones are made out of alloys and glass.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Carthagena
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: A building primarily made out of ceramic quartz many of the buildings are sturdy but partially see through. In order to blind outside viewers lights at the top of the wall shine down the quartz veins creating roots of light that streak through the district.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Cerveter
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: A standard residential district made by the Tivarin admin before its collapse it contains standard Tivarin architecture at its base but with differing styles the further up you go changing into pseudo districts with a common ancestry.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Choimar
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: Part of the forest district, home of the Oalintha plant which can be used for medical supplies. It’s a parasitic vine that grows along the trees and replaces the sap of the tree with its own. Eventually when the tree or an infected branch dies the sporeseeds held within a hollow created in the tree are released and allowed to float to nearby trees affecting them. Extremely toxic to most life people in the region are required to wear rebreathers resulting in a mask based subculture, this also means a large Kasatha population calls this place their new home.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Cortonwe
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: A district famous for housing some of the most cutting edge augmentations of the era. The entire district is built on precious mithral mines which allow engineers in the region to build stronger, lighter, more practical, and fancier cyberware at an enhanced rate.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Erebunir
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: The great tide of the Salzari Mountains it is an anomalous zone where water seems unaffected by gravity resulting in the rushing water from Othello stopping and floating like a sheet blanket over the land until crashing down at the border of Araratk.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Etruska
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: A district of silver (what was once considered a precious metal in years past) founded due to the founders fear of the lycanthropic curse which she herself was affected. She clad the entirety of the district in her bane so that when the curse took over she may not harm those she lived amongst. The people continue this practice centuries after her passing in her memory.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Fiesolep
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: The colored fire district also known as Bright Hell, odd particles in the atmosphere cause open flames to burn in different shifting colors which become incorporated into the design. Many of the buildings feature open fire and/or act as a torch with the flame on top. It's popular amongst the fire resistant ancestries for this reason. Home to devils as well.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Gadirem
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: A district with heavy ground magma flow, special alloys are made in order to resist the heat and redirect the flow to the sunside where it continues its march directly towards the central sun pillar.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Hattusa
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: A dark zone underneath the red cloud of Zuniaur. It absorbs the heat from the clouds surrounding it resulting in a feeling of being in an internal rainforest night surrounded by lightning due to iron friction. Almost all buildings are made out of a plastic polymer in order to insulate from the outside, small electricity collection rods line these buildings and convert it into usable power.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Leptir
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: An old cogs district that was settled long ago by a cult of a human god struck from the annals of history. The district bears the marks of the distinct cogs that churned away for a purpose lost to time.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Limaurrio
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: Many old precursor buildings are still fully erect here, the local architecture has thus incorporated into the stylings including the seven inner circles on many of its townships.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Malakatu
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: A standard residential area outside of the anomaly and the great industry. It is a reprieve between extremes.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Nerikala
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: Shining desert jewel where the people actually live due to the mithral deposits that run under the city and the oasis nearby. As a show of wealth the city has a blue tint compared to the yellow red desert that surrounds it.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Othello
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: Part of the Salzari Mountains located where the great tide ends; it represents the peak. The top of which is the tallest mountain of senaria which technically falls outside of the legal zone for being on planet. A military base used to guard the peak from immigrants until a law passed allowing free travel from those on Senaria into near space.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Penora
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: The modular city, the entire district is made of parts that can be easily disassembled and moved as part of an Aetherion Corporation initiative for its soldiers. The defenses were disabled and the parts claimed by the populace. It is common practice to disassemble your house when you leave and sell the parts to your neighbors or those moving in.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Perugat
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: A location founded by Ords but also has a substantial blind vlaka population as well. The entire city is made with sound in mind, and an intricate set of sounds allows those in it to move just as well as people with sight. In order to facilitate this it has one of the most sophisticated radio infrastructures in the known galaxy.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Samuhael
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: The beginning of the forests but most have been cut down in order to gain lumber. Fields and field of research facilities are trying to find ways to accelerate growth for the local ecosystem. The majority of the place is where natural* growth for agriculture on the planet takes place.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Sidonla
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: A location founded by the Knights Reclaimant, the majority of the district is decorated by sculptures of heroes and warriors of the land. Even as the empires gave way and the planet switched hands the murals here were never destroyed only added on top of in order to preserve history. It is unknown why the Solara Imperium spared it.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Tarhunt
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: Deep forest most of the terrain has to be integrated or account for the growing of trees the largest of which can be 100 meters in radius. A popular form of elite housing involves moving into the trunks of said trees which are blessed with a spell of continual growth. Automations then continue to dig out rooms and furniture that change weekly as time goes on. The large trees also contribute to a narrower band in the region of habitability but a larger band of ‘comfortable’ temperatures (by human standards).

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Tarquinui
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: Crystalline growths mark this district with a rare material that grows naturally over time at an accelerated rate. Able to be refined into fine quartz, the Tarquinui Crystal by which this district gets its name grows at a constant rate based on exposed surface area so long as there is at least 100 kg of starting material. The people have built an industry of mining and refining the crystals that grow much like a logger would with trees. Though with the Red Tally these crystals threaten to swallow the city as a whole.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Teisheba
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: Salt flats that remain devoid of natural life, most buildings in order to avoid it are built on stilts above it while systems mine the salt below, underground resistance groups can be found in the abandoned depleted mines since stripping the faculties is usually more costly that building new ones. The local salt storms sometimes get past hardlight protections and will coat emitters in crystals.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Ur
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: A district that was established by the Solara Imperium, it is an area marked by numerous shrines that allow the natural spirits of the world to interact with the people of the district. In it hauntings are considered a blessing and it is the home of many spiritualists.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Uticavi
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: An anomaly zone where the entire district appears greyscale. Appears as a blotch on the planet from space.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Vanatir
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: An undulating lake populated by a vast amount Kalo and Copaxi, the towers rise like colorful coral upwards into the sky. The weather is calm but the inland sea swells often and seems to obey a 70 hour tide despite the lack of tidal forces.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Veienta
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: The missing district, this area appears to be a great excavation site for people past, it appears as a perfectly rectangular (with regards to the curvature of the planet) hole dug out and kept there. The sides of which are littered with indications of old sewer systems that now open into the giant hole. Water does not seem to naturally pool at the bottom seemingly being absorbed or evaporated upon contact.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Volatere
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: The ground lightning district due to tunnels underneath it containing a storm. Lightning shoots in from the ground out to the sky. Electronics need to be configured to work backwards in regards to their transistors in this district. Tech has been manufactured to subdue this process for people moving through.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Yazilik
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: The return to civilization proper according to most of the populace where dense infrastructure returns yellow clay covers most of the buildings proving to be a natural insulator. The clay is also the natural home to small burrowing creatures which leads to an advanced network of tunnels of varying sizes that create numerous whistling noises throughout the city.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Zal
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: A district of hot zones due to an airflow tunnel, mostly uninhabited with more of a wild west town population in the few million. This results in a strong airflow leaving the region and an unstable climate according to it’s sidereal movement.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.title: Zuniaur
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/omeg.description: The red land covered in light red dust of iron, old upside down pyramids cover the area and are held up by statues of different ancestries found in the universe. Of these pyramids 13 of ancestries remain unidentified. Large collection towers with sail like devices that flutter collecting the airborne iron and pulling it in. Most people live in the “Rat-mazes” , a collection of tubes that have an internal filtration and climate. Notably unforgiving to live in for larger ancestries.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Altunha
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: A district where the ‘spines’ of the district rose up and caused multiple megabuildings to collapse inward in the district. The result is a series of interlocking buildings held up by safety mechanisms that appear as someone’s interlocking fingers covering the center of the district.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Apacym
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: The hot springs district, used often as a retreat. In contrast to the rest of the city the lower levels near the naturally occurring hot springs are considered the wealthy parts of the city with places higher in elevation being delegated to lower incomes. There is an entire bubble underground dedicated to reproducing the natural day/night effects of various homeworlds.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Ausanget
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: The corrosive swamps, the acidity ate away at almost all natural life leaving only mud and shimmering blue water that will kill you if you drink it and burn the skin. Odd algae seems to swim through the water and provides oxygen for the area but people in areas with large concentrations start to suffer hallucinations despite there being no chemicals present in the air near them.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Caracolu
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: The hive built by Shirrens, primarily the entirety of this district, has hexagonal designs in all directions. The buildings connect geometrically making it possible to move through the entirety of the district without ever truly leaving the hive.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Chav
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: A volcanic area where artificial volcanos pump the lava onto their skyscrapers allowing it to flow down through the building, hardening into obsidian and then being carved away from the inside to make new rooms on the expanding buildings. It is the home to a large diaspora of orcs and known as Orc City.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Choluyo
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: A green river canyon district that runs on the habitable belt. Factories were placed in the bottom of the canyon to extract the natural resources then the canyon was slowly filled in with buildings on top of buildings causing the district to seem unnaturally flat when entering from another district.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Choquezu
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: The cybercity, the entirety of this section was built brutalistically without flair or adornment. Instead the infrastructure was built to allow the fastest internet to upload a shared reality in AR visible through popular eyewear in the region. This allows the internet architect Vaphes-2 to recreate the city as they desire to those outside.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Chulpara
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: The slums give way to more and more at the Sillusti border but eventually it returns to a normal city. Sillusti attempts to stop their work force from moving here for a better life and have succeeded at legislative maneuvers in order to prevent this area from getting proper funding to flourish.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Copanmar
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: A rainy district with flash freezing resulting in large icicles that cover the region pointing in every direction. An important public service is for one to go and trim the tips off for the safety of the common folk.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Cymki
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: A city of white as the nearby thermal springs have left their deposit on the landscape. The whole region is covered in white from it with rust red towers emerging out of the chalk.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Draigre
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: An arid savannah region almost all of its native life is able to dig underground when the hot winds blow fiery sand across the plains. A large Talphi population resides here.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Elmirad
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: An oceanic stretch of land, a salt water body of water sits on the sunside and slowly comes to a boil the further into the sun you go. This results in an extremely hot coastline that goes along the city, it used to be sauna like before pollution took over resulting in an atmosphere similar to a hot springs populated entirely by sewage runoff.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Gwynhak
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: Home to the majority of the workforce of Vitiae, people who work there only do so one day out of the week in order to not reap the benefits unearned. The majority of the work force takes a basic shift in Vitiae. It is also home to one of the space elevators of Senaria.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Icanin
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: A karst area it seemed to be the natural runoff point of the Apacym springs before it changed due to a tectonic shift to flow towards Apacym. Known as the teeth of Senaria the Karsts are not stable enough to be built on and thus are being destroyed in order to access the bedrock underneath resulting in numerous protests.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Machupir
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: The waste pits, originally from one of the first galactic wars that was fought here and the original capital center of the Tivarin System. As numerous ships fell and irradiated the location all that was left was rubble. Everything worth stealing was taken and as the society regrew, people needed a place to put their waste and thus the old empire seat became a garbage dump.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Marterra
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: A grave district, blocked from the sun due to a series of walls erected, the buildings aren’t allowed to exceed the height of the shadow made by the wall in order to prevent light from reflecting down onto the undead population within. Home of a Corpse Fleet embassy.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Mitlano
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: A district with a colder atmosphere staying at around 35 degrees Fahrenheit consistently, a harsh wind blows in from the dark side making it impossible to heat up any space that isn’t sealed like a spaceship.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Moraya
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: The nearby forest grows supernaturally fast digging into the city itself. Automated drones chop the roots before it can damage infrastructure, though most of the forest was destroyed after it was deemed a hazard to profit and growth, the darkside forest was allowed to exist after it was discovered that a classified herb could potentially enhance/unlock psionic powers in the consumer.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Ollantek
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: An anomaly zone, all ancestries gain access to 30 feet of telepathy. Despite being a wealthy zone it has a low amount of people applying to move in before the scarring as it’s incredibly easy to beam random thoughts into strangers' heads if you don’t normally have telepathy. A form of advertising is to beam the ad directly into someone’s head.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Paracas
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: Brutalist architecture takes over the area in an attempt to recreate the strongholds of the dwarven home city. Known as the citadel of senaria its insides are warm and inviting but the cold wind blows across harsh stone on its outside.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Pisakot
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: A pahtra heavy zone, with standard tree top architecture built into the existing skyscrapers, large bridges suspended on adamantine cords sway stories above the streets. Small chimes dangle underneath singing in the wind that blows between the towers.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Quir
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: Floating islands dominate this district large stretches of land that forgot to fall down following an unknown magical event. Many support pillars have been put up in order to secure it in case it remembers to fall. The city at large throws its trash into the land under the floating islands so it may be buried when it falls. The poor have built upon the island due to no one reasonably wanting to live on the unstable magical event.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Sacsaywe
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: Another impact zone though less devastated than Machupir, it was spared the wrath of scavengers but not the waste build up. That is until Raxilite communities sprung up from the destroyed and natural reclaimed buildings. They started a thriving community before it was eventually reclaimed by greater forces and assimilated into the Aedryn standard.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Sal
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: A ring of Solenne exists here which beams light up back into space. The people in the city proper cannot see the stars and instead see a pure orange and yellow shifting aurora borealis like effect in the sky. The streets are paved with mirrors to reflect the beauty of her sky throughout the city. Very bad for the light sensitive ancestries.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Sillusti
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: An upper middle class section of the world. Built by those who want to become part of the Vitiae district. They do not have the means to import their labor though resulting in very nice buildings near the Vitiae district that transition into slums the further away you go.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Siourex
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: An android haven, founded as an escape colony from those fleeing indentured servitude under Aetherion Corporation, it eventually became a home to all androids before they gained their rights. Was the first place outside of the Solara Imperium to allow androids to hold office.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Solnox
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: An anomaly makes it appear as if there is a permanent solar and lunar eclipse at any given time. Research has shown that the anomaly is pure darkness, with lasers sent from the moons unable to penetrate back to the planet.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Solrex
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: An anomaly zone that makes it appear as if the sun is in the sky at all times. Notably hotter than others at 140 degrees Fahrenheit, people not accustomed to hot weather are not advised to live here.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Tenochti
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: The upside down mountain, an odd anomaly, has allowed a large artificial upside down pyramid to remain in this district. People have built support pillars underneath it, resulting in two cities: the shaded area underneath, and the waterside district built in the pool of rainwater at the top of the pyramid.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Tŵrcre
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: A fey aligned district where one of the feylords of twilight has claimed their domain. Mortals may visit but only after passing a basic written test about the rules of the fey there. The test is administered by the world bureaucracy and not the fey for the mortals safety.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Uxmalir
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: A vesk section of the world built on a maelstrom, the weather changes every week to a new extreme resulting in a large population of adapted Vesk.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Vinihung
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: A temperate zone with weather at about 78 degrees. It only rains in a light drizzle but it always rains. Data centers used to be built here but the hammer of industry slowly acidified the nearby lakes resulting in a constant acid rain and the abandonment of the primary source of income.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Vitiae
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description:
An incredibly wealthy area with holes in it that connect to the Plane of Vitality, people in the region live double their expected lifespan but studies show that increased population in the region divides the vitality between people. The result was a ban on megabuildings and a minimum income was enforced by those living in the city. Notable individuals were selected by The Council to be invited into the city.
Spoilers/Jay Info Storm has been moving up in the world getting to be headquartered in the Vitiae district; they've fallen under the command of one Mafilus, a vesk commander. Running the district as a military junta.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Xochical
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: Tube district, a series of pneumatic tubes were funded for the district as a way to test viability for others, it eventually led to a tube oligarchy recreating the railroad boom conditions and never spread to the other districts. The entire city is traversable (and sometimes only traversable) by tubes. These tubes have managed to be integrated in small scale in some areas but never like this again.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Yaxchilan
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: Prior home of the Proso clanking trees, the area was built to mimic the trees that are no longer there. New residents don’t fully know why the buildings are built with strange hollow chimes that clank against the exteriors of buildings but they do serve a purpose of showing wind intensity to people inside.

places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.title: Zunimer
places/systems/auver-system/senaria/sigm.description: A tornado alley with very few natural terrain features due to deforestation to keep it under control. The outer rim was protected by an order of druids that divert the tornados away from the city and into places that didn’t pay protection money.

places/systems/rona-system.html.title: Rona System
places/systems/rona-system.html.description: Solara Imperium space

(she is technically exiled in Concord of Aedryn space, but shes in Hollow Stars space so whatever happens happens. Not technically allied with any major faction. Kalervo Turred Leads us to the center “Please take off your shoes upon entering.” woman whos augments make her roughly 7ft tall, extends a hand
Zaera allhaven “Welcome. I hope the ride here wasnt too bad. The winds can be rough.” N: what a fascinating place, are you responsible for the bugs? “No, they’re natural here. What do you think is happening- im here to oversee their evolution.” N: oh i understand. You wanted to meet us?
“Youre the first survivors. I wanted to know how it was. I have a proposal. Do you want to live on Kiliv-VI for the rest of your lives?” No
“Ill repair your ship if you get bug corpses. More than 2, less than 10.” 26: why put an upper limit? Could i offer you a drink?” Xep: alcohol? Soda? “We have various non-named juices.” R: milk? “What kind?”
Almado gets Dr. Vesk (meat flavored soda) E-xep-ro gets ‘normal beverage for human’ “Now obviously, there was 1 issue. I will request another favor, of course.” “It appears the vehicle was not salvageable. We were able to take some of the insignias off of it, if you wish.” Al: were you able to salvage the uh. (motions to the mask) “The thing is. It was skewered through and eaten by the local braueri.” N: was it made of plant material? “No, it appears they spit their digestive juices on it in passing.” N: you mentioned you wanted to ask another favor? “Of course. If i could ask, are you going to Nsuoba soon?” Yes “Could you bring the doctoral student Turid with you?” 26: for what purpose? “He needs to go there. I won’t ask where you’re going or why you have a ship that was registered under an aetherion official’s title, and had to scrub, and you wont ask why he needs to go.” N: do we have to bring him back? “No. He will find his own way back or travel with u. Once he’s there he will do his task.” N: i dont see why there would be an issue. Unless there’s someone else who has an issue? (miku is 3 hours late to her performance.) Nivaya pulls zeraph aside for a moment N: i know this seems like a lot to ask, i was very interested in your research, im a student of biology myself, i did come here to seek out that sort of thing. I was wondering if there was any info from your research youd be iwlling to share, i could share what i have so far. I was able to get some information about the bugs we encountered “The bugs are my research, theyre a pinochle of evolution, theyre able to evolve midlife cycle to fit their group. If those 2 survived they mightve been leaders. N: do you know where theyre migrating? “Theyre migrating???” N: there are signs of migration “Thats unfortunate. We’ll have to move. We picked this location bc it was close.” N; theyre moving. (shows her pictures of the filigree and what was seen with the other 2) “They’ve evolved!” looks outside “this is most unprecedented. I wanted to experiment on the vesk, but they were sentient fully by the time we learned of them. This might become the next vesk.” N: have they always been like this? “They were much more violent. (abt to say something)” N: able to adapt as well “Of course. Why else would you come out here?” N: can we stay in contact? “Of course you can contact me at any time.” N: ill be sure to contact if i have anything to share She writes down something, waves us goodbye Turred waits outside “did you have a nice talk?” N: i did! “How was it!” N: it was fiiiine? “Ill be setting myself up in the cargo. If thats alright with you?” N: if thats what you prefer. “I need a lot of room. And the experiments get implosive.”
Able to go to newly refurbished vehicle, 300ft, The Blue Angel Despite its size, handles like a dream Rumbles upon takeoff, able to leave atmosphere, free to go to amongst the Turred takes off for the first time in his life Almado texts manager Overhears ASPER conversation, punches wall and starts texting manager more Contact dead, asset fine
ASPER texts Siryu Get in contact with text, get a call back “Hello, youve reached the impound. Who is calling? “My designation is ASPER. Is siryu there? “Siryu cannot talk. Are you calling to pay the fine? Do u represent Siryu’s company? A: I do
Siryu is currently in holding for murder of Arroyo Cemsor The man who was going to give Miku her first gig A: IDK what this is about “5000 credit fine. Will go to auction if Siryu is held in contempt of court, if you wish to buy the ship back.” As: this seems out of character for her?? “Murder is out of character for most people.” E-xep-ro checks for messages, none Almado is PISSED, making Asper help hatsune miku
Approach Nsuoba Lower part made of underwater caves, various unique fruits Able to make wine-like Nsuobier
Begin landing in Thorne, have to pass by rusty curiosity that is currently impounded Looks like it underwent surgery, standard practice to prevent invisible creatures/holdouts Warn abt venting the air out, you may show yourself and be arrested normally Siryu is planetside, mildly injured, conscious She may have punched someone when they attempted to arrest her Land the ship on the raining planet, central city itself. Traffic controller boards, looks at nivaya “could you sign here please?” Almado tries to look “not you please, this is a free city” Corp has tried to incorporate the planet, have failed “Could you sign?” N: what? “The ship landing. To say that this is your ship.” N: well it is ours “So could you sign?” (this isnt a contract, but it will be signaled out in case we’re wanted. More a check to see if we are a pirate. Odd legalese of the planet (cant sleep in ship if parked)) Nivaya signs “Welcome to nsuoba. Is there anywhere you wish to go, if you lack signal for some reason?” Al: we dont lack signal “Good my job is done” leaves Miku and co goes to the studio Odd looking building, not quite a studio but it is labeled clearly on the map as such
The Dredge Al: ripley open the door youre the first fan here. I wont charge you! Drying room bc of the rain
Dive bar, dwarven gentleman Korrim Vale “You’re not supposed to be here!” M: SORRY WE’RE LATE Al: we got hung up “Are you here to stock the shelves…?” Al: here for the show “This is a bar. This is a non-live music bar. We had to tear out the karaoke machine with the sailors.” Al: we were supposed to meet arroyo “My boss? He’s dead. Gutless pig got what was coming to him.” Al: there will be a performance. “Theres no one here but me and you.” Almado checking texts with Maikeru “Youre not allowed back there, send me the files.” He disappears for a bit, comes back “I should offload this before the cops come. Would you be interested in buying any cocaine by chance?” “Do try to ignore everything else back here.” guns, ammo, sniper rifle, payphone (the pin is correct, this is supposed to be a venue but the picture is entirely different)) “Hes a fan of the old world.” hands over a dollar bill with coke on it Ripley gets miku’s signature “Would you like any of the hard money? I took the credits out of the safes.” “Take as much as you want. We ran out of toilet paper weeks ago. Ive been using this for less savory business.” Al: so arroyo “The bastard. Worked for aetherion. Youre just working the job. You wouldnt be here if you werent working it.” Al: gotta do what you gotta do “Its a shit company. I should know, family comes from there.” Al: the company’s not bad, pretty good gig “Well, he wanted to open up the planet. Probably why he got murked.” Al: any idea? I heard it was a cultivator “No? Pilot. Pahtra.” Hands over a datapad, shows she was at the scene of the crime with a gun 26: reasonable to be nervous when people are to be murdered Al: i havent been able to contact my manager, means im next “Youre next?” Al: yeah for promotion Al: 26 another bump on me 26: please call me the 26 laws of power Al: we have a murder to solve 26: we supposed we can leverage our understanding of the universe to leverage such matters Al: it would be a karmically good thing to solve a murder, yes? 26: itd aid in our heavenly tribulation, yes! Al: hey where’d you get that coke “IDK. same place he gets his weapons.” Most of the weapons are incendiary “I wouldnt open that one. Theres currently security on the other side. Itll shoot even me. Probably his personal stash.” Electronic and normal lock 6 bots explode, combat
Invisible creature (Ayla) who throws xep around
“Cmon, mommy and daddy want you nivaya. It’s time to go home.” Al: are you just here for the kid? “Yeah ill take him and leave.” N: do you think now is the time for me to be immobilized? “Its fine, ill protect you. I just need to bring you back and if you suffer a bit on the way it’s fine” N: are they here?? “No, they have better things to do than chase after a (smth) son” Woman doesnt move like a typical elf Restrains nivaya Al: nivaya is a contracted employee of the aetherion corporation. This WILL be reported N: im in the middle of a very important research project. Are they trying to get in the way of my research? “IDK” N: i thought they wanted me to pursue this “IDK. they just want you back alive.” N: could we all go? Im sure my parents would love to meet all my friends “Theyre a bad influence.” N: ill go without struggle! “Youre barely struggling” N: if they cant support me, ill just kill myself “Here, i’ll make sure i cant” points gun at hands R: if you move, ill shoot him in the head “Go ahead and try. You dont have it in you. I could threaten to shoot everyone else in the room and you still wouldnt shoot him.” Xep, gun to nivaya’s head: this is a person who would rather die than be in captivity. She drops the leash She walks out and waits, gun still to the back of the head of 26 26: we dont enjoy guns at the back of our brain “No one does jackass.” Combat ends There was so much cocaine and personal weapons and a cracked open safe Stuff is missing, datasticks and the like were stolen from the safe Guy who died was trying to turn the area into a monopoly, only parts he doesnt own are public sector parts Owns his own vineyards, (sailing) ports, has a real concert hall, sports arenas. All on the up and up beyond having to engage in some shady business The white angels emerge victorious once more

sessions/epitaph-protocol/act-1/session-.description:
