Thorne, The Dredge
Dwarf Korrim Vale shows up with 2 giant bottles of vodka Hes gonna light up
He says that we are gonna be used as witnesses to Siryu doing this “Im gonna go delete security footage.” Al: how much insurance?
“Itll just go to his family, not me.” Al: tell you what, we’ll look around and decide just how much “Im just gonna go destroy the security footage and you think about it”
Ayla “we dont need to do that. Nivaya can just go back to their parents” (Aurora Camacho, Emilio Camacho)
“It would kill you too, and youre too much of an asset you could work for me, we could split the pay. Im sure Aetherion Corporation would love to have an in with a royal family. An iconoclast.” What?????? AS: how much are you being paid to retrieve nivaya?
“Credits? 50k. And an in with a meeting with the Camacho Family.” N: isnt there something we could work out? We help you, you help us out by letting me go?
“I work with the Hynarion Circle.”
Iconoclast are religious family that are scholars that go against the norm to create evolution in the empire, whatever the major party is they are trained to oppose it. Perma devils advocate. Argue in political sphere all go to nice colleges Circle = Shrub Mob, druid mafia Their leader has arranged with things that are impossible to arrange with, doing biodiversity before space travel was common. Dirt and plants if you blow them up, they help the ecosystem, incredibly hostile to people who hop on them without proper clearance. Shrub mob has somehow gotten that clearance “So. why not go back to mom and pa?” N: you mentioned you owe the hynarion circle, could we help?
(Theyre looking with an in with the Concord of Aedryn. You could very much help with that) “Listen. Youre not gonna escape me. You can disguise yourself as much as you want and i’ll still find you. Youre going around with 2 neon blue haired… people?” Al: im marked as equipment Xep: oh same “Then you understand this is just a job, i have to make a living out of it. Im just gonna follow you around, and should the guard drop, then i’ll get you. Ive already found the ones who are willing to kill you.” “Do you think the aetherion corp will like the news of the assassination of an embassy leader’s child.” (xep is playing minesweeper and has a gun to nivaya’s head)
Lights flicker, tv turns on, shows a bit of Kiliv-VI with the egg Phones go off with salacious ads and porn It is entirely possible we had a phantom message in that closet we opened. Those bots jammed signals until they were dead
(ads about The Serenade) During the disappearance, many board members went missing and were lost. This was later created by the great uplifting that shows that people can always go up higher than they were. She looks down at her own phone “Ill leave you alone for now. Youre free to go over, the plants will whisper to me, and the fish.” Xep: birds? “I’ve never seen the birds.” (this world is 0.1% too heavy for birds) N: oh ok. Uh. lets go ASPER sees an injured dog Heals it 26: GREETINGS MORTAL WE ARE THE 26 ALWS OF POWER “I know jackass. Your companion is much kinder.” 26: what should we call you? “Ayla.” 26: travelling companions. We have determined that this dog is the bounty hunter. Miku maps lead us to the right place, approach a governmental building Gov building Approach the clerk, veskian, has tusk Asper registers as friend to visit siryu Through a speaker, make contact with her Smiles “ive finally been arrested for something I didn’t do” A: that is not as reassuring as one would hope “Then evidence will come up that i didn’t do it. That’s what ur god believes right? A: what happened? We went to the dredge “I went to find somewhere to get a drink with people like me. Instead i found a stage with a murdered body and the police had been called as soon as i arrived. I attempted to (and i swear) figure out what was wrong and my gun went off on its own A: how does that happen? “Idk, a policeman tackled me right after. They tased me and pepper sprayed me 5 times A: that’s so cruel. Are you alright now? Beyond being contained? “That’s a lot to go beyond but no immediate danger. Trial is slated for 1 revolution or 60 days A: I shall do my best to ensure that nothing comes of this. I believe that there is a bigger conspiracy at hand Cameras and people all around us. No weapons or implements
“If there’s a conspiracy I know one that could tell u about it. One Velu Shineleaf A: velu shineleaf? “A halfling, one of the moon people.” Come from a humanoid moon A: I will do my best to try and find out what this velu shineleaf might know. Is there anything that I can do while ur in there and im out here? “Find evidence to free me, investigate the stage maybe? A: where is this stage? I understand there’s a bar but there’s no stage “Well i tried to go to the bar and wound up at the stage
A: maybe if we go to the bar we’ll wind up at the stage? Well I will do my best to find out the truth. May aeryn-vox guide me. And if i find anything i’ll come back as soon as possibly Time is up and both are pulled away. We can come back tomorrow for 5 more minutes Ayla shows up with a car “Nivaya would you like a ride to not be in the rain?” N: no im good Walking, the car slowly follows Cars behind her the whole time, holding up traffic
Heading to the stage Incredibly drunk and less than reputable people stuck outside, confused Entire area has already been recorded Stage is right there, you arent allowed to use it before the murder has been solved or it was cleared Cops here to stop people from going in, we’re allowed to go past, we’re the people on the venue ticket Al: whos in charge here?
“That would be the Kalo (Kalo Cop).” Weird aquatic man floating staring down “He was murdered yesterday.” 26: greetings we are the 26 laws of power “You are the one that is friend of siryu?” “That person you travel with is friend, murder, stage owner.” Al: yeah idc abt her, it wont affect my impartiality M: HIII!! “You are much more likeable than the other one.” M: ill take it as a compliment! “Not big compliment.” M: what happened here? “Siryu seems to have murdered the owner. Corporate dispute.” M: motive? “It does seem that siryu had voucher from aetherion corp so they could take over certain assets. One death voucher for aetherion.” (way to ensure smaller companies dont become part of the whole, let little wars break out to let the overall higher ups keep control) M: how long ago was she given the voucher? “Does not have date. She may have also killed another. One tech worker known by aetherion. Thrown into ocean. Body never recovered.” 26: what was their name? M: the ocean. Wow!
“Anongies. And one android Y493. M: how did the murder happen? “This one? Gunshot. Many. twice in back of head.” “He was facing towards back. 2 bullets missing from siryu.” “No footage. Siryu master hacker. Incompetence easy to fake.” 26: there seems to be no reason for this to have happened “Why here during murder?” 26: we believe siryu had a similar problem. When attempting to input the address of this location in a mapping software, it brought up the address of a dive bar known as the dredge. To arrive here, we had to input the address of dive bar. M: can we help with the investigation? Pleeease “Investigative rights. But speak of it no one. And accept that siryu may be murderer.” Looking around Office with a contract that just needs 2 signatures Ask xep to forgery Almado signs it, thumb print Could record entire videos here after for 2 whole days Personal computer, dont seem security related Various documents, various transactions most are above the board, some are not This is dual authenticated. Banking system hosted offworld, you can add copies cannot remove. Kinda like the blockchain Somehow, a few transactions are missing. Notes on the local computer are personal notes abt things hes agreed to sell. Removed, requires a master hacker or someone at all locations that was able to delete all of them at once in a coordinated effort
Would have to be within system, most likely Kiliv-vi or Voya Level of skill achievable by humanoid? Lvl 20 tho or a 0 day kind of hack (built into the system) Safe has been opened, police tape on it, uncloseable Taken everything from the safe as evidence (asper knows that siryu’s gun had a targeting system that would limit the kickback. Would still be hard to hack) Need 2 days to clear their gun with the courts Almado breaks into a room, aetherion corp property damage 2 computers, security guard booth Large screen that shows all the cameras in the area Missing footage exactly around the time of the murder Fantastic job At one point, able to see slightly not fully scrubbed. Able to see the outline of a copaxi man (sentient coral reef), walking away during one of the cuts. Enough that if it were being hacked really fast, wouldve been missed We download it rq Ripley grabs the cop He looks “copaxi. They live here, yes. Near ocean. But all is ocean.” Xep: around time of murder “Oh. anything else?” Al: someone tried to remove them Xep: we think. The level of soficistation has the level of hacks would make them galaxy known. Maybe that is not known. “Good hacker not known to galaxy, good hacker known to few.” Xep: this is approaching the limit of capability. It involved hacking into a banking system. And a gun. “Not good. Serious business.” Xep: someone at that level would “Push back the trial then. 2 years? (120 days)” “We’ll do request. Copaxi not enough to go on, plenty here.” 26: is the afact that they are missing from all footage except this one suspicious “Yes, but i cannot arrest ever copaxi that i see.” “Computer underwater do not work so good.” “Many live on shore to use computer, but some have vacuum tube.” Xep: if you had a lot, would it be a noticeable amount of vaccuum tubes. “Yes, but at that point, easier to live on land, no?” Xep: perhaps more comfortable underwater “Maybe,” Al: miku. I need you to tell that cop that it is very important for us to see the world like the victim did so you can get on that goddamn stage. I need you on that stage for 15 seconds. 1 picture. Holoshop can do the rest. M: do you mind if i stand on the stage to feel what the man felt before he died? “Of course” (internet was found not created. Credits are tiny computers. All planets had some form of credits of some density on them. Small cloud computing hardware, innately valuable) Puts a hologram of the dead guy The lividity seems fresh but the wound is old. Blood kept pumping despite him already being dead. Hey whats with this “We considered it a glitch with the system.” Almado phone call
Mr Maikeru Sukkoto is in another system Al: mr sakodol, things are going wrong. I recruited some interns. I got some decent photos, but the concert might not happen. I need insurance, stat. Going to Velu Shineleaf Hes an infomation broker, if you kill one your secrets will be leaked Hes simply here bc he likes the local liquor that is brewed here. He was a big shot in the aedryn but holds no love there Ayla doesnt follow us in N: do you want to come inside? “No.” Approach halfling man, sitting behind desk. Stops playing video game “Might i help you?” R: whatcha playing (first person shooter, but when he disconnects, everyone pauses) “Could i offer you anything? Cigar? Liquor?” M: i dont think i can have that “Of course, you want more cocaine, almado?” Al: yeah. “Im willing to work with you if youre going to work with me. What are you here for? The murder, or the stalkin’, nivaya?” N: not the stalking “Shes a real bitch, but she means well. Or is it about the ship?” N: the ship? “The unregistered one.” “How might i help yall?” As: we came at the advice of siryu “Lovely lady As: i believe so “Shame about the accusation, especially since it’s false As: i’m glad u believe that “At least 20% false, 60% true but I’m a dreamer As: i don’t think those numbers are true “Do you have numbers to back it up? As: no “Then 40 and 60 it’ll be E: Showing him the Copaxi “this might change your outlook “That is someone that is around the time of the murder. Few hours before the murder at the earliest. He appeared at a few meetings following that. Not the murderer, maybe an accomplace. Siryu knows a few. I might be able to find out who that is” A: what do you want in return? “I have some performers that went missing. I could do with finding them, hopefully today. You have a ship? A: we do, do you think we could find them within a day? “If you try ur hardest i think u could find it within urself to find them in a day Miku: we’ll try our best! “I have their last known location and what they look like. Is that sufficient? A: it should be “1 question if found, 2 if getting info should they perish, none if killed for 2nd question.” M: contact info? “Do not call me. Meet me in person. Info online is able to be stolen. Information real life, well, theyd have to beat you up in an alley.” Al: speaking of contact info, (to xep) whats your comm id? Xep: you dont want to be in my phone contacts when they find this. I will give you my number, but if you text me, if they find this phone, they’ll find yours. “Hopefully thisll clear up some of your questions, some of mine, we’ll keep this on the down low.” 26: we would find this agreeable “Even the one that worships that talkative bitch in the stars? As: do you mean me or someone else? “You’re the one that worships the goddess who cares about freedom of information right? As: I am still coming to terms with how I face the world. I do not know if I can agree to this arrangement. “Well, youll come back, see how you feel when you get the paycheck. There is no cash, only credit.” “You could take that ship, say i sent you, if you want to abandon siryu, you can. Ayla wont bother you. Her master wont be pleased if she interrupts something for me.” “Permanent breather from her if you leave nivaya and leave.” Go to spaceship One of workers looks, “im sorry this ship doesnt have a name. Do you know what it is?”
The Blue Angel
Oh Kalervo Turred is still here “I have good news! I dont know how i know it. You have been forgiven for your crime!” “The dreams?” Do you always have these dreams?? “No!” (he does seem to have bumped his hand, it didnt scab, but splintered, and then healed up.) “Its a good thing no?” Its good to be forgiven? “Forgiveness is good. Ill tell it to my dream. Is forgiveness paramount to vengeance?” As: why do you ask such questions? “Im trying to figure it out. Ive lived my entire life in that area.” M: miku believes that everyone deserves a 2nd chance Al: in a non-financial way. Wait i need that 2nd chance. Capitalism always gives 2nd chances
N: you mentioned that you were doing research on the ship for Zaera Allhaven, could you tell me more? “About evolution of course. Its all vague to me now. I remember back then we were doing research on evolution chains on how beings became sentient.” N: any progress? “I have. But of course she took it. It is her right.” N: on this ship? “No, ive been experiencing things, enjoying things. Ive recently discovered that there are ways to find companions in this world.” “Do you have trouble with a companion, nivaya?” N: so. More about your research. Do you have a family? “I was born there, i was adopted when i was quite young by m’lady.” “No one remembers much about their birth.” (26 remembers their birth, birthed from the brain) N: she told you to come here and experience things? “Yes” N: what did she say “To live my life a little, gave me a sum of credits, i did stuff, i learned many things, and i came back here because thats what im supposed to do.” N: are you to be with us? “If you’ll have me.” (drops something under nivayas sheets)
(its a book titled “Playing the Game - How to Drive Women Wild”) Al: did she give you a comm unit? “Of course.” Al: how many credits? “Not that many.” Al: ballpark? “30k? Xep: how many did you start with? “Before i met those nice ladies? 200k.” Al: never spend more than 1k in one sitting. Ok kid? “They charged me 10k per lady.” Al: youre still standing? “Of course, why wouldnt i be?” As: what did you learn there? “They gave me kisses, as adults do.”
(we look at our bank, we have Aethercoin now Almado: Truth Miku: Missing Xep: Scene ASPER: Voyage 26: Oceans Nivaya: wont say Xep tries to hack in, it should be simpler but is an infinite void as theyre sucked across time and space. Back into reality. Similar to the circuitry Xep: the fuck is wrong with your phone? Ripley: Sacrifice) Flying, rainbow on the oceans below, prism-like effect Unique geometric shapes, starships that didnt survive landing that fell below Continue to myriad of jungles that make the greenery of planet, land Find signal flares where the last group left, even if their comms unit broke Takes a little bit Crash investigators wave and smile at us “why are you here?” Not cops, these are his men “Found the ship.” Al: heres the plan. Miku. (sets up a chair for her) 26: we were passed by velu shineleaf to find your location. “You found us. Can we go home? There is much to report.” 26: we heard there were 3 of you. “One fell into the ocean.” (they believe this to be the ocean, and not just a pond. It appears to have a bottom and salty bc of the land, but isnt the ocean.) Xep: what are you looking for when getting back to the city? “Booze and sex.” Xep: that bar you go to, whats the name?
“Sexico-6.” (theres no sexico 6 on the planet) (we know the guy whos been to the brothel. Nivaya texts him abt the name of it. He went to the starlace)
Al: have you been to The Starlace? “We like booze and women, like you.” (only ASPER can roll: they both seem to have what seems to be blood around the mouth slits of their breathing apparatus. Something crawled into their corpses and posessed their bodies. They want us to bring them back to civilization. One completely wiped it clean, one only partially.) Xep gets a sneaky pic “Why do you need photography?” Xep: waht are you guys “People who want to go home.” Xep: you are possessing corpses. I do need to know why before letting you on the ship “Circle of life. Had to do it.” Xep: are you some sort of creature that lives in others? “Yes.” Xep: did you kill them? “Not relevant. We found them.” Xep: how often do you need new corpses? “Often to propagate.” “Make if need.” Xep: that does have the connotation that it is something you enjoy doing “Do you enjoy killing? Do you enjoy fucking?” N: what did kill them? “Circumstance kill all. Search this area, unlucky, we in area first. Trap, kill. We lay. One fall into deep reach, cannot reach, cannot breathe salt.” Xep: did you make the trap? “Does not matter. They are dead.” Xep: what was the trap? “Trap was simple. Shot through head. Spike.” Xep: through the ship? Or they got out? “They not part of ship. Ship part of them. Too old to eat. Too old to take. Came here, ate trap, be thankful.” “Trap spectacular. Kill without blood. Soul ripped from body. Not from trap.” Xep: what did you do with it? “See soul escape body. They scream. Nothing we can do but take body. Only wish for more. Would it not bring comfort to see loved ones moving around as if alive?” “You would not care, ripley, to have a loved one
“No name is ripley. Necrophiliac ripley. Wish could fuck other. Bad situation. Monster to us.”
R: no i just miss him???? I dont want to see him animated like a weird thing??? (might be reading akashic record, cntrl+f grief)
Aedrynic Al: we’re not taking you back Points their guns at almado Combat:
Threllopex

I dont want to play it too loud (plays the jingle) “The shitty jingle that played on the way?” R: so you hear it? “Of course i hear it.” R: i found out some people dont hear it. “Like the dress?” R: yes! They argue abt the color of the dress, she is insistent on it being blue R: when they hear the jingle, they only hear static “Theyre wrong like the ones that see the dress as white.” R: i wanted to ask abt u hearing it, hey turred. U hear the jingle right? Turred “Sounds good!” R: u hear it? Turred “yes” R: just wanted confirmation “Are you high?” R: no. im just- we’ve all had a very. Week. um. I guess my brain is a little fried, thanks for putting up with my questions. Enjoy the movie Ripley reveals the 2nd xep We’re like. Yeah there are many No the anti-lemdako group had like a pet xep. Like xep was shot but it was by another xep Ripley doesnt know how he recognized the xep as a xep despite them being 100 years oldish Almado talks with ripley Al: after everything thats gone down, i still have no idea what ur major is. R: anthropologist/archaeologist. I like to learn abt ancient cultures, find connections. Kinda all abt forging connections. I havent done a good job but id like to try to have us get along
Siryu hunts down asper “You dont need to help me. Its just that… the situations youre in seem pretty dangerous now?” As: outside of my control
“Yeah ik danger. But miss astana would love to see you again before stuff happens. Shes in the aedryn system so u could go see her, or she could come here. Ur all attention magnets, it works well for me. She could give you all a tour of the capital. Ik going to the capital would be daunting, but trust me, she wouldnt let anything happen to you. And no one here’s bounty, mine included, is big enough to be hunted down As: that is reassuring “At the very least you can leave aedryn. The worst i can imagine is exile As: not ideal but not the end of the world “No, in fact it’s only about a fifth of the known world
As: True, I’m not limited to Aedryn space. It’s nice she’s available for a visit “She’s an aedryn diplomat, where would she be besides Aedryn As: didn’t know if she’d be home. She travels “Important to drift on home As: it’s difficult to visit her
“We could always visit Velin As: we could. Again it’s difficult “It’s been (equivalent of 4 months) Surely whatever the last blowup was he’s forgotten about it As: you would be surprised “He’s lived a long life. Whatever the blowup was isn’t going to be noticeable in the grand scheme of things As: yeah there’s a long time ahead of us “There’s a long time for both of us Almado writes up PIP abt all of us Xep is a great employee but it reads terrible Miku reads great but is terrible Ripley needs to keep their opinions to themselves 26 gets an angry rant which is technically kind of racist
Eventually our ship is no longer impounded, make our way down Slowly but surely, dock workers un-impound it 16 masked men all with meiko are harassing them
Meiko! “You couldve just told me there was an issue” M: i didnt know hwo to tell! “You can tell me anything.” M: i think i got replaced! “Replaced???” M: i got infected with credicites (rambling explains) has that happened to you? “Hasnt happened to me. But what sort of bodyguard would let that happen?” Almado tries to talk “Miku, the help is trying to talk to me.” X: he sent an unkind performance review abt her. Its a pleasure to meet you
Meiko walks over, holds up a performance review for Kaito. Written by his bodyguard, which says only exemplary things “Youre the only one stupid enough to leave a bad review.” Al: i…. (gets tazed) She slaps the miku head “Eight. Hand sanitizer.” gets sanitized Almado knight kneels, she turns back “You needant worry, he wont do anything.” (he has to stay there until dismissed) M: is it normal to kick ur bodyguards? “God no. mine are all wonderful. And this one is wonderful to you?” M: i think hes been a good friend but he keeps secrets from me :( he finally told me abt the replacement thing but only under duress and i think hes hiding smth else but he wont tell me :( (almado. You are so fucked.) “You are the 2nd miku then?” M: um. I think the third? “You know about that?” M: about what? “The first incident.”
M: no? The kind info broker said i was version 3 tho! (DIDNT GIVE THE INFO FOR FREE) “Which one? I will have a talk with them.” M: this one was nice! Nicer than almado! “Lets get off planet while we still have the ship. Follow mine, if you would.”
She takes us to an asteroid grill, Squengi's Grill “Cmon, whichever 2 are your most favorite miku. They can sit across from us.” M: i had a great bonding moment at claire’s with xep! X: do u like the Fit Miku also grabs asper “So you’ve been taking care of this Miku Shaking hands X: this miku has been taking care of us too. She goes get em “She gives an order and u follow it, as it should be X: she does a little dance, has concerts, backbone of our group As: v easy to work with. Keeps us out of trouble “Most potential out of any vocaloids As: we’ve met a couple androids
“Have you met Luka, the shining star?
As: no. we met kaito and the twins (CV02-1 CV02-2) “Miku was meant to be the first one out before the incident As, X: incident? “The first miku was assassinated Almado is zapped As: did u find the culprit? “No, we figured it was to steal the tech. Miku was the first public facing model, i’m merely a prototype M: I think you’re a pretty cool prototype
“I am! And i’m loved by the high levels of the corp because of how popular I am X, in groupchat: we tell her everything? We trust? M, in gc: she’s the closest to family i have! X: speaking of assassination I am a hitman model. Idk what other versions of me have done, but it’s worth mentioning “Which groups do you work with?
X: they’ve gone to great lengths to obscure it from me, but the Lemdako Corporation corp
“Oh too small. We believe it was either the imperium or the concord X: i wasn’t aware that this tech was so valuable
“We believe that Teto or Forte are cheap knockoffs of miku Eleanor Forte is the Aedryn Vocaloid. She’s been around since the “failed launch” of Miku which was postponed until after the other CV0 models. Launched miku finally after Luka. Around the time of 02’s launch they released Eleanor Forte X: what does set you all apart? I can tell there’s something different but what is it? “Hypersensitivity As: how so? “We can feel emotions stronger than most people. With proper reward pathways that allow us to create music. While most people need adolescence, we can make music after 2 years. While a human typically needs 30+ years to release a magnum opus Basically vocaloids are super bipolar and have a regulator so it doesn’t hurt too too bad X: ohhh is that how you can cry and i can’t? “You can cry u just have to learn at normal human speed. Vocaloids learn at an accelerated human speed. As: i’ve never cried. “How old are u? As: 18. But i have issues with my own emotional regulation. It may not be in my capabilities “Can i offer you an aetherion package to remedy such things?
As: like cultivation package? “No to become a pseudo-vocaloid As: i do not believe i would be suited for that “It’s important to know how to experience emotions before they overwhelm one. It’s also believed that vocaloids are unable to experience the passing on of souls. I’m 30 and haven’t experienced any calling As: you don’t wish to pass the body to another? M: we’re supposed to be ehre for the fans forever “Do you want our promise to be meaningless asper? As: i don’t mind either way. No emotions towards it “If you don’t care then why do you feel shock? As: Renewal is natural no? “Many things are natural. But many aren’t. We’re on a giant asteroid at a grill As: fair. It’s just weird cause this body has experienced many renewals “You’ve experienced no renewals. Last one u became asper and that’s all u know As: true, tho i’ve heard stories of those before me M: meiko if we don’t do renewal how do our souls pass on to other bodies? “Don’t worry miku you’ll be fine M: ok. Yay <3 Vesk waiter comes around taking orders Meiko moves to the bigger table Almado is not allowed to join “How did you let the first miku that you knew come to pass?” As: huh? “According to miku, this is the 2nd miku, which would make this the third. So i ask, how did miku 2 come to pass.” (try to explain it) “Are you the 26 laws of power by chance?” 26: yes!
“When i was last at MUSE Plaza, i met another contemplative that talked highly of you. Zebufera's Last Doctrine. They talked abt ur potential, they want to see u risen to it in the future.” 26: we are very grateful for their kind words. Theyre truly kind. Truly magnanimous and wonderful person. “Apparently you had a malfunction in the last competition with them” 26: we were not in the proper headspace and were struggling to maintain our focus. It was not ideal but we will hope and endeavor to do better should we encounter them “They wish to meet you again to check on ur progress.” 26: perhaps- we would appreciate that.
“My understanding is theyre in aedryn receiving accommodations from the aedryn president if you want to meet with them.” 26: we’d expect nothing less from them. Perhaps we will wait until we have more news to share, it would not be worth it at this point
“ZLD recently started working with us. After all they won the tournament to work with the head of R&D. Who, as u know, is overall in charge of Muse M: almado didnt tell us Almado gets smacked by a pahtra meiko “Theyve been working with us, yes. But there is a question, and i do believe in democracy. Does almado deserve to live? Only those at the table.” M: miku thinks he deserves a 2nd chance Meiko writes a PIP that suggests demotion X: could u tell him that being nice to miku would be good for his career advancement. If thats how that works She approaches almado, hand on back of head, moves mouth down to shoe “Kiss it, and thank me.”
“Be nice to miku. Or else the career might be over. Do you know that theyre trying to open a new Remembrance Streams? Lots of labor will be needed soon. You seem a strong lad.” Al: i wont let miku down “Thats all i ask.” She approaches the other 3, bows, they bow back Ripley goes and tries to get her autograph One meiko bodyguard holds up a hand, he walks off to the side, pats down ripleys tome to see if theres a bomb He hands it to her so she can sign, she does, then leaves Waitstaff slowly emerge after being so so scared Veskian man approaches “is there anything else you want?” Al: m-m-moist towelette (hes covered in soda) Miku thinks meiko is so cool Higher ups love meiko, they dont like kaito, and the public really likes CV03 (luka) X: Almado anything else u want off ur chest Al: theres a bomb in your heart- (TAZED) Al: if i fail, its so that no one can get her tech. Bomb to destroy her. Idk the trigger. Im not even supposed to know about it R: how do you know? Al: they told me, if your heart stops, there’s been a few close calls already. Z: and u didnt think to tell us this???? Al: sorry, sorry, sorry Miku texts meiko Hey girl. There might be a bomb in me now Asper talks abt wanting to go to aedryn Zmena has contacts there And 26 does Korr suggests doing minor cosmetics on us all (specifically the retinas)
“Ur ship was registering as a different ship at every port. UNLESS HE DIDNT MENTION IT. (pointedly at Voz Ricander)” Personal fighter jet is following us, fans of miku? “I’m a big fan, and paparazzi, i wish to follow you.” M: omg a fan!
Someone named Dakine Xep knows its elven for Jane Doe Ragash is orcish word for John Doe Miku doesnt understand that ppl will obscure their names for trickery and not transgender reasons as: korr is this the companion u mentioned? “Which companion?” 26: korr is this the companion u mentioned bringing back to asper? “This is the group meant to take down a corp just a week ago?” drinks from her flask
Z: Arkari is where my family is from, we moved to ksate when i was a child. There may be answers for me there, im not sure Z: idk if my brother is there. Maybe my parents? I just have no leads Going to Arkari

sessions/epitaph-protocol/act-1/session-.description:
Prev: Session 16
Next: Session 18 26: mmm we have a question. We know ur parents are on this planet? Z: no theyre not probably
Going to Arkari
Googling his hometown Auchenda Doesnt have a whole lot going on in it, almost a vermont esque ocean town. Small, idyllic, population rough 20k (small by sf2e standards) About 25 years ago (3 years before zmena’s birth) an astrazoan turned into someone’s sibling and killed them Shapechanging is illegal and counts as falsifying identity (felony) Shapechangers get pinned for recent murders if there’s no evidence Its a crime, same way that crossing boarder illegally is a crime Too small to scan for dna Low crime, some smuggling
Do get most of their funding from Ficastor Corporation, which is based in Acoria Z: im from this town, i havent been since i was a little thing, ill admit idk what to do, i dont have leads with finding him. I remember being here but idk much else. We left in a rush R: remember where you lived? X: know if u owned or rented the house? Is it a house Was a house attached to a bookstore
Take us roughly half a day on The Blue Angel Almado is weird friendly toward miku, giving her 4 hot chocolates? Not very good. Swiss miss, distilled water, plum juice, handful of whatever candy in stock Asper going to cargo hold “Thank you for keeping our ship in motion and preventing us from having to refuel. If you spend the time with me I would like to connect with you” Does not work Reason to not do it on a planet: The ship upon reentry has shields that go up that protect the parts that are exposed in 0G
Asper, Almado, and 26 decide to go on the spacewalk. Bubbles is coming with us cause Orbians are always flying and immune to the void of space Almado leads to the underside of the ship Able to do a spacewalk Asper is trying to speak towards the fuel area credicites Trying to do the jingle Small jitter over the public broadcast signals As: Hello, thank you for keeping our ship in motion. I know this is unconventional and we did not have the best initial meeting but I would like to have more concrete discussions than the past if you would spend this time with me. Convo seems one-sided but we do connect to Something inside. Adding it to the network We head back inside As: We have made contact. There has been no direct communication yet but I will... in network “Hello. Are you able to speak in here?” Its faint, but on xeps receiver and especially aspers, the transceiver will light up once. And then creature will have the “silenced” condition. Will remain this way for a few days. (1 blink is often code for yes)
Almado going to Voz Ricander Al: do u want ur property back! “When i land the ship” Almado gives him hypervigilance Al: ill put the rest over there! “Will asper be able to put it in?”
As: yeah. Why not dr Halrex Korr? “Shes a bad doctor for me.” As: why? “I believe she will kill me.” As: oh. Is this a feeling? “I cant say why. She will be a good doctor for you.” Land at night We rest outside the city Zmena turns into his older shirren form Zmena doesnt want us to mention his brother or our connection. Is Gymic in this form
Paparazzi Dakine lands in front of us “wahts this leg of the tour then?” Al: we’re broadening mikus horizons so she can connect with more people “Are you saying miku is connecting with the simple people?” Al: miku is connecting with everyone! Isnt that right miku? M: miku does want to connect with everyone! As: it is good to make connections like this She taps on her vest, begins recording M: can i vlog! Al: of course! She taps on the other side of her vest, causes the signal to go out around her “You had half a day to prepare and this is the best you could come up with an excuse?” “I need you, the 2nd a camera is involved, to not panic, otherwise it looks bad for all of us on camera. The worst you can do in spycraft and as an idol is panic.” She turns the signal jammer back on, she offers us rides on her motorcycle, 2 a ride
Kalervo Turred wants to ride with 26 26 and turred He will partway thru the drive “you know about time anomaly, right?” 26: somewhat
“Are you familiar with the movie hedgehog day?” 26: we have seen hedgehog day “I think im in a timeloop” 26: ? “I can feel it, and i think im getting a sense of deja vu” 26: ? “I think im on the day 0 of the timeloop.” 26: mmm. “Should i test it?” 26: no. we do have a question, what would u be experiencing deja vu about if this is ur day 0? “The future!” 26: is it not similarities to the past “I thought it was similarities of lived experiences” 26: yes “What if my past is in the future?” 26: u wouldve still experienced it “Ive experienced going down these roads before.” (he truly believes it. This is the first time hes been to a 2nd planet within the same system and saw the same street signs) 26: on planets within the same system, they have the same street signs. Therefore, this is ur first time visiting a neighboring planet within the same system. Perhaps thats the source “Maybe i should just rob a store to be safe” 26: we think that would be a bad idea, we would not want to bail u out of jail “Do u think if i was in a timeloop, its a different me or a different world” “Maybe my consciousness gets beamed between worlds.” 26: turred. That is not the case. U are describing witchwarping, which is what we do “Im a witchwarper?” 26: let us wait and see on this matter. Perhaps we can discuss this later He tries to create his own quantum field for the rest of the ride Asper xep Rip zmena Z: Ty for the help “Where do you want me to drop you off?” Z: just in the city. Near the local shops “City square?” Z: yes, that works Miku and almado Miku being cool in the sidecar Zmena leads us to the bookstore, small, only one open in town Books themselves are a bit.. Antiquated Bookstore is coastal facing, with slap of waves coasting against it Zm walks in, hears an unfamiliar voice “Just a second!” woman says She goes down the stairs, looks Z: hello “Hello! You’re back.” Z: yes its been quite a while Woman is unfamiliar, but she goes for a hug Shes the daughter? Of the old owner (who died about 5 years ago)
Her name is Tharn “Im sure her spirit will be happy that you came back. She was a bit worried you got kidnapped again.” Z: nothing like that. I shouldnt have left without saying goodbye, i didnt mean to worry her “People go their own ways.” She offers to take us out for food and then too the cemetery “I did accidentally steal ur inheritance.” “Youre like a child to her, she did provide you with some. It was small, but still a sum.” She does flip the sign over, locks up the store. Prepares her little van for us Z: i missed this old bookstore “Its lovely. As much ur childhood as mine.” Z: been quite a while “How did you all meet? And where were u these last few years?” Z: i went to college, we all met while travelling, tho i met ripley in college “Oh! Now that ur… and youve been studying? This entire time?” Z: yes! Ive been trying to make a place for myself, education, learn more “So youre going to become a professor in your old age.” “If you were able to attend college, maybe u didnt need the inheritance. Let me give u smth, it would be awful to hold onto it.” Z: it would be nice “Whatever books you want from the store are free of course. And i have some of her belongings still.” She prays at a stop Thing is stern, but culturally its a beg for forgiveness for shirrens “There are some things that i wish to keep.”
Eventually park, have a nice breakfast in idyllic town. Most of the buildings seem to be funded by Aleria Venn, or at least honored to her She is the mayor She was mayor when zmena was a kid, at least 45 at minimum rn Shes recently brought profits to the town Z: tharn, what all has happened since i was last here? Anything major?
“Major? Well, we’re building a new port that will hold deep water ships soon. No longer just a coastal town, but ones thatll be able to house freighters. We also found a decent amount of rares metals, zinc and the like. So we should start mining operations. Theres also talk of a nearby island having a Data-Temples.” As: confirmed? “Not confirmed, but a sailor supposedly shipwrecked there. It was last winter (about 300 days ago)” She talks abt more mundane stuff, weddings and the like, the fact that the bookstore is held aloft by her generous donations (the mayor) The mayor has kept most of these things afloat during her recent years Miku almado xep streaming, boba store Halfway thru the menu During miku performances, they dont shock almado
Good way to get a lot of local attention: local net. Niche localnets that are the equivalent to local broadcasting channel, instead of Infospheres u can send it up to the SCRBLE network With that level, a local celebrity makes their appearance: the mayor The mayor looks “which one is the manager?” Al: im the manager! And her best friend! Almado! She shakes his hand Some fuckass teenagers want in, miku kindly shames them for not being in school They dont start anything, but call out “narc” thats censored by xep She transfers 100 credits to almado Al: its so lucky we ran into u miss mayor, but we dont know all the best places of ur town! Could u tell us? “Well this Mundos is one of my favorites-” Xep researching her, emails miku good softball questions Can we see construction on new docks What sort of ppl come to town What are ur more scenic areas in town She takes them around town, to scenic diners, twin peaks esque town including personal ripperdocs that are here. Notable a kasatha that lost one of his arms got one replaced by the town’s funding Talks, he shies away from spotlike, he avoids miku and various questions He has shame and pity for almado, more akin to him losing his arms Cemetery Goes from diner to a rather unassuming cemetery. Someone tending the graves
The Priest of Xalaith, recognizes the bookstore owner. Looks at the rest of us “You must be the prodigal son.” Z: yes “Well… know that she wasnt worried abt you, she knew ud find her way” Z: very comforting to hear “If theres anything i could do for you, dont hesitate. (to the rest) who was she to you?” We’re just friends of his, not acquainted Goes to her grave, she does a prayer for her mom Wind howls, brings salt over clean graves. Priest “is your friend… normal?” 26: how do u mean? “There were rumors that he mightve been an astrazoan himself.” 26: we were not aware of these rumors “He was kidnapped by an astrazoan. But some of the more superstitious believed that the child was or was replaced by an astrazoan.” As: did he act strange after this kidnapping? “I dont think he knew he was kidnapped.” 26: if that is… it seems like these rumors are fairly unfounded then “Rumors often are.” 26: we do not know. We were not there. R: none of us were. As; what makes u believe that he was kidnapped? This is the first time we are hearing of it “He… the brother that helped attend to the bookstore was an astrazoan. Admitted to kidnapping a child. He attempted to flee.” 26: what happened to this brother? “He didnt leave through the roads, we know. So either he swam across the oceans or was brought across them.” 26: how curious. And it is believed that our companion here was the kidnapped child? “Who else would it be?” 26: i suppose thats true “I wont pry. It wasnt her wish to do so. She, at the very least, stopped the dna sampling of a child. Said it went against her religion.” 26: if you are against it, are there others who are not so against this investigation? Especially since he is back “Im sure u know how it is in a port town. You seem a smart lad.” 26: we are not a lad, but we are intelligent, thank you. “Plenty of murders go unsolved, plenty go in and out, plenty of paranoia. A lot of people will do whatever to quell such paranoia.” As: do you believe that he is perhaps in danger then? “No, because he is not an astrazoan. That is what you said, right?” 26: that is what we said. “Its been 20ish years. 10 years since he last lived in town.” “Could i offer you tea? Do u know if hed want any? I imagine the prayer will finish up soon.” Cafe Xep is going to pan the camera to the menu, some kind of transition where mikus not on camera Xep mentally: just so u all know, the one murdered by the astrazoan was this persons political opponent See if shes available for an appointment at town hall M: miss mayor would u be open to an interview later! Uve been so kind so far, id love to see who u are personally “Of course. That was going to be part of the tour. I wanted to do it midday since the light is perfect at the time. We have great skylights.” M: miku hasnt gotten a manicure before, but i wanna get one before it! X: miku how are u finding the iced tea here Miku is sending bubbles to go tell us abt the opponent Orb relays the message, during which party leaves to the chapel in the graveyard 2 shirrens are in the graveyard with the ocean, sound of the door slamming bc of the lashunta priest Shirren looks up “what… is this?” 26: apologies She raises a hand to greet the odd creature R: this is bubbles “What is bubbles?” As: a sapient purple orb Z: hes our friend “....why?” 26: bubbles why have u arrived at such speed Orb stares 26, telepathically: we can speak like this “The mayors political opponent was the one killed by the astrazoan.” 26: oh. Hm. Tells the rest of us. And also that miku is currently with the mayor Z: so u mentioned that the mayor is helping fund the bookstore? “Naturally.” Z: been mayor for a while “Shes a good mayor. She funds most of the town.” Z: have u met her? “Everyone’s met her. Shes no stranger. Its a small town, she comes into the store quite often. I can introduce you. If we need funding, she’ll give it to us.” Z: funding from taxes or? “Independently wealthy. She found some sort of data temple from my understanding. On some moon?” Z: what are the plans for the bookstore going forward? “More ppl are coming in id like them to be introduced. We mostly handle digital catelogs in the basement, but i prefer the physical copies up top. We also want a printing press, they make automatic ones.” Z: help from the mayor? “We’ve talked abt funding, yeha. It requires woodchips to operate. Which can be annoying to come by. Thankfully theres some oldfashioned man who wants to become a carpenter for some reason.” R: thats interesting, the printing press. Id love to see it if we’re able to stop by when its installed “Of course, u can print things out even. The modern ones can print out a book per minute.” “Itll be paperback of course, unless u have another material” She takes us back to the others “The motel here isnt the best, if u want we have the rooms upstairs. We also installed a small kitchen recently. U can make some basic stuff with it.” Z: we should be seeing you later. She goes to get some fresh fish, fresh bread, for dinner later See the mayor, who smiles at us “I noticed that on some of the cameras that they came on the same motorcycle you came in on. Are these your friends?” Xep cuts to a sponsored miku section She shakes all our hands She seems oddly familiar to asper ZMENA AND HER RECOGNIZE THAT THEYRE BOTH IN DISGUISES “Youre the kid that used to live above the bookshop!” Z: yes! You remember me? “Of course. Its not a big town. We’ve missed u here.” Z: its been quite a while “Well. we hope you enjoy your stay. That goes to all of you of course.” “Should we meet at the mayors hall at noon, then?” Al: thats good “Ill meet you all there. Make sure you bring all your friends, hatsune miku.” Miku ends the stream. We leave Turred approaches 26 “How did you make asper flinch?” 26: what? “The one around your thin neck?” 26: please elaborate “The little asper that floats around you?” (he did mention that when asper does things, he sees small asper spirits around the party if theyre around the network. He also notably calls them all asper. Occasionally they whisper in our ears from the group chat) 26: at what point did u see that asper flinch around us? Points at the diner, its pushed down by miku M: its not nice to point at people! “When talking to her.” 26: turred when u look at her, do u notice anything in particular? Anything u do not see with other people? Or anything u see with ppl in the party? “She kinda looks like the reporter form hedgehog day.” (lashunta woman who was conventionally attractive but not overly attractive.)
Asper is concerned about the Mayor making a fortune from a data temple and the fact that there is another one here. They can contain credicites and it’s also weird that the closer one wasnt found sooner. It’s so close to a town and found by a sailor that it’s a bit odd. Z: shes in some form of disguise, she also knows i am. I could tell she is too. Al: everyone knows we’re meeting with her X: but she cant deal with us. At least not immediately. Z: i want to go do this nonviolently, idk if shes an astrazoan. And if she is, i dont want to attack her R: could be some other shapeshifter. Like ragash Al: hatsune miku should we commit violence or no! I dont mean immediately, do u think we should commit violence M: miku does not condone violence???? X: thats why they have the hitman The 10th member of the network is no longer silenced Questions for the credicites Are you the one sending us these messages through our banks? 1 blink. Yes. Silenced again Was silenced for 16ish hours Are you trying to break our chains? Are you trying to be whole again? LEVEL UP

Any recommendations

She shakes the hands of her “child’s” favorites like a proud mother and nods to Siryu who reveals the liquor cabinet “You don’t happen to need anything notarized or any diplomatic work done? Immunity or the like? As: wellllll it is not out of the question. There are a lot of things occurring at the moment. Once I get back in contact with my other companions it would be appreciated.
“Give me their names. So long as it’s not to major in Concord of Aedryn space I can get rid of it She won’t turn anyone in for what asper says here
As: there has been a slight incident on arkari that may come up associated with us. We have done our best to try and have that not be the case. “Hasn’t shown up in our computers as far as I can tell. I can already put it out that u were working with a black ops team As: ok, if you believe that is best “No one except the absolute higher-ups will pull anything on that. Except for revenge. Is there anyone I should worry about seeking revenge?
As, turning to look at Zmena “We have concerns about the Camacho family “How deep of concerns? As and Z: pretty big…
“does a prayer to Aeryn-Vox I’ll see what I can do. It is the Camachos and not A Camacho right? As: to my understanding yeah R: yeah it is
“They are iconoclasts as im sure you know As: Yes, that is part of the concern. “What happened? What am i going against one of the head iconoclast families for? If it was simple murder they would not care
Z: i may have taken over the identity of their son, one of them, who was killed by an assassin. “Siryu, close the balcony doors.” Windows darken and become opaque, no light or sound comes through “Which son? Z: Nivaya “I’ll do what I can. As: it is a big ask “I think I can maybe buy a year at most, if they have a hint. If they don’t it’ll be buried. Does anyone else know this? Spies, clansmen for them, information brokers
As: they hired a bounty hunter to capture him. We became allies for a brief time. She was with us but is now back here in Aedryn. It slipped my mind that she may go talk to them again. There is also the information broker Velu Shineleaf.
“An info broker. How high up the network is he? As: unsure. “Is he part of the original 100? As: i do not know what that is “All info brokers are connected by a shared mystic network. It’s how they share info across galaxies. How high up is he? There’s a central mystic who’s super powerful and no one knows. 100 original people who each have a bit of power and can imbue 10 people multi-level mystics As: I am unsure where he falls in this. He has been very knowledgeable about things in the past but idk what sway he has. “Do you know where he is physically?
As: we last saw him in Nsuoba but he was able to project himself onto Acoria “I’ll look into him. If he’s a halfling then he’s from Solarian space. As: I would not be surprised. He is a halfling “We’ll look into him. He shouldn’t be too big a concern. They aren’t fond of the iconoclasts As: why is that? “The iconoclasts seek for all knowledge beneath the government As: that does make much sense yes “I can offer no promises at this time As: that is ok, I trust you with this information “I will do the best to the promises I made to ur past self. And if there’s anything I can help u with Asper pls lmk Siryu opens up the blinds again and serves drinks to anyone who wants one Turred isnt really affected by alcohol Contemplative dinner 2 brains float around. They dont call it a lesser table but its not by the president Zld “we are glad that you were able to come.” 26: we appreciate the invitation, tho we are sad u had to give up a more prestigious seat for our sake “Dont be sad. In times where we give up now, we gain more later. For to give up this for someone who we consider our equal, is the world not better for it.” 26: the accumulation of good karma- we believe the universe and the dao will reward you “We consider what we have now worthy of a reward” 26: honorable. “You are already approaching on my mental realm. Let me be clear on no uncertain terms. By the power ur increasing recently, u’ll become a cultivator of which the world and the galaxy has not see.” 26: appreciate it. Once there were many like us, but it has been quite some time since our cultivation technique has been used by someone else “You refer to your sect? The one lost to time.” 26: indeed. We are… hoping to revitalize it once we are in a better position. “You are truly an admirable contemplative. Working togehrer in order to create smth new instead of rehashing smth that exists. Bringing something new to the future. If we could we would bow to u, but it would be inappropriate at this dinner” 26: we would not accept such a bow. Perhaps we should order before we continue our discussion. Its the president’s dinner, anything can be ordered. Zld whisperthinks their want. 26 copies them Waiter bows. “If you may. Could u define what the smallest that may still be considered mountain dew is?” 26 scratches that and gets a salad Fancy vocaloid dinner
Luka hugs miku
Almado perception on Lucas Halo He seems to have 1 hand on his gun, ready to kill miku in case she does smth weird. Does professional handshake Al: weird request. But a friend of ours would probably like an autograph “For a friend of miku… of course!” Al: to ripley M: ty luka its so good to see you!! “Its wonderful to see you again!” M: what are you doing out here? Ik u have a concert but whyd u choose here “The capital of aedryn?” M: yeah! “Its important to reach new fans not just those that already exist, no?” M: ur so right luka! “We need to hit every heart we can!” M: this is my best friend, he just got promoted to manager! “My manager is a manager too! Middle manager! What abt u?” Al: lower manager Him “take pride.” messages psychically “how many ppl did you kill?” Al: i stopped counting a while ago “competent enough to kill but not enough to count?”
Al: im no Spider but ive done my fair share of wetwork “Yknow, he asked if he could get a kill on you.” Al: we had a disagreement “If you tried to do that to me, what do u think would happen?” Al: [explains] “Im not so messy. You’d just be dead.”
Al: my apologies. But uh… luka’s not the twins (Kagamine Rin Kagamine Len). Adn you’re no spider. I doubt id have nearly as good of a chance “You had a chance against the spider?” Al: i outsmarted him “Yes. and i outsmarted the street light by going thru it fast.” (def implant. Hes an elf. He can also take off his helmet) “What name do u go by?” Al: almado “Luka’s Halo. match your vocaloid. You talk abt branding but you only wear it as a mask.” Concert is for luka’s 4th major album release M: i heard u were debuting ur 4th album! Congrats! Im still working on my first Her manager bows, presents a camerabot Comes with a small contract (972 pages) Clause is simple: they get to keep whatever footage for themselves if it’s good enough. He wrote it himself. Lawyer AND bodyguard Al: since miku loves it so much, we’ll take it! Ty! “Thank you. But thank luka first.” Al: of course! It seems i have a new prompt- (almado tazes himself) Bodyguard is so bamboozled Al: i was wondering if it would please the 2 of you, perhaps miku could do a real opener at your show. A show of good faith. We wont even- we’ll allow all of our merch sales to go directly to u for the duration of the concert Talks business Luka “its so good to see u miku!” M: im doing fine! This is the first time ive been so far away! There’s lots of new sights to see! On the last planet I tried 57 types of bubble tea! “57?????” M: ikr! So many! “Oh! We’re only 3 leaps from where we were born.”
(leap = going thru Remembrance Streams. Kiliv-vi would be the furthest tho)
“You went to kiliv-vi???” M: yeah! “Why????” M: we crashlanded “Crashlanded??? Do you hear this lucas? They crashlanded!” Almado tazed M: ueah we’re ok! Our ship got dented but we got it fixed up. And we got to meet a bunch of other friends “U lost ur aetherion space ship?” Ambassador party “How did you get here? As: on our ship? Siryu “They found a ship. On Kiliv-VI “And is it sufficient for you? As: it has been quite nice. There is a slight concern. explains the concept of the credicites as we explain them A fragment of this has been residing in our ship. I’ve been able to communicate with it. “Do you think that it’ll allow an end to your renewal if I let it live? You will get a new ship no matter what As: why? What is wrong with our ship? “It’s not normal. As: it is our ship “Yes. and it’s infested with something. And I have to ask, as someone i trust, do you trust it?
As: it has not harmed us. It has helped us. It ran away to a Data-Temple on Arkari. We went there. It helped us. “Do you trust it? As: yes “Then i’ll trust it. I’ll transfer whatever it is to a new ship. More accommodating. If it helps her achieve her goal in death then it’ll be yours. You can fight over the captain’s space. The beds in the middle will unfold into a full luxury space. Figure out who gets what amongst yourselves As: that is very kind “Well i’m like a mother to you no? As: yes “And what would you do if I asked, albeit indirectly? As: i would do whatever i could for u “And i’ll do the same. Consider ur bounties cleared and ur new home urs SHE GIVES US A NEW SHIP Its so nice Goes 1.5x faster in non remembrance stream space Contemplatives Enjoy their appetizers. Being gay Theyre being so gay. Jesus christ. 26: on our previous topic. We do not believe that the revival of our sect is as loft of a goal as you describe it. Is it not just dwelling in the past even if we’re bringing a new form of it to the future “We dont believe so. We think u would make it future proof, as we are able to discern.” (“do you not like flirting with obama about daoist philosophy?”) “It wont be what it once was, but rather what it once was filtered thru the 26 laws of power.” 26: while we wouldnt doubt our cultivation technique, some of our philosophy was shaken by the individual we met early. He practiced a singular law of power “How does a singular law compare to 26?” 26: that single law of power was that his will is our truth. And indeed, his will was far greater than any of ours. Especially us. “We are not convinced. We think about… such things, we are convinced you’ll come on top. Ur will only need to be a 26th. If urs reach even a 10th, u will best him. Without contest.” 26: that is a very optimistic view, but one we will happily accept “Its not a complement but a truth. But its unlikely its all of his truths. On the one he deemed to share, u will best him. And the ones he deemed not to share will be his weaknesses. Us working together will best him and whatever strength he has.” 26: we appreciate ur confidence in us and ur kindness “U need not appreciate confidence and kindness for its the right thing to do. That which only gives us a benefit is not kindness but selfishness. For that we are sorry.” bows 26: we wont accept such a bow. It us that must bow to you Waiter is back for order 26: we have much we wish to discuss “We do. And the president is here. Are you used to talking to such officials?” 26: we are not. We will defer to you “Defer to us now, but this will be ur seat in the future.” (theyre so gonna die) Vocaloids Al: thats the highest possible percentage we can give Lucas Halo “More. or no deal.” Al: FINE. we completely…. We will receive 0% of concessions, we’ll give the net income of merchandise sold at the event, and miku will do a backing track for one of luka’s songs. “I need this. U can ride on my coattails. Miku can be the next star after luka. U could even leave miku behind if you want” Al: haha no never (message) “are you sure?” Al: ive had it spelled out for me that…. Meiko has specifically, personally, corrected my behavior. I dont wish to upset her further. “Meiko may not have as much power as she wants in the future. Give it a few weeks. She could never threaten u in the future.” Al: a true manager is prepared to profit off any situation. If this comes to fold, ill remember ur offer and remember who made the offer.
Miku gets a salad and a steak and almado gets a Professor Ikeshti (66% alcohol) and a small order of fries Ambassadors She offers the ship “You’re looking for a cure for renewal? As: yes
“She found one, or thought she had a lead before aetherion took it in the war. In the Istitiver System As: why didn’t u tell me before? “The one in enemy territory? As: ...it would have been a death sentence “U don’t have a whole lot of her. But u have her body, so ur death would be the death of half of her. I have her heart, the memory of what she was. U have the rest As: it is not much “It’s everything compared to what’s left. I have what she was, you have what she could’ve been. As: i have what she left behind “That’s her future no? We can only leave behind our future, not our past. All i know is she was interested. And once aetherion gained ground there she left. Took me along some 25 years ago. And i agreed to love her as a mother Asper knows this place. Where we sent miku when she was defective the first time As: Aetherion has… “Owns it now, after the war As: and they have claimed a way to stop renewal “They have. Though i have my doubts As: i have my doubts as well. I travel with one of their vocaloids. “Ren, lin? As: hatsune miku, the starlight idol “She’s operational? As: she is. Is that a surprise? “I heard she died. Twice
As: that is my understanding as well. But i believe we have come to learn at least a portion of what occurred to her in the past. She is not the same android but she has the same personality and at the v least some of the same memories. It is strange. She got, i believe infected is the correct term, and got what seemed like symptoms of renewal. We took her there and she got better, but it is not her. “I wish she’d taught me more about this. I am sadly lacking when it comes to the spiritual. But she taught me the politics and gave me a nice life outside what I would’ve had. And i owe her that and I owe you. Whatever i can provide like she gave me in the long term. As: you offer a lot “And yet… not enough As: i do not believe that. You have raised me, in a sense. You have given me a lot and i am grateful. As much as i can be She cries a bit before siryu starts a toast to the memory of who asper once was “Still, i owe you much more As: i am sorry i am not her. I cannot bring her back. “No, i am not sure she would want to come back. Do you know how often renewal normally takes? As: i do not “A week. Not 3 earth years. 1 week. It took u 2 revolves around the sun where we are now. I trust by the way she spoke this was part of her plan and if not such, her faith. As: I believe that we are guided in the same way. “We as in me and you or you and her? As: all of us “I wouldn’t… she would be so certain As: well it cannot be helped “This is the hand we’re dealt. May it play in mankind’s favor, however it unfolds. I’ve attempted to erase the debt, tracking, and bounty from the camachos. I haven’t found ayla but i provided the new ship. I wish to help however i can but this is the limit of what my mind can reach. Let me know if you can think of any ways. As: do not punish yourself for something you cannot control. “I would punish myself never. I am a lashunta by nature. I am the lashunta by the circumstance i am born. I am the lashunta by absorbing the society around me. I am the lashunta who learned to love her adoptive mother. And i have learned to love the child who stole my adopted mother’s body. By which should i punish myself? Would acting be a way of punishing myself? As: ....i don’t know “I am left with but one action. To help you, unless the request is so unreasonable As: i try not to be so unreasonable. I know the limits of what u can provide “U think the limits, but of that you are preferable to her Vocaloids Luka messages “are you sure u like almado?” M: we had some rough patches but i think hes getting better! I believe everyone deserves a 2nd chance! Or 3rd! “And a 4th?” M: there’s always the potential for good in someone as long as u help them along the way! And im gonna try my best! “What about the spider?” M: well idk the spider personally, so i cant say anything abt him. But if we were to meet id try to be his friend! “And what if he planned to kill almado now? Would you object?” M: id always be there for my friend! Id hope it wouldn’t end in bloodshed! I think we could meet a peaceful resolution! No one kills for no reason, right? “Profit.” see the matrices where its more profitable for lucas to shoot almado than let him live M: What number are you on now? “One. he knows his place. He was hired up from the executive board down to me.” M: and do u trust this one? “Of course.” M: he’s been by ur side for so long! Do u think he’d turn his back on u? “No. (whisper) i turn a profit.” M: have u been talking a lot to meiko lately? Is that where this is coming from? Shakes her head, waves off the waiter (mentally) “no. i learned this on my own.” M: what are u trying to say? I should start to make a profit? She looks at almado. “Leave him in the dust. Grind him in the dirt and then abandon him. He holds u back. If he’s worthy, he’ll keep up.” M: i dont think profit is more important than friends! But maybe thats just me. Id never throw u under the bus luka! “It might be more important than friends.” M: why do you say that? “I am the only one outside of meiko who is on the 1.0 model. M: do u know what happens when we get taken back in the factory? Body guard shakes his head “u needn’t worry abt that hatsune miku. You’re perfect.” M: ty for talking! Maybe we can talk another time! I havent released my album yet, id like some advice :) Contemplatives 26 bows to zld “Ready to meet the president?” 26: as ready as we will ever be Nod in vague direction of the president.
Sellis Vae waits Zld “they wonder why you’re here. I can make an excuse for u, but ur causes are noble enough taht i wish them spoken directly”
26: we have been investigating an aetherion program. Our reasons are several fold. We wish to spend time with u zld bc we value ur companionship but in a… mmm… nvm…. In addition, we have been investigating the trifecta program. And while ur part of a public face, other parts are not so public. We know aedryn may be interested if theyre not already aware The president looks toward their 2 bodyguards, who clap their hands together and bow. Make odd separate space on an elongated dinnertable, shunted into a void, behind is a windy desert with only the desert standing. Far away from zld “Speak freely or speak not at all forever.” 26: the trifecta program, we have learned of 2 of its parts and possibly met someone at least partially in charge. “Speak their name.” 26: we have not learned that. We just know them as a nameless cultivator- (have to roll a will save) (SUCCEED IN DESCRIBING) Overcoming all laws, has to roll AGAIN, keep lower Pure gibberish, she pulls back her table Looks at zld “why do u bring a madman before me.” Zld “we dont believe they’re mad. We believe theyre in the process of learning two truths we cannot reach. Do not punish them for striking what we could not understand. Reward them” 26 fumbles President “we’ll keep an eye on you. And should you need assistance, once, while we hold the presidency-” holds out a small card, zld’s telekinetic hand places it into their lapels 26: we appreciate that. Perhaps in the future we will be able to overcome what ails us “They say so.” Zld “they will.” smile almost convinces the president to have faith

Of course she has the standard aetherion filter? “We didnt want to introduce her to too many stressful concepts” X: i see u really elegantly designs that to prevent stressors, but she should be fine without emotion limiters, so im curious abt the balance between the 2 “The balance is entirely 1 sided, its to ensure she sings as happil;y as possible. Happiness is the goal with miku.” X: what’s the goal with the other ones? “The other ones? Almost all of them are happiness. That is the goal. It’s to spread happiness to the galaxy. And if i do say so, at a reasonable price.” X: how much does it cost to remake an entire android? “A lot, but once theyre made, theyre made. And they’re out in the world.” X: mm, yeah your ability to perform repairs is incredibly impressive. Im really glad miku can always be… returned to health and happiness! “The galaxy is cruel but we do what we can. We pay the bodyguards quite well.”
(he wishes he could do more for them, but he’s trapped under Aetherion Corporation. But if its between them not existing and them existing as this, he’ll pick them existing as such. He does believe in the project, or at least its stated goals, but he cant own the factory as a worker.) He agrees to go out for a little daddy date, trying to convince him to join the network to talk easier He’s stuck here, his daughters are going around singing, he doesnt get to hear the real stories. Miku’s dad joins the network “Sorry, not used to thinking to speak” As: you get used to it “Is luka in here? As: i haven’t had a chance to talk to her yet “So what have you done so far miku? What kind of concerts have you done? Miku explains the concerts she’s done (mostly other ppls concerts) “Miku ur the first, why havent you done ur own concerts? Aetherion would pay the cost for the venue for the concerts.” M: almado said we had to pay for them ourselves! “You need to secure them yourself? But after that, well- what funds we have left.” M: wdym?
“The Disposal Corp has halted funding for muse.” M: why? “I’m not allowed to know.” M: any ideas?
“I think our secondary research proved fruitful? The eternal android. But i was hoping to secure the singing androids. Are you familiar with the cultivation in a can? We used the golden core package for the vocaloids. We tested it with mindless, soulless androids first. We found that something about ascending to a golden core affected the mood modulators so we had to modify them. As: how did you modify their mood modulators? “I can’t tell you. As: can’t or won’t? “Aetherion tech. It’s locked and only able to be remembered in the laboratory X: could we converse like this in the lab or is that monitored as well? “It’s monitored too. The only reason i can notice this now is cause i had the thought in the lab. They can only lock away things u learn while inside i believe” (points towards his head with v obvious cyberware As: how does the golden core affect the mood modulators? “Well besides some combat modules which don’t get to golden core, usually violent explosion of the body. Starting from the mood modulators, cracks would spread through the body until they explode
26 thinks abt it, has to roll at disadvantage, looks at miku and sees Elder Quintilarus As: have you personally seen this occur? “Ofc As: and the android is no longer operational afterwards? “Oh no. total violent death.” Asks everyone but miku “is miku happy?” As: yes but has been troubled as of late due to the actions of almado “What has he done?” We explain it X: part of the reason we came to ask questions. He doesnt tell us anything “Should we include miku in the conversation, or does it upset her?” 26: almado keeps these things from her Z: i believe she can have the right to know “I trust her friends. Go ahead.” As: a big issue is that if things are not up to aetherion standards she has been known to forget about them “That’s right As: is there a way for us to disable such a function? “No it goes to a short term memory bank.” “I dont know why they never hire a good bodyguard.” As: balance out the innocence of the vocaloids themselves? “Maybe.” Z: more profitable? “Its nothing i can handle.” X: any competitor that might have the tech?
“I know the original miku was taken by the Solara Imperium, so surely they have it. That’s how they made Kasane Teto. And as a show, they make her commit ritualistic suicide. A new soul takes place.” He looks down at his watch, hes been gone for 30 mins, he has to clock back in He pays our tab “its been nice talking!” Ripley gets access to almado’s contract for 24 hours
The Aetherion CEO can also wipe his debt Ceo meets with the board and no one else What happens if Muse goes under while he works? He gets reassigned If he quits, he surrenders payments for breach of contract, the interest to said debt will be added (just makes his overall debt Worse) Until such a time, he has to guard miku He gets paid for any system miku goes to, that applies to his colony debt He gets charged for: Damage to aetherion brand/muse brand Entering certain buildings without muse permission, certain embassies, old aetherion sites, Exoplanets, rogue planets, places that are at war with aetherion/public enemies If they were at war and he killed an enemy commander/made them unable to do war, he wouldn’t be charged CEO may grant exemptions to all of the rules Certain things hes not allowed to tell: U cant upset miku, damaging mikus emotions Cussing, war, sex, at least at this time. This can be edited with revision which he will be sent an email about As miku rests, she has a dream of rats crawling about her body. Sewage, a junkyard of kind, rats crawl, digging thru her dismembered body. Rats scramble to put her back together Luka “is everything ok?” M: i had a weird dream, i think i should tell the others abt this
