Next: Session 3 News
Solaran Emperor has put reward of 10k credits minimum for the deaths of any immortals killed to fulfill a citizens sacrifice! Citizen and status of scar not verified. Immortality of sacrificed individuals will be! The hyperrail cars will be outfitted with temporal sentry turrets. Riders are advised against doing violence as they are programmed to target those who fire first and fare evaders
Voquari Ascendant Yarveinthi the Golden has been spotted outside Tse and Ifont dragging people into the burning sun. satellite imagery has shown mass corpses posed to point into the light Water treatment handled by nanomachines that cling to dirt and boil water. Citizens are advised to not fall into the treatment plants due to their sensors not being able to tell living flesh from contaminating material
Security: Aetherion Corporation has started offering higher tier weapons to those who can pay beyond prev legal limit Technomancer gang said to be behind [error: data corrupted]
Checking on the other bodies Suimin, Denpakant All killings are consistent 1, taller, resisted the poison and got into a fight. Person got a few blows on the attacker but eventually succumbed All vents tampered with Lashunta man also at the scene “Who are you?” Neighbors “I see. Friends with the woman?” I: we all know where we were at the place of the crime even tho we hadnt spoken much before “Might i ask why you give a shit?” I: i dont want to be murdered. And i’m really curious Ko: i dont but these guys are fun I: shut the fuck up! We gamers gotta stick togehter S: this is part of my job “There’s one good excuse. Would a serial killer be so bad in a world such as now.” I: yes! “Why???” I: everyone deserves to live and they died painfully S: an excess of murders mean there are less people when the next scarring happens He pulls out a notebook “you dont happen to be aetherion do you” S: i am! “Have they been taking proper tally of their dead?” S: indeed they have (debts are sent to the next of kin) “Can i get access?” S: i can put in a request, who are u “I’m part of the census bureau” (hard to verify, very much gives you a reason to go to any place) Konbini analyze target Missing fingerprints on right, but able to get ones on his left Tall 6’2” when not slouched Has a few implants, autorecognition lenses and enhancements that let u move faster Theoretically lashunta that can do slight mind reading H: any id? He hands over his ID to Haven, who thinks its legit, who hands it over to Ithax
Marlow Tensvey Might be a bureau worker, def not underworld related thinks “Can i see your ids?” S: of course!
“League of leisure?” I: hell yeah! “Why?” Ithax starts infodumping for an hour and he doesnt seem annoyed at all H: how’d you get in? “I was in when the building closed.” (27ish hours ago) V: why were you in the building? “Because I heard there had been murders on the first 10 floors” Odd, they would be more interested in the living Konbini does background checks on him with sacraments phone First thing is that his name Is listed on govt database, no picture tho I: keen to get out or u wanting out? “Someone has to keep track of the dead.” Ko: what happened to ur fingers? “Used to work blackops.” V: for what?
“Aedryn. Its why i’m an employee for their govt now” Ko: pay well? “No.” S: does it ever “Better than aetherion. At one point i was in their bases watching them to gacha pulls to get ammo to stop me.” I: what have you found about the bodies? “They had names. This woman killed her own children.” S: scarring or before then?
“Part of The Scarring.” Ko: plural? “Three.” Ko: all three for the scarring?! Anything abt the other dead? Did they do any morally correct things “One was a serial cheater.” S: all perform immoral actions? “I’ve only seen three. But yes. One was a cheater, one sold hard drugs.” P: did you hear about the one that was abusive? “That would be the cheater.” S: how did you find out this info? Their misdeeds? “I contacted the abuser’s wife, she wrote about it. For the dealer, i saw it. It was hidden in his drawers. Alongside a lockbox of credits.” S: possible someone’s doin it out of a sense of justice? “Maybe.” V: vigilante style He tries to not speculate abt the serial killer “There’s a qr code on the back of my id, you can contact me thru official channels if necessary.” Next is the taller man Vesk 7’1”
Eskov Background check Able to see same bits around the vents, same telltale Runs over to the couch, takes off the couch cushions Foot of killer went thru, see where springs went up instead of down Come to conclusion: foot didnt go thru, his boots pulled spring up. To get thru vents hes wearing magboots. Give killer a rough extra 5-6inches of height Still smaller than the vesk Other victims normal height Range of killer would be about 5’10-6” Using fingerprints to open his phone, checking to see texts, cursory search Dubious if wrongdoing, did blackmail aetherion corp a few times Worked as security consultant, whenever aetherion man paid him to ignore concerns, then blackmailed them abt reporting further up the chain Last person Konbini sees that the person doesnt have a phone or anything. Seemingly lives off the grid, but u do have to pay rent digitally Seem to be local worker for various charities Some are derided by aetherion Otherwise charities dont seem harmful, worked at foodbanks Pantry is fairly well stocked, no sign of hoarding or starvation The gamers fuck up the body, the sutures unravelling Rocks dont react weirdly to being taken out Patch takes some of the rocks Body will seem altered Eyes ears lungs, joints (behind the knees and elbows), and finally the heart Weight of all the rocks equals out. 2 for lungs, 2 dense for eyes and ears Rocks are obsidian-like substance, sooty like obsidian S: given the nature of the killings, this does match typical MO of the silence. Cult. they think sensory organs blind ppl to their god. Dark between stars. When they kill ppl theyre found in sensory deprivation tanks. Cult injects them with a neurotoxin to perform some kind of divination. Seems similar to that Differences, the ppl there are alive for the process for longer No sensory deprivation chambers in this building Silence typically grab any passerby, but some group has some methodology. One is using prev victims divination to determine the next victim Go back to floor 37 Going to missing neighbor, kaspar fails real bad We all bungle this We need to take a rest to do this Sending ithax into the vents He video calls us He needs more rope so we pull him back
Ok Save Point Convenience
Bored teenager Al H: rope. You got it? “What alloy do you need?” Basic 2 credit for 50ft Al can we get a discount, turrets move toward him “i cannot” “Does your friend like anime?” Ko: vintovka do u like anime V: it doesnt exist on my planet “She doesnt know [insert anime]” Ko: we’ll watch it on Discourse later if u can fix my phone
“Did you know theyre making a Dr. Vesk flavored Hero Energy Drink soon” Ko: yeah but sure. Anyway my phone “I’ll be right back.” He hands back unlocked phone Ithax demanding konbini to look at her phone He saved some fingerprints in the backlog. He mightve downloaded info off of it, unsure Ko: sacrament-sama cover ur ears. He probably just downloaded the porn of his anime i have on my phone I: ok go ask him Ko: hey next time u wanna download porn off my phone can u just ask first “I’m sorry. I just saw bullet choir and got excited. U know how i feel abt idols.”
He explains Bullet Choir, idol anime that takes place in a war zone Vintovka does look vaguely like one of the idols Ko: u havent seen anything weird have u. With all the killings. Anything sus abt the butcher “Not really? I tend to not pay ppl mind. I tried to talk to him but he seemed wildly uninterested in the Graveyard Shift at [smth]. He seems like the type”
Manager to here now runs Circuit Lab, no manager in the building who can access the computers We can use konbini to impersonate later, once we’ve seen them
Go to Ogar Butchery and Produce
Onmagakar waves at us “The big one’s finally come for meat. Would you like something on the house?” S: i dont believe im allowed to accept charity “Its not charity, its a donation. Any preferences?” S: no anythings fine Try to distract him with sacrament trying meat, he doesnt get distracted “U couldve just asked.” Konbini gets a tour Many vents Incredibly clean, nothing seems to stand out, keeps meat away from it The knife he keeps on him could be used, standard steak knife. Made with a nice mithril blade Small shirren engravings A lot of the meats hanging are rare and preserved, bron tusk, ironhide, scorchtail, nebula manta. Fancy, all of which are super expensive. Typically served to ppl who come in Primary way he makes money is grocer himself “Do you want something of it? I could give a slice and cut it up.” “It’s not like it’s been easy for anyone.”
(kaspar did know abt his son, hes a single father after his other 2 partners died in a crash. He is helpful and nice to the community. His son allegedly died in the scarring.) (he is pregnant. Technically. Tube pod is opaque, to simulate warrens they grow in.) P: how far along is your baby? “Not a baby. Its a memorial to him.” I: What happened to your son if I might ask? “He died” V: seems a bit too recent to talk more further “You all are lovely people but it seems inappropriate for us to discuss this further. You first tried to sneak into the back under false pretenses to look at my wares.” Ko: Sorry I’m a little shy “No you aren’t” We buy some meat as an apology “You haven’t offended me so bad as to make me redact my previous offer. Is there anything you want?” H: I don’t have a budget for anything super high end. Do you have anything better than that. “Have you ever had super high end? I have starless ham. The pigs are grown in zero G, allowing them to fatten up in every direction. Blade is made to cut through flesh, slightly vibrates so it doesn’t get stuck Knife could’ve been used in the murders Whats up w the engravings on ur knife “Steadfast in my belief of the future. Best translation.” K: did you do that urself? “My son did it for me.” (the rocks were engraved. The writing seems similar like its by the same hand. Same stylization at the end, same acid burns to create the engravings.) Father’s handwriting Does match son, slightly different tho Analyze No fingerprints (bug) Voice modulator Not common Has internal & external injuries from being a soldier Ka: i did lose my mom in the scarring, i do understand how difficult losing ur family is “It doesnt have to be the same. The pain is real regardless.” Ka: we’re all in this together. We’re around. If u need anything let us know. Let me know. “Of course. I’m very well capable of handling violence, but you seem a capable group. Its exciting to see young take initiative in a forgotten part of town. At least it feels that way.” (dad is a bit more blue than the son. Son had smaller eyes, as far as face portrait seems)
Patch and Pray Woman waves “howdy. You come here for smth? What work yall need done?”
Serath Ka, the doctor. The closest thing to an official doctor, but everyone visits patch for a reason. She’s less than gentle I: weird request, could we look at ur north store room “Thats service entrances and exits, should be closed. Why?” I: saw someone sneaking around, we want to investigate goings on “I could give u a wildwise graft if you need” Could we just pay
“Sure. i havent gotten much since the scarring. Ive been doin much more combat focused stuff. I never thought i’d be let go from Mr. Stud duty. Its how i got my kill.” (3 mr stud implants, 1 was a bomb) Penile enhancement Any lens fittings “Less and less, mostly aetherion corpo ladder. We do do loans. Buy now, pay double later. No interest.” We pay 5 credits I: could we look around the back “Now why would i let regular customers look around the back?” We asked nice? “U did. But my regulars pay 500credits” Backrooms are effectively service hallway, lets cargo trucks go thru and offload as need be In the back, smth odd abt the vents. Someone does climb up thru them, but also they have set up maintenance switches to activate despite them being on standby. Vents are modular. Covers up tracks Konbini tries to analyze, but obfuscation implant Back to the vents Goes to the red light blaring, blinding him from looking down Able to see the red blood Seems to not be where the killer is, shines flashlight down into a storehouse. Not conveniences Next blood Stares down into the butcher shop Turns around, his rope is cut but still taut on the party’s side. Taped to the side of the vents We can hear pain noise as ithax is getting jeff the killed He begins strangling as his last action in the vent Ithax tries to change shape, he holds him, compressing body down “I am so sorry. I am not a bad person, i swear. I really hoped it wasnt you who found me out. I know that you are a good person. And i do look forward, if it comes to this, to you being part of the body. Why did this have to happen to us?” I: dont do this. There’s still hope. Please “There is. Youre just going to take yours to your grave.” snaps his neck. Ithax gains dying condition We are Sprinting Over To The Butcher’s Shop Patch and sacrament get there first, she kicks open the door Goes to where the vent is, pulls down Others manage to get here, ithax and the killer spill out of the vents Patch stabilizes “You have good friends.” lets go of ithax’s dead bodies S: why did you do that “I jsut want to stop the scarring.” S: by killin more??? “Aye. by being a killer.” S: how is that gonna stop the scarring?? “The killing wont. The rituals will.” S: what. How???? What rituals???? “I could tell you. I’d have to kill you.” S: like you killed all those others? Why them?? He walks around. “Its your first day on the job, isnt it?” “Seven are going to come for me for the seven kills, no?” Yeah “Then i was right in waht in what i did.” S: how does that make it right? “Hard to explain. Esp to someone like you, tho ur lovely.” He explains, the dc is smth he barely passes tho so hard for even us “Could we wait for the others then?” “Im killing people. Youre going to punish me.” He uses prepared action to put vial into gasmask Cant see his face under gear and hood Do see red dripping down behind the mask A form of self sacrifice used in rituals, vaporized hydrochloric acid hes pumping into his face and eyes. Make it hard to identify, but necessary for the ritual Coughing thru it “lets begin” He’s a spellcaster Special abilities: Ritual poison Fairly strong Poison hes taking will weaken him as the rounds go on Analyze target No fingerprints Losing face due to the hydrochloric acid Definitely a shirren Stabbing people with his son’s knife Turns to vintovka “do you worship a god?” V: only god i worship is the bullet “It’s a bad god to worship in my opinion.” “It’s a shame to do it to a good doctor.” Vintovka gets the kill He seems to grab onto the pod as he goes down, and holds on tight. 1 potential level up Sacrament carrying konbini He had fake blood packs Past the courtyard, thru the trees, ithax can see the lights go out in various apartments Taking his mask off, his face is seared but still recognizable Everyone was injured at least once….. Plans: Text or call vossk abt the situation Check out his room Think really hard about the ritual We gotta go fuckin rest

Suimin, Denpakant News
BREAKING: Civilians are told to not participate in the Dead Yield AR. All profits gotten from it will be taxed at 100% says local officials.

PUBLIC SAFETY: Quanverium University has gone silent following a riot there. Locals fear an experiment has broken free amongst the rubble.
ENTERTAINMENT: Groff the Crime Vlaka and his sidekick Puggsy the Shoony celebrate their 10th year of running. MEDICINE: Medivax to continue service for select clientele interfering with a medivax is still considered a felony. Floor 17
Patch calling Vossk Irontether Goes to voicemail Patch leaves voicemail: hi vossk i gave u ur leg. We have a predicament, please call back. Its about the serial killer, we need you as soon as possible We lock up the grocery store, drag him to the back Sacrament calls her manager
S: hi Crinz Griftol “Sacrament report” S: in my megablock we have experienced a rash of serial killings, identified the culprit, forced to murder. We believe there maybe more. Continuing investigation. Allied with other residents, able to confirm alibies. Im reportin in, will update further later “Understood. How many more will you expect?” S: could be 3, possibly more
“Youre allowed to take whatever action you deem necessary, aetherion will cover expenses unless you act rashly”
Sacrament is in training to be a Hellknight for aetherion under the order of the compliance engine.
We have sacrament stand infront of the butcher freezer while we investigate his house at Ogar Butchery and Produce Incredibly boring The only thing of interest in the dad’s room being an empathnid Haven knows if theyre w stable ppl, they stay normal. This one was on its way to be a dread empathnid Butcher’s pet
Son’s room is as generic as imaginable, really boring Repulsion spell, ~6th level Disinterest repulsion, makes people lose interest in it and keeps them away from it Covers the entire apartment. Curves around walls and doors Ithax takes the spider down to sacrament We have konbini stand at the edge of the wall and bringing items in and out of the room to her We do son’s room first There’s a vent also that connects the rooms Into the vents u go ithax Doesnt see anything. Nothing hidden Basic living room + kitchen area Clear out kitchen cabinets Remove his laptop and stuff Only those in the main room are affected when the vents are also blocked off Start covering smaller objects with a metal pot to check but it’s ineffective We bring sacrament in. she immediately sees it on top of the meat fridge Meat fridge is full of The Organs A few of them have gone missing, probably spoiled Marked for organ transplant if needed Konbini looks thru his browser history Locked out This man was on the up and up at one point Able to find some knowledge, he did make his money in, tho never spoke of it, he was part of a black ops team at some point Ithax is able to find, in the post of his son’s bed, someone has left a usb drive there. Recently placed, likely not from his young years Asui model This is what you put ur files in when you really want it safe. Can’t be accessed by magic or most computers, needs a full server room But we know where the servers are. 16th. Right below this floor Text al abt when hes off work. In 1 hour Go down a level to 16 Able to see electric eel-like things flying thru the air??? Electro vore Consuming local electricity, incredibly territorial Invasive pest Not supposed to be here More than likely ate some wires, may hinder access to the farm Ithax goes to investigate emergency access hatch Drone drops down onto ithax This area is super hot and humid cause it’s the heat sinks and liquid deposits for the server room Also lets species who prefer warmer climates have a more comfortable place Go back to floor 37
Hey Al. sorry abt that “I didnt think that guy was serious. There was a guy who said he’d become the god of the internet and went down there. He was kinda bald.” Ko: did u get his information
“He called himself the Stringfinder i think??” Konbini googles him She gets sent to hardcore porn sites, redirects from google Check on the body again Its missing. Yeah. Sacrament and konbini shower together It’s very unsexy and kind of like washing a cat Al is awkward in the other room Haven goes to take food from ithax’s fridge Ithax is so awkward, haven is trying to get him to chill H: you fucking got kidnapped today man I: i got my neck snapped H: You got your neck snapped! You need to crash I: (pathetically) aha u need to stay with me H: can you put in a bit more effort? I: please? H: ok sure. Yeah man i can crash on your couch and watch the door I: oh i was gonna be on the couch H: go sleep on the bed I: but I just turns into a little dog shaped alien
Kaspar checks her sister’s journal, nothing there We reconvene in the morning Konbini makes awesome coffee Ithax tells konbini to check out hiyori chan (herself) Break open the door Smell of viscera from the bathroom, kaspar can barely smell it. Faint remains Seems to come from the shower area Open the sink cabinets, not a whole lot. Cleaning supplies. Bleaches Smells vaguely like the viscera was cleaned up with chemicals Sulphuric acid (cleaning up bones), also bone saws hidden deep in the back. Used for surgical procedures usually Check the drains, find tough collagen that coats the drain To the windows at 17th floor To the apartment, all of which are locked Knock, no response A person leaves their apartment nearby, skittermander “they’re dead. Been dead.” S: how long?
Klutch (owner of gun shop Dying Light) “idk. Prob 3 weeks now it feels? I didnt put it in my calendar.” Notice any noises yesterday from this apartment
“Must be seein things. Light have been taken off. Rook-9 turned them off for more room for their server. (person in charge of computer repairs. Not a server administrator, repair guy) H: where could we find him?
“I presume Petaslice Repairs” I: just needs the electricity? “I think he just turned off the breakers, yeah.” Konbini texts al abt the eels (were they pests that stringfinder was complaining abt) “No they were his pets” Klutch is licensed to sell to aetherion personnel I: i got my neck snapped yesterday! “WELL. i cant help with that. Maybe i can order in custom armor, a neck brace?” Break into apartment Nothing but old memories remain Lights dont flick on Someone did step foot, smth abt them singed the bottom of a rug, but not the top Ithax thinks theres smth odd with the lightbulbs Vintovka sees that the lightbulb is cracked with spiral patterns. They should be broken, but are still held together We take pictures of it Sacrament touches it SHE DISAPPEARS? AND THE LIGHTBULB SHATTERS Flash for a half second She’s now standing alone on the roof of the megabuilding???? Next apartment, we flip the breaker Flip the light switch Able to see swirling patterns go across the walls Oddly move like a discobulb, tho cracks create reflections Grasping fingers goes to shadows The second they touch, the shadow disappears and then reappear after a second We send konbini They fly down to 65th floor We go to meet Can find the access to the skybay, tho under shutdown Door is a bit odd tho One is a hologram, put in place bc the original was destroyed. Someone at some point during the scarring came at it with a breachcutter Floor 16 - Fight outside the server room We do it and all level up Empty desk where there once was a greeting robot Go way down Deep deep underground Takes 7 mins to go down Man exits wearing a tank top and underwear “You approach the stringmaster?” Ko: we have some files we need to do but they only work if they hook up to servers. Can we do that “The only one who can use our servers is me. But i would happily share if you gave it to me.” Ko: sureeeee. Can i ask how u got the name stringmaster “Stringmaster or stringfinder”: Ko: which re u “I started off as the humble stringfinder and now im the stringmaster” Ko: what strings did you find
“Its pretty obvious. This will get me back into the good graces of the Signal Saints.”
(group that believe theyre creating a god w the spilled blood and computing power of senaria Technically classified as a gang??? Also weird gray area. Not really religion. Structured as a gang but thats the higher up initiative “Would u like to see some of my data? In return ill show u what the system has on all of you all.” Sacrament says shed have to kill him if he revealed aetherion info
“U wouldnt have to do such a thing. We’re all held by aeryn-vox to tell the truth.” Haven Various stream chats abt him. Rumors that float out abt gang activity I: this is slander! I mean, you would’ve told me right? H: not the time Ithax I: it’s just these people on the internet lying right? H: how much to wipe it? “Nothing can be wiped once it’s added to the strings H: strings can be cut Sacrament Aetherion secrets Sacrament performs some of her reckonings, rule one onward Patch They play the video of him intentionally botching a surgery P: but there were no cameras! “There’s always a camera” He shots at stringmaster Pulls out gun, starts combat

misc/the-26-laws-of-power-(cultivation-b.title: The 26 Laws of Power (Cultivation Belief)
misc/the-26-laws-of-power-(cultivation-b.description: Cultivation One’s path (Dao) is one’s strongest blade (dao). Other weapons cannot compare The Dao does not take action. Removing desire settles all disputes The Dao is hidden and nameless All things soften to achieve harmony. Submitting to yin is the way of the world Having just enough of one’s needs curbs desire. Excess accumulation leads to one’s downfall The experiences of the world drive us from the Dao. To be imperfect is to be complete To hold all of the Dao, one’s palm must stretch to the ends of the universe None can claim ownership of others for all are equal under the heavens The only thing to fear is straying from the path. What lies beyond is naught but distractions Act as a reflection for the minds of others. Manipulation will steal away the world. Greatness lies in placing oneself below. All things come from the Dao The Dao is the weakest of substances. It crumbles before the gentlest of touch The Dao changes all it touches. None are bereft of desire The Dao is grand like a flooding river All things embrace yang. Softness is weakness without tempering. The Dao provides for all who listen. npcs/former-pcs/haven.html.title: Haven
npcs/former-pcs/haven.html.description:
Family❄️Father: Nel Samsal Teadri of Clan RunsaTimeline❄️📋EP -26age 0 — Born
EP 0age 26 — Start of Red Tally in Senaria, Auver SystemEP 0age 26 — Died

Ithax
Senaria Suns, League of Leisure
Suimin, Denpakant
drinks Hero Energy Drink
Walqirae UniversitySPOILERS
Who are you now, only weeks after The Scarring? Haven, he/him, kasatha envoy, 26y/o Why are you the class you are? What made you choose this path over another? He has a very demanding personality, and he specializes in making others do what he wants. What do you specialize in: combat, survival, influence, craft, mysticism, technology, or something else? Influence + combat Where is your Scar? Back of the neck up the back of the head. Peaks up just behind his mask. What are your personal edicts and anathemas? Describe a situation during or after The Scarring that did/could test or shatter them. Edicts Outshine your rivals. Use every resource you have to win. When the plan is falling apart, know when to cut your losses. Anathemas Breaking a sworn vow or contract. Resisting change or refusing to adapt to new circumstances. Allow personal feelings to cloud judgment. Before the shattering, he was consistently tested on his anger management skills, but he never did anything drastic that cost his team the mission. Yet. Then again, he’s actually got people he cares about now that have an even higher chance at getting killed. What is your immediate goal now that the initial killings are over? What do you most want to protect, change, or destroy in the city? Survival is the biggest thing; making sure that Ithax doesn’t get in over his head with his investigations. He wants to shut down a lot of the criminal orgs here, making sure that others weren’t dragged in like he was. How did you survive The Scarring: was it through your own hand, someone else taking the fall for you, a deal you struck, or something stranger? He struck a deal with an old acquaintance, Meskiv. She needed help getting an ex-client out of the picture, and he needed to live. He didn't even ask for their name, just knew they were some barathu. But they surely weren’t important enough if their bodyguard left as soon as things got tough. They just cried out when they got cornered. At least it was quick. How did you gain your class abilities: formal training, gang work, religious order, guild apprenticeship, military service, experimentation, accident, or natural talent? Initially gang work, but acting as a shot caller has been nice for upkeep on skills. Who were you before The Scarring began? A pro esports player, technically, but tried to hide previous involvement with criminal orgs. It’s not hard to tell what he used to do, though. When he did an occasional stream, it became a popular joke amongst his chat on what he used to do: hired thug, drug trafficking, assassination work, all were thrown out as suggestions.
He grew up in Denpakant with the name Vihe (v-eye-hey) Nanse Jaltra of Clan Runsa with his dad (Nel Samsal Teadri of Clan Runsa), but once he was old enough to start earning some credits for simple work, his dad needed more and more money for his growing gambling addiction. After shit hit the fan one too many times, Haven left their apartment at around 15 for a grimey, tiny one rented to him dirt cheap as long as he acted as errand boy for his landlord, Luthien. Turns out, he’d unknowingly joined a gang. Were you connected to any gangs, guilds, noble houses, religious orders, militias, or other organizations before all this?
A local off-shoot of a gang that called themselves the Storm. He always thought it was a stupid and cliche name, but they seemed proud of themselves, and he didn’t really want to get his ass beat. What did you do for them? It started off small; make deliveries, debt collect, don’t die. Then as leadership slowly left or got axed, his roles got more important (mostly killing people who pissed off the upper guys), until he had a small squad of guys who listened to what he had to say. And as their influence grew, that meant more people died under his watch, even some of the new guys that he said he’d take care of. Being stuck in there for just about a decade, he had his fill and decided he’d had enough. So, he cut his losses (not without some yelling and a few new bullet scars in his right arms), moved across town, changed his name, and didn’t really touch the scene until Ithax started poking his head into things. He’s lucky he’s got someone like Haven there to keep an eye on him. What is your strongest memory from before The Scarring? Has it changed in meaning since then? The first time something made him falter in his actions. He was barely 17, still a nobody, but trust was put in him to get Luthien’s money from a “tenant” that was refusing to pay. It was a vesk woman and her teenage son, just a few years younger than him at the time. He shook her, and the boy ran at him, yelling. Panic made him shoot, and the next thing he knew was the boy writhing in pain, clutching his leg. They didn’t have the money to get help, and they all knew it. He threw up in the alley outside their apartment. If the curse had never happened, what would you be doing right now? Streaming, or if he got bored, leaving the planet to find something new to do. There’s only so much you can do in one city for your entire life, especially when you’re trying to avoid the consequences of your actions. Where in the city were you born or raised or are you from offworld? He was born and raised in the southwestern district [INSERT DISTRICT NAME HERE]; it’s where his family lived for most of their lives, and he hadn’t moved far from home initially. But after he left, he researched and booked it to Denpakant (raised in district where it then nuclear meltdown. Hard 2 get to) Who were you closest to before The Scarring? Ithax, Meskiv Who do you still have left? From his understanding, his dad is still around, though it’s a bit surprising. He’d texted him, something he did often asking for money or trying to check in with him, but all it said was “Don’t come home.” What were some life changing memories before The Scarring? The first few days after leaving home. He still hadn’t found a place to stay yet, and he hadn’t thought things through that much at his age. He ran out of food super quick, so he turned to asking people politely, and when that failed, he stole. It didn’t take Luthien long to find a kid willing to do anything for a place to stay. Describe a moment from The Scarring’s first weeks that permanently changed you. Ever since he’d moved away from Storm, he’d found peace in the anonymity of a new home and faces. But that peace shattered when someone followed him home and tried to stab him in the stairwell. He’d seen the fear on their face when he pulled a pistol out and shot with precision. His life or theirs, and he won. Guess he still had the reflexes, despite trying to avoid that kind of life. Name three NPCs you know personally who also survived The Scarring. Are they allies, rivals, or something in between?
Meskiv Ocano - ysoki, she/her, behavioral scientist with a focus on criminology. She was, ironically, a major client of Storm’s. Two of her brothers were in the group, and when Haven came and made sure they didn’t die for being stupid, she was a bit soft on him. She kept in contact after he left, and though he’s pretty sure she has alternative reasons for doing so, he does appreciate a little bit of care being sent his way.
Luthien - human, he/they, 35y/o, asshole landlord that pressured Haven into joining up with Storm. Trained him in the loosest way one could interpret the word, but always bragged about the fact that Haven very rarely got his ass beat by those outside the group. Kind of his father figure (since he somewhat raised him) if his dad sucked even more and threatened him constantly.
Imrek Sariin - kasatha, he/him. Was also part of Storm, but joined after Haven. He looked up to Haven a lot, though didn’t really listen to him when he was told that he could have a better life elsewhere. Where one stayed, the other left, but Imrek has reached out to him and warned him about things that could involve him in the past. Of those three, who would you kill to save yourself? Who would you die before harming? Kill to save himself - Luthien, Imrek? Die before harming - Meskiv Do you have any history with the other PCs: family, rival, ally, co-worker, neighbor, debtor/creditor, or something else?
Ithax - Roommates and teammate. Haven tagged along on his investigations to provide back-up in case anything happened, and also to make sure that things went Ithax’s way.
Konbini-chan - Guest player on the team, know her personal identity? What themes or arcs are you hoping to explore with this character in the aftermath of The Scarring? (i’m so bad at deciding these sorts of things) People can surprise you even if you think you know who they are To what lengths can someone change who they are? How long does it take after fucking people over can you say that you’ve become a good person? What kind of gameplay experience do you want mechanically? (e.g. social manipulator, heavy hitter, problem solver, specialist) Problem solver, social manipulator. Lot of commanding my allies and spooking my enemies What kind of end do you imagine for your character: survival, sacrifice, power, transformation, or something else? I kind of actually picture sacrifice for him? How would you prefer the city’s political and faction details be delivered: in-game through NPCs, as handouts, or through GM recaps? Via NPCs or handouts, tho I prefer NPCs What are you hoping to see in this campaign? (Tone, themes, types of encounters or problems) Pushing the PCs to their limits of what they have to do in order to survive. What content or themes do you want avoided? Explicit pet death This campaign will explore coercion, control, scarcity, death, and power struggles. Are there specific emotional beats (e.g. betrayal, body horror, loss of autonomy, desperation) you want excluded? Just avoid explicitly talking abt damage to eyes pretty please! Some elements will include urban horror (claustrophobia, paranoia, constant surveillance). Is there a particular way you’d like these approached? Nope, I’m good! .
Storm has been moving up in the world getting to be headquartered in the Vitiae district; they've fallen under the command of one Mafilus, a vesk commander. Running the district as a military junta. Allegedly unkillable, he became known as the one permitted immortal of the imperium before disappearing for 10 (earth) years until The Scarring.
The internet has become localized SCRBLEs have been cut off and disallowed to enter the system. If you send out a message out of the system, it will take 6 years to get to the nearest star. Use of Remembrance Streams is also incredibly cut off, only essential personnel from each sector empire are allowed through and not allowed to make contact.
The twilight vigilante hero of Senaria, Captain Dusk, and his teen sidekick, Dawn, have disappeared. Leaving behind a power vacuum in the Grenthol district. Rumors have spread that the Vitiae district was once a military compound was an experiment to mix military infrastructure into civilian sectors. There is some truth to this due to the new tech the broken standard has suddenly acquired on the streets. As the skies are closely monitored it stands to reason they were already planet side.

pcs-(active)/bwip.html.title: Bwip
pcs-(active)/bwip.html.description:
Who are you: Bwip, a young zabanii po talphi who is working "undercover" on the ship to weed out The Criminals that are running amok! She's very bad at being undercover. She has no real sense of who she can or can't trust with her cover identity, Bweep. She's just too friendly. What class are you and why: Investigator due to her Deep Desire to catch criminals and put em in JAIL! Even if she doesn't really know how she would do that, she's very confident she can. Whether or not this confidence is warranted is yet to really be seen. What was your role on the ship: Bwip was a janitor on the ship. What better job is there for her to be able to find cluesies?
Name another person besides the party members who you knew on the ship: I know Atoll, a Copaxi cafeteria worker who would sneak me corn bread when it went stale.

pcs-(active)/jabari.html.title: Jabari
pcs-(active)/jabari.html.description:
Who are you : Jabari, a summerborn rypharian sent to work on the ship after some "restructuring shifts" happened at the company he works for. It's run by his disapproving father in law Bilis, so he thinks its just a ploy to send him off somewhere. But Kokos, his dragonkin husband, really wants them to get along, so he will try his hardest and put up with it. He's a kind guy who puts a lot of value in an honest day's work and likes to give things his best effort. What class are you and why: He's a striker operative because he feels most comfortable with one-on-one hand-to-hand combat. He used to wrestle as a kid and really enjoyed it, and wanted to go professional, but after learning how much of it is scripted and about performance, he refused to "sully real wrestling". What was your role on the ship: He's one of many laborers on the ship. When something needs moved/built/broken/etc, he's on the job. He also like to consider himself a "part time pal". When someone needs help with something around the ship, he will happily offer a hand however he can whether it be assisting with a complicated building project or something as simple as reaching something on a tall shelf.
Name another person besides the party members who you knew on the ship: Atka, the brenneri coworker who always joins him for lunch and rambles with him about their families back home. He's not the best suited for their job and makes a lot of mistakes, but he's cheerful and has made good friends with nearly everyone on the team.

pcs-(active)/lucine.html.title: Lucine
pcs-(active)/lucine.html.description:
Timeline❄️📋EP -27age 0 — BornEP -24age 3 — Dead Arrival Ship Launch
EP -2age 25 — Dead Arrival Ship Crash
EP 0age 27 — Start of Dead Arrival
Who are you: Lucine, umber-blooded madrosarai (25ish), brought on to the ship at a young age to try and bring some money in for her parents after they struggled to stay afloat financially. She was raised explicitly to help navigate the stressful multi-year journey as a friend and therapist to the crew, and she has not known much other than the ship. What class are you and why: Psychic due to manifesting psychic-like abilities as a toddler when her bloodline settled. Her thoughtforms manifest as emotions, which help specifically with connecting with those who confide in her. What was your role on the ship: Advisor/therapist brought on to help combat the long hours confined on the ship.
Name another person besides the party members who you knew on the ship: I know Kansivix, the shirren tech support specialist, who has had to help her recover her data several times after something or someone has caused it to wipe off of her computers.
SPOILERS Came onto Jabari during one of their sessions, causing him to react Badly and has begun blackmailing her with the end of her career if she doesn't assist him.

pcs-(active)/morain.html.title: Morain
pcs-(active)/morain.html.description:
Info
SPOILERS Edicts: Never leave a comrade behind. Keep your head down and don’t get noticed. Take risks when you could win big. Anathemas: Abandon a mission. Rely on others to fight your battles. Where is your Scar? Peaks up over their right collar bone.
They were previously faking their scar being on their hand, which they wore gloves for, but with The Scarring 2, they don’t really. Have to really worry about that much anymore Morain’s offsite identification is in a gravebox, not far off from where Thane got left, labelled as a John Doe. They have to pass by his burial spot if they want to actually retrieve their identifying information. Things they believe Sanctity of mortality (immortals continuously consume resources long past where they would naturally give back to the universe and will eventually leave things stagnant if left unchecked) Value of life Things to remember (For Jay): Immortals are evil not because of their active actions but because them passively still consumes resources, the soul and someone's effect on the world can't stop growing and it's impossible to be a living creature without affecting the world, their effects naturally outweigh those defined by death and if left alive will eventually eclipse all the potential the universe has leaving it a stagnant place unmoving similar to an entropic force. The imperium doesn't believe they can fully sever the ability to become immortal but rather it is a tide mortals must fight against similar to fighting against entropy The universe belongs to those who live in it and will return body and soul to it, not those who will consume it endlessly and never return their body or soul to it
The emperor is thus the ultimate embodiment of this someone so committed they are willing to give even their history to the universe as thanks for the gifts of life. Halfling, he/him, mid-late 50s Family friend that they saw occasionally, popped in and out of their life over the years. Parents seemed mostly unconcerned with what Growing up, taught a few moves, went “oh hell yes lets fucking go” Decided early on that they wanted to follow in their mentor’s footsteps, and the option was. Either end up with the state military industrial complex or end up being mentored by Thane. So Thane went well I guess you’re stuck with me now Ended up being sent on mission together to Senaria to investigate what was going on, not finding out abt the Scarring until it was too late to leave Thane was killed trying to protect Morain while on mission Which is fine. They’re not mad. They’re not upset at all. Don’t put it into the papers. Ok they’re a little mad Led to where they thought they were meeting up with Kaleo, but actually walked straight into an ambush It seemed like a targeted attack, Morain just Barely managed to make it out with a half-dead Thane They tried to drag him to a clinic, but it was a little too late by the time they found one He died in an alley, leaving Morain with his locked down comm unit and them barely understanding what their next move is supposed to be Morain has been trying to get into the unit with very little success and has very much fully locked themself out of it by accident Kaleo had messaged Thane about several possible new locations to investigate, and told him there was crucial information that couldn’t be sent over comms in case it was linked directly to them I don’t know the limits of what i can put here for like. What can be workable. Looks at you with big wet eyes
I think Thane would have known more but didn’t tell you. What you could have known is that it related to The C. Based on context clues The C was some sort of immortal group that was sometimes referred to as a single entity. The C was allegedly connected to the group with cyclical names, he had a word he called them but he seemed afraid that you would be tempted by them if you knew too much too quick. It did imply they were able to make people immortal with fairly low effort. Thane had a weird feeling about the situation, told Morain to be On Alert, and they scoped out the place ahead of time but it seemed. Fine?? There was nothing crazy suspicious with it, so it was a kinda like. Damn i Guess its ok moment It, in fact, was not ok It was Genuinely supposed to be an empty office building. Everything they got said it was supposed to be empty. And Then It Was Not. they got up 3 floors, opened the doors and stepped out and Immediately got shot at by like. 4 guys with no sign of Kaleo. After Just confirming that they did see Kaleo alone They managed to take out 2 of the guys, with the other 2 slowing down as they managed to make a break for it, but thane purposefully took a few too many shots that were intended for Morain They slumped in the alley, and thane started talking about what morain needed to do after this and morain was like. What. what. What do you mean. Stop talking like that its FINE youre FINE. and thane just kinda gives them this pitying look. Says he’s sorry, tell your mom she was right. And morain does Not cope well when he finally ends up bleeding out while they’re trying to lug him around looking for a doctor Zack Provided Info: There's a group of people that did not manifest scars and were immune. He believed that they knew of the runelords but were a distinct faction The group was using spiral imagery, the one he seemed to have killed on his own showed no DNA degradation despite being a Lashunta, meaning immortal. He would have given you the basic info of "if you see anyone with a name that invokes a cycle such as Palinode or Echoic, to report to him" He also would have told you some basic tells of something odd, such as: creatures not knowing what they should/visa versa that liches when threatened will step towards their soul instinctively unless they trained that habit out to listen to the creatures making sounds unintentionally/only when others aren't around how to cut yourself slightly to fool a polygraph to always confirm what is someone's room when you get the opportunity especially in the field you should not trust them. As is the saying in spywork, "there is only one spy who is a thief, everyone else is just trying to get back what they're owed"
that being said do not physically steal unless necessary Halfling, she/her A lawyer who was Fully expecting Morain to follow in her footsteps and was extremely surprised when they decided to Not do that
Was fairly against Morain leaving on an unknown mission, but trusts that they’ll come back alive with Thane’s guidance. She grew up with Thane, so she trusts his decisions, even if she doesn’t fully like them. Which was very much a point of contention in the house Their parents had very differing work/life schedules and beliefs which caused friction at home This led to Morain’s eventual decision to turn to becoming an inquisitor Thane met with them a handful of times in different districts, though Morain only officially met them once during initial contact At the time, they kept a disguise on, expressing concerns over being identified. pcs-(active)/shibao.html.title: ShiBao
pcs-(active)/shibao.html.description:
Who are you: ShiBao (石保) realized from a young age that he had a passion for food, brought on by his incredible sense smell, even by Vlaka standards. He was happy cooking for his friends and family, but wanted to put his abilities to slightly more useful means and found a job on the ship to provide nice, hearty meals to others who could be motivated by them in pursuit of bigger goals. Despite his somewhat intimidating stature, he is softspoken and friendly, and never minds extra or odd requests his shipmates may have for their meals. What class are you and why: Hauling everything around a kitchen takes a surprising amount of strength. In more actuality, though, you have to hunt for some of the ingredients you want to use, especially back on his home planet, so a fighter he became. What was your role on the ship: Chef :3
Name another person besides the party members who you knew on the ship: Sivri, the Maraquoi medic. Had to get acquainted after testing out (and messing up) a particularly difficult cutting technique for a blind man.

pcs-(active)/trahern.html.title: Trahern
pcs-(active)/trahern.html.description:
Who are you - Trahern, Ikeshti former brood minder, the planet i was living on was no longer a good place to raise hatchlings, I learned to manipulate scrap by living in a junkyard surrounded by it and became attuned to the element of metal, thankful for the gifts provided to me by that which others consider leftover. Once the brood was old enough and I'd done my duty to the community, I learned electrical engineering and decided to go see the worlds. I picked up some healing as well, considering how fierce young brood creatures can be. What class are you and why - I am a mystic and electrician due to my connection to metal, I feel like I have a good understanding of the importance of each component in a system. I imagine my mystic network as a circut diagram. Sometimes people complain that I shock them when I empower them with my powers, which grant metalic versions of natural mutations to my friends What was your role on the ship - My ability to magically manipulate metal and knowledge of electrical engineering makes me an excellent repair person and electrician
Name another person besides the party members who you knew on the ship - I knew Zio the bantrid security officer, he has caught me stealing scrap from the trash and watches me closely.

sessions/dead-arrival/dead-arrival.html.description:
You're all workers on a Concord of Aedryn colony ship attempting to set up a remembrance stream. During the voyage, you're not sure how close to your goal you were, your ship was attacked by StA defense systems destroying the majority of the ship. Your other party members are the ones who got in a pod with you before systems started failing.
A republic democracy state which was founded by the elf homeworld as they spread out under the guidance of Vibias Sevreina who led them to the stars, you continue her will onto deep space away from the Central Distortion and toward what may be the center of the galaxy. You can play any ancestry and any race, you carry on the honor of her memory with your sails. Your ship has been approved by the central planning committee to allow expansion in accordance with the balance of three, may they be proven right about their decision to send you.
Going from Etsperunt System to Ageve System in what will become a bridge jump. As such you've been given some basic kits for making houses and the like on the ship so you can start infrastructure constructionPCS:

sessions/dead-arrival/session-1.html.description:
PCS: Bwip
Jabari
Lucine
ShiBao
Trahern Prev Session:
Next Session: Session 2
Dead Arrival Colony Ship How did baobao spend his last day before the accident? Had exactly 1 day before the captain planted the beacon, which wouldve then allowed him to go home No duties, just have to enjoy it Everything heavy duty picked up, little celebration meals amongst the crew Didnt know what was abt to happen All of the xenobiologists were called to stations immediately Jabari Happily enjoying a meal, a feast with the rest of the crew Sitting with atka, probably drunk, excited to go home Wouldve only been a 70 hour trip back once the beam was set up Founders of a new area, would have the naming rights Bwip! She’s bummed, hasnt caught a single criminal, hasnt done a good job, trying to scrounge thru the trash Digging thru dumpsters, maintenance robots asking her to stop Unfortunately was incredibly clear trip Able to see papers shift when the ship makes a sudden turn She snatches them up, various recipes and receipts thrown away Ppl here are odd! Basil the service robot serves proportionate alcohol to the people, 2 drinks per crew member Thinks, but it passes her by. Excitement she can go to an actual city! Money to start her own agency We would get fuck off levels of money, invest it wisely Lucine Packing repacking, packing repacking, very nervous At least 2 drinks in Hasnt actually Been on a planet as much as she remembers Trahern Sells 2 drinks Waiting on the countdown Nervously reviewing- doesnt understand the beacon, trying to make sure all the electrical looks good Shes gotta take pictures of things to send to the 50 babies who are not adults Nothing seems all the matter, able to look at the structures and the like Solar winds or smth, but a small tinking sound against pieces of metal occasionally, doesnt see what could cause it Entering heliosphere, probably the solar winds Pleasant night, none the wiser Eventually, alarm sirens go off, lights go flashing down thru the hallways, leading to various escape pods Not friendly for baobao, who has sensitive ears Eventually find our way, no one else comes Automated system makes us not hold it, we’ve entered an atmosphere Releases us Fall into the orange ringed sky, the cold overcomes us from the foam meant to save our lives An unknown amt of time later, cryogenic freeze undoes itself Find ourselves overlooking a vista, red emergency light Things outside cawing, hitting the side of the pod Moons are odd 2 of them visible from the window Bwip is looking at space from the ground for the first time Ground is silent, which means other creatures are avoiding it Baobao hears a group of creatures flying silently, waiting for something to happen with the pod Goes to whatever side has the most people Fuckass birds that i hate They are basically extinct on elven homeworld. But not here! Meat of bird is somewhere between red meat of a deer, very gamey, and the fine meat of a pheasant Do have to ignore the part that its probably made out of people hearts or smth, just dont think Ship crashed from outer atmosphere. We have no idea where the main ship is Near a flood plane Early night rn, seems to be summer, around 100 degrees Air is a little low in nitrogen, bones will hurt occasionally 48 hour days, 20 hour nights 28 hour daytime In the badlands, itll heat up severely. If we’re still there when the sun comes up, 130degrees First thing we learn. Mountains across the badlands. Given the cars engine, it can travel for 12 hours before having to charge. Manage to make our way to a crossroads area, what appears to be a grassy plane Lava motes crack into it from the earth Rapid burning and healing of trees in a vitality network Screesire here… we Could fight it. But it’s hard. Move on Rest in the groves Battery charges oddly fast. Blue sun charge it fast <3 Artificial neon tint like a shopping mall On one of the taller mountains, there is smth artificial They carved into a mesa despite it being a naturally sloping mountain Foam has an upper limit of 50 years Pod doesnt alert us to the time. As to not cause mass panic We go up the mountain Pink forests on the other side Turns from the shade of green into an odd orange, also seems to be cable line installed across several gaps with small pieces of planks that hold them over Spiraling down the mountain, like strands of webs, pipes Baobao hears Something! Has 3 feet and moves haphazardly. Interrupted by the sound of metal tightening We go around the mountain Odd cave with pipes going in, seems to be fluid processing plant Lava! Pipes are pretty hot Lava is flowing Down the mountain. This used to be a volcano, was built upon Last blast was abt 1000 years ago Robot doesnt care about us
We see a starmap that wouldve led us to aedryn abt 1k years ago Jabari waves at the construct creature, it doesnt seem to respond This is a clockwork, ancient type of being. Of elven make Few thousand years old, during the time of the elven monarchies This is not supposed to be here Another shows up “name?” in elven T: trahern “Code.” Safety code would be more of a ping, similar to morse code It points its halberd at us “Descend.” “Location not identified. Descend.” We descend Go back to the cave, see if there’s a way to get up. Basically the underside of a pool that holds lava Bwip steals a piece of paper This is basic arcana script, precursor to modern programming Creatures of clockwork can get new orders by going down the line Paper is abt 10 days old Lava pool at the bottom appears to be the source of energy for the entire facility. Could destroy it, lose power, but we could go thru the empty reservoir We give the orders to turn off the reservoir, we scurry over Bwip picks a lock We get burnt :( Go up to the observatory Welcome to my space :) Astrolabe, seems to be central galaxies
Notes in elven mark potential burgeoning civilizations of ppl. One marks humans, vesk, lashunta. Missing mark where the dwarves would come from (habitable part of their planet is underground) Spotless A lot of magic One of which is prestidigitation stones Balled up paper is arcane theories, attempt at spells. Theoretical ones ofc One appears to be an attempt at time beacon, which it says should not exist. It does exist for us, but for him, it was a theory Should be 1000s of years old Room to the left Living area Edible food??
Known as Manafood, magical food that can take any shape Cannot be flavored, is incredibly bland The wizards that made it liked to shape it like their fave foods Keys are keys. Dont seem to go to anything we know yet Study on how magic is affected by different spells Person who made it could cast 10th rank teleport. Go anywhere within the same galaxy
This started a mass exodus of wizards, created competition here. 1 wizard got the idea, many wizard elves followed. They then agreed to start their own state, known as Mageocratic Capitalism Societal system where wizards would be at the top and could engage in free trade with each other Utopia away from the small ppl of the normal elven world Person who slept here is reasonably assumed to be an elf - Planet symbols correspond to where we were supposed to go Go upstairs Hot cocoa still hot Compass! Magical compass It just kinda swirls around before locking in on a directly, slightly off east Compass of transpositional awareness. Lets u know where someone teleported from if u get there within a minute, also sensitive to teleportation effect Jabari briefly dazzles himself Bwip drinks the hot cocoa Insight coffee…. Twilight lantern, moderate Adjust the scope Spot 2 things, one of the planes is crashed and a camp is set up there from our ship potentially The other is more valuable but far. Nearby mountain covered in red moss has an antenna from the ship. Useless on its own, but could be attached to a nearby object and allow signals for the nearby region The clockworks notably only go downstairs. The upstairs, the master’s study, is undisturbed At night, look at the sky: all of the other planets are barren. No lights. This is the only one that we can see with life. Far off in the distance we can see the star that’s our home Down the mountain, to the car, head to the camp Able to pull up to a daily empty area, have to walk thru the woods where someone has clearly cleared out a parking area for potential Someone has made a makeshift tavern out of the planecrash Robot waves to us! “Well. welcome!” B: hi!!! “Good for you to wake up. Do you remember me?” B: yes!!!
“My name is Beverage & Amenity Service Interface Link, or B.A.S.I.L. if you will.”
“How may i and aetherion service you today?” B: how long has the ship been down? “2.5 years. On this planet, 1 and a quarter year.” J: other survivors? “Other survivor pods put off their emergency signals like yours back to aedryn.” (it didnt carry the data that our ship was attacked.) It would take abt 20 years for a fully prepared ship to rescue us J: locations of the other sections of ship? Or were u able to see where they were shut down “I was only able to see. U flew on an aedryn ship, i am an aetherion SRO.” T: we saw a satellite, is that anything “If you set it up, it would unlock the pods. But u should find the other survivors, some are orbiting the planet.” “I legally cannot sell water and my aetherion programming does not allow me to have what i cannot sell. Are you familiar with the aetherion motto?” B: remind us? “Currently, our front facing amenity robots have the motto ‘everything good has a price, and we sell the best!’” J: doesnt include water???? “No, aedryn calls water a human right and thus we cannot sell it.” Basil wants a new battery so he can move around, we can take a crashpod battery and repurpose it
He offers us credits or Aethercoin, we’ll take credits Fresh water 1 mile northward Radioactive zone a mile west, close to the location of the antenna

sessions/dead-arrival/session-2.html.description:

Next Session: Session 3 We wake up to non dark and stormy day Middle of the night. 2 more hours until daylight To the antenna Several hour trek upward Collapsed radio tower Reddish mess of algae Likely very common due to blue star, red is one of the best colors for photosynthesis Does mean that u can see in rivers, it looks like blood when algae grows See patches where algae has been consumed Hear a roar from within the antenna Coposirix, a type of coral growth with similar rootword as copaxi Grows in poisonous area or areas with a poisonous runoff like this antenna V territorial, small child sized head, migrated over here over the years We fight it Take apart the antenna We can salvage the dishes into 1, bring it to a high point and turn it on Lots of discussion abt fixing up the stuff
Basil tells us to send the clockworks to grab our cargo and bring it up while we deal with the stronger ones Rifler goes to recharge, we go to attack the other one We deal with the 2 main clockworks The others bring up our stuff over the next 2 days We attach it to the rotating dome, allowing us to move the dome around to catch different signals Put solar panels on the dome so we can have actual electricity here instead of wizard lava magic Checking to see crash pods nearby 4 sources of signals from this position First is near the ocean, alongside a beach area 2nd is far side of the valley, opposite of our crashsite 3rd is garbled, tho get smth that responds back
“This is Wizard Servitor Irvex, how may i help you?”
They reclaimed the pod for the wizard lord Gurastoff and the ppl inside are in prison We want our guys back please?
Ask if we’re part of the Freestriders, we say yes, they call us commie scum and hang up We call them back. Say we’re not freestriders. They ask what wizard lord we’re under We’re not under any but how much for our guys freedom Willing to sell them back to us. For 700credits and 10kgp Thinks we’re using a sending spell. We’re using a radio This is a bamboozling one. This planet is 1k years behind modern day tech 4th is a message coming from far away thru a signal broadcaster
Seems to be from 1 first mate Almanthir Mialari
“My loyal minions as we find ourselves stranded, we must adapt. As the rightful inheritor, i’m your royal lord and you’re my servant. The tower has accepted me.” (this was supposed to be his promotion voyage, where he went on and would become captain) This is so far that we cant triangulate it just yet. Very far away The compass of transpositional awareness does flick occasionally, flicks around as compasses To the ocean The escape pod is bobbing up and down in the water Glyphs
For Ulidel the Salt Wizard that would make salt golems that would plague the lands His personal water drake is in the water :( We’re going to do an epic show the everlight crystal

HR Coordinator Braxor Trox woman is someone we can trust
1 engineer who was nearby, Guanspio L: you all alright? Bosun “fine. Why did you wake us up?” L: its been 2 years, the ship has been crashed T: more importantly, the rescue ship will be exploded L: we kind of need to stop that otherwise it’s gonna be another 20-ish years before any service to get back out to get another rescue ship “What parts of the ship survived?”
L: well,,,as far as i’m aware, not much, we did recover the antenna at the very least. We’re able to figure out where other people are, but a lot of it is destroyed. We have a central base with Basil

And we found the remains of where someone lived (shows them the compass) people are teleporting around Tells them the first mate has gone crazy Jabari brings braxor along “Has lucine been harassing you?” J: …no “You know you always have a friend in HR!” J: thank you braxor “Of course. Yes. that’ll probably help “Is there anything HR needs to know at this moment?” J: first mate almanthier called us minions? “Not proper terminology, did you feel degraded by it?” J: i did “Would you like to file a complaint?” J: i would love to. He even called me his servant “Hmmm. did you feel this was ancestral in nature?” J: i did wonder! I dont have any proof but yknow “Good to know!” J: ty for ur help ms braxor. I feel a lot better after talked “Of course. Do you happen to have a knife i could borrow?” J: basil may have one? I only have my rapier, im sorry. “I’ll find a way, dont worry.” Grab the rest of the party Yeoman looks “So do you do you have?” Just you, and basil They tell us that we should use tech to convince the wizard that we’re a wizard as well Go back to BASIL’s camp Work on the battery The bosun wants to go to the antenna, best shot at figuring out the impact site WE DROP HIM OFF HERE, WE MUST REMEMBER HE EXISTS Go to the other drop pod Coiling snake of fire Flariska, not dangerous but do go around and make a lulling sunlight. Want to warm up ppl Also have the ability to knock you unconscious if you stay in their light for too long Bwip digs to the pod The seal on the pod is odd The pod seal activated their awake mechanism before their full revive. They wouldve been awake but frozen if the creatures werent there She digs a tunnel for the ppl, hits the lever, ready to free someone and gets hit with cryogenic gas Bwip found the science team! She pulls them into her hole 2 astronomers, 2 xenobiologists, and 1 geologist B: DO YOU SPEAK PYRRIC Astronomer Fenxsys “...yeah?” B: good morning!!! Can you talk to talk to fire elemental snake things so that they know we’re not a threat Olzii “firesnake things? Fire or sunlight?” B: sunlight? “Flaryscas?” B: yes! “That should be easy. We could tell them theres more in need of warmth, they could search for those. They glow in the dark, we can see where another pod may be.” Fenxsys talking, the creatures float away, wiggle of happiness as they go to look for more The ppl are
Xeno-biologist Olzii - specializes in fauna, mammalian genetics mostly

Geologist Meleas - halfling

I presume you are using solar panels? The sun is a bit different than what we were expecting. It does mean the solar panels could run more effectively to charge the vehicles better.” The land patrol durgible is destroyed, but the 2 buggies inside are in tact They could repair the patrol durgible. Can hold 2 other vehicles and up to 12 passengers Explain the situation J: be wary of the radio. One wizard does not know what tech is, we’re gonna keep it that way so we can ge the survivors they kidnapped. He thinks we’re casting sending over the radio “Does that compass of yours flick in regular intervals?” Yes! Could be a clock
Also the wizard servitor Irvex is most likely a clockwork/automaton
warn abt Almanthir Mialari Also havent heard from the captain They think theyre probably dead Zadok was in cryo sleep due to being a gnome. Would get bored Astronomers go to observatory Gnome wants to start from the top and go downwards, can see the rocks and see what happens Engineer presents us smth after some time “Put this on the other side of the valley. Its a wave jammer! For us. Stops our messages from getting out unless we want them to. Closed communication loop.” Shoot it with electricity and itll go down for sometime “U could also. On switch off switch. Big issue is we wont know if it’s off.”
Guanspio has family tattoos, hes part of the Marrione Family “500 should work. I could set up protections.” Lucine tries to offer sexual favors in return of hes on a mountain alone. It was a real bad roll. Hes going to get 500 credits + a car to use Hes immediately starting a protection racket Trahern gets grabbed by HR “Why do you think some schools of magic are worse than the others?” T: mines the coolest! Trahern doesnt like WIZARDS Trahern is going to get a month’s deduction of pay She writes down a consent form abt the meeting with a berry pen “I dont think we addressed it on the ship. How would you like to receive thanks?” T: IVE NEVER THOUGHT OF IT BEFORE “Is there any way in ur culture you wish to be thanked upon!” T: exchangement of scrap! She gives pieces of metal and wire she found T: how do u like to receive thanks! “In mine we pound our chest. 3 is customary!”
Gurastoff's Dungeon Can see where the pod crashed in the side of the mountain It crashed onto a bridge. And see the drag marks on the mountain
Giant door, says “The wizard Gurastoff’s Lair! Enter for a modest fee of 100gp to speak to his servitor himself.” Knock on the door Go through the hole, enter Lava drake :( Go my jabari “Who enters!” J: hello “Why have you entered the vampire wizard’s lair!” J: we came to deliver a glorious bounty in exchange for some slaves that you may have, for the wizard lord gurastoff “And you cleared it with his servitor?” J: yes! We spoke via sending! “Why lie to a mighty dragon!” J: well. We wish to enter the dungeon of the mighty wizard lord gurastoff “Why enter thru the door and not the front door?” J: we knocked and no one answered “The door is automatic” J: since the hole was open, we assumed this was usable and permitted way to enter. Im sure he would fix the hole if it wasnt permitted “Would it not break one of the 70 laws of gurastoff?” J: if we provided a gift would u overlook this shameful breaking of laws This dragon is the wizard equivalent of a minimum wage worker putting on a mascot costume. Just show him smth cool or pay a tithe Trahern makes a cool metal statue “you understand a mighty wizard’s draconic servitor!” goes down. Comes back up “what year is it btw!” J: 1000 years since the wizards arrived “Then i have a mere 1000 years to go!” J: for what! Signed a contract that allow u to ascend from drakedom to draconicdom. Even if wizards are gone they can still become a dragon J: also a 2nd one. Also wahts up with the blood fountain “Its decrative for those who wish to receive his embrace Go past Crackling purple fountain Signs posted that say “insert a mere 1k gp and receive the embracing fountain which will grant u eternal life.” Malfunctioning. Drinking this would def be death or being unconscious Plants are odd Wizard sponge Named such bc theyre a type of amoeba that scrubs dungeons. (wizard Gurastoff’s lair) The wizard is also a vampire and probably isnt actually here Big lava drake blocks our way but we bribe him with statues Drakes are minimum wage workers to wizard, 2000 years to lvl up to draconic by wizard spells Tusk motif symbol, similar to a heart Oddly yonic More rough draft paintings He thinks v highly of himself Another cage room for animals Undead Basic undead immunities 3 statues of dwarven warriors Dwarven and elven inscriptions We dont have dwarven Elven “in honor of our fellow capitalists of the underground, may our fruit be bountiful together” Dwarven is in a different penmanship Urn shelf is odd Secret crawlspace
Run into Irvex “Wizard towers are for losers. Anyone worth his salt can cast a fly spell and reach the top, but a dungeon you need to assault.”
“It needs to be workstone, lest it be penetrated by foul magics like the mole people from Zirkon-6.” We get party split Fight irvex Weak to electricity and oraculum, resistant physical He’s infected, we could cure it WE GET IT, GET THE PARASITE
Aetherion Acquisition Terminal A lot seem to be modern tech Microwaves, radios, creature has hoarded them here Reactivate the creature Very nice robot Lord gurastoff should be in the inner sanctum “We had pupils but 2 days ago.” J: what happened 2 days ago? “The pupils graduated, became full vampires.” “Its an honored tradition, going back 200 years.” T: what year is it? “It depends, you dont seem to be from aedryn.”
L: we are from aedryn! “I see! Youre like me then. Servitors.” (500 years ago) L: what have you all been calling the planet?
“Of course. La Vetrine.” (old world for paradise, fell out of fashion 300 years ago) “There are many wizard lords. They all serve the oath. (capitalist) “That scoundrel! Do not work with him. He stole the design of our good lord. The clockwork of blood. He uses lava instead.”
“The fowl Salvier.” “He talked abt how we needed to come together. He theorized that the other planets would lose their life soon. And that ours would follow.” t: how soon? “He says within 100 years.” “Studies Publical Science.” “He was rejected. But dont worry, you’ll experience paradise within the valleys.” J: would u be able to retrieve your master? We’d like to experience his mentorship “Of course. Let me check” bows, prays “i may not! He deems me not fit to be answered.” The tower? “All wizard lords refer to their tower as The Tower” (describe area)
“Ah. you’re talking about the Konseki Tower. A lecherous man that. Though not bad if you dont mind a party. Lord Konseki Mialari had many illegitimate sires before he left on his grand quest.” J: vampire? “No he came in many people.” L: What sort of grand quest? “The founding of this nation.” L: Where did he have to go to be on this grand quest? “To this planet!” J: how long has this nation been founded? “200 years of prosperity.” J: i guess despite his lecherous ways he was able to do that T: how did everyone else get here? “Teleportation. We decided this would be a nation that only the fine arcanes could access.” The planet had natural defense mechanisms but its either redacted or we dont have the perms
J: do u know Ulidel? “Of course. Their floating fortress is a mighty thing to behold.” (it fucking crashed on the coast) J: how mnay wizard lords made home on the planet? Is it a lot? “A countable amount. They called it the centurion.” J: at least a hundred? “Exactly 100” J: that sounds very countable! T: were his apprentices not wizard lords or “They were apprentices but not wizard lords!” Hey wahts with the teleportation thing
“The teleportation magic of Nos Sodesk. Teleportation stones by which they set up a teleportation circle between aedryn and here.” J: only allowed for wizard lords? “Naturally! Only wizard lords may activate it.” Teleportation goes to aedryn and is guarded, dont typically go out J: set course? “No they should be teleporting it constantly. If its only 1 set then your compass must be broken.” J: no set locations? “They are a magnificent wizard, move it wherever they seem fit, making it untrackable for all.” (its so trackable) Hey what does lord gurastoffs thing means The growing of fangs, just like the green men of Kroson-5.
“Harsh ppl from a harsh land. Poor in the skills of magic.” (describing orc homeworld. 5th from the sun. It’s actually called Saurial. He’s describing the elven word for the star) t: obv theyre abt and well. But what kinda thing for that some of them abandoning their post “An apocalypse! And even then they wouldnt abandon their post, im almost certain.”
J: the wizard lrod that predicted the apocalypse, did he mention what would cause it “Something from the stars. But bad men always look toward the stars, but we only have under our feet” L: hey the eternal waters “Dhampirism!” T: hey btw the worm? “Idk it” T: i think youve been out of it for longer than 2 days L: yeah that “I base that ive been out for abt. 3 years.” Trahern distracts the robot The thawed

Metal movement “No. exchange of currency is how we do things here.” T: ah excellent. Whats the exchange rate on credits “I have to wait to see the master to discuss such things.” Back to the others Escort them out Emerge with all 3 pods fully saved effectively Explaining the situation J: the servitor says theres some natural defenses but either he doesnt know we’re not allowed to know or he lost it. 3rd floor of Konseki Tower Baobao Combat Basilisk Special abilities: immune to petrify Petrify gaze Stone spittle (ranged attack) Oh fuck lizard is in mystic network!

Grandpa Konseki Mialari might be skyping into his body 4th floor Blacked out room Feel electricity crackling
One first mate! Almanthir Mialari 5’6” elf man looking at us With a warp troll L: u’ve done a lot! “I have. I was given a gift. For the rest of my life i can be the only wizard lord left alive. Competition.” J: shouldnt there be 1 left? “Do you think its impossible for 2 people to kill each other?” J: id just assume there would be 1 left L: im just confused abt the blessing ur grandfather gave you “Its simple, i saw a light beckoning me to the tower, when i woke up, i was already.” He was teleported J: if they were all dead who couldve done that? “Magical runes. “If i could teleport back and bring the magic to the homeworld.” J: why does that involve mind controlling so many ppl? I talk and the world answers.” L: wdym? “I found this troll, told him i need defenses, and now he’s here.” L: other cases? ‘Of course. Some people resist it, but the animals respond naturally here.
