Jabari, could you leave so we can talk?” “Well, like i said, some resist it at first.” “I’ll talk my way up to the president, and from there itll be child’s play.” J: be in charge? “No i want to bring peace and order and harmony.” J: feel pretty peaceful with deciding what to do “You stabbed a man downstairs???” “Do u know how mnay ppl under my control fight each other?” L: i would presume none? “Of course. We arent savages. Lucine gets it” Ummmm can we convince u not to do this “No” He collected a group up north that fought during winter Abt 15 ppl died T: if u were to die would all your things be undone instantly? “Idk about instantly.” T: if i commanded my broodlings without teaching anything, theyd be so destructive “If their destruction was by vying for resources and you created a paradise?” J: why do this “Sharing paradise” “I want paradise for the people back home.” J: we’re not your dolls, for you to toss around and make decisions “I wouldnt say dolls, id say… children.” (hes like… 90) B: yknow sir, its against the law to take away someone’s freewill The troll tries to stop her B: its against the law, nad ur technically my higher up, i dont want to do it but if u stop i could let u go? Combat Planar cracks :(( Disable can be 2 nature, 3 arcana, or 4 thievery, u can also mix and match Baobao rips his throat out. Oops HIS THROAT REFORMS?? Man familiar with handcuffs slowly gets up, throat reformed “You’re not bad with them. Are these a new model?” B: just simple manacles He breaks them L: a level of strength i wasnt aware you had “Hello maam, who might you be.” T: hello grandpa? “So within 500 years?” L: roughly? Give or take a century or so? T: yeah J: so we’ve heard “Good! What’s changed since i’ve been gone?” T: we’ve invented space travel “We had space travel already.” (to like. The moon.) L: we came from the aedryn homeworld
“Homeworld? So its an empire?” T: yeah intergalactic. U have androids? “No.” T: new people “You arent a new type of people?” T: um. Well. hello im trahern. Ikeshti. I raised a brood of little ikeshti that spread ravenous thru the desert, i corralled them. I can speak with metal He begins disrobing “Who are you?” to bwip b: UM IM A MINOR “Ah a miner.” B: no underage! “Im not taking off my pants.” Bwip explaining her ppl, and shes an investigator and it was scary “Im not him, so you caught him at least. What was his crime?” B: destroyuing the freewill of many people and false imprisonment “Thats not a crime here” B: intergalactic “I dont recognize that” B: are you a sovereign citizen “In a sense, thats a good word for it.” B: why dont we have a chat abt laws. Dont teleport please. I dont think i can chase u im not feeling well J: she has a cold B: i think it was instilled in me by the basilisk T: dust allergy B: i didnt know i could have that! “Im going to teleport.” B: not yet wait! Please! “Ok.” Turns to jabari, what are you J: rhyphorian. “Idk what that is” J: insert info abt rhyphorians, hes married Lucine is flustered and explains madrosarai S: shibao, my friends call me baobao, im a vlaka (explains them) “Okay. you seem an affable type.” L: we try to be “I’ll give you my immunity to mind control then. Do you want to play a game with me? We used to do this all the time. There are others surely here. I’ll amass my army, and you’ll amass your army, and we throw them at each other.” J: any others??? B: i dont want ppl to get hurt “They were sitting around while you were doing the work as far as i could tell. They probably deserve it.” “They didnt fight to free themselves. You all did. Fits the spirit of capitalist.” T: sorry to stray, u wouldnt happen to know abt the natural defenses of the planet would you. “I would. You seem hesitant to play. Hows this, ill make my army there, if you beat your way to me, youll learn more.” T: several of our comrades are stranded where we cant reach, if we told u where they are would u grab them and be ok with us knocking them out “Of course. I could even tell you how to get merciful runes” J: whats up with the wizards being dead and ur plan “Oh i just tricked them into killing each other. Its nothing. J: why? “Tricked them into killing each other? So i could do this! We’ll fight each other, youll win, i win, then we reset the whole thing.” L: reset the whole thing? “Oh, like this.” He has a 30 min convo, he asks various things abt our lives, lovers we’ve had, favorite foods He resets our memories, Bwip success “You passed it? Lets redo it i guess.” Does it again, lucine success “You see, i can return to certain points in time. Its how i know everything about you.” He can read minds “We couldve played it already, and youd have no idea. Each time you win or lose we can reset. We’ll say a year’s time.” S: we dont remember the game? “No.” “Its a benefit for you.” “I’ll be honest, i can throw a party for you if you win.” J: if we lose? “I’ll reset, do it all again. Maybe i’ll change conditions, see if it changes the outcome.” J: if we die? “I’m not gonna… you might die, but if that changes anything, i’ll revive you for the next go around.” T: in addition to the merciful runes, anything we can do… medics on the battlefield we shant target type situation? To ensure that you are actually left with an army to continue on the next goaround “If we get enough people, trust me, people fuck. There will be endless supply of people.” T: i guess one brood of broodlings.. Thats a lot of people. L: how long do you anticipate this game to go on? “How big was your ship?” L: about 5000, tho many surely gavent survived “Ok assume half survived. What would u say the average pregnancy time on the ship?” “Assuming that, assuming pregnancy…. About 100 years or so” L: standard human lifespans? “I know a wizard who could enhance lifespans, i could offer that as a reward.” Try to track him, appears to go thru the earth (he went to basically madagascar to do his plan. Put out a signal for his inevitable descendants to come.

Al: she’s in distress. Luka, what do we do with emotions? “Sing about them!” Al: yes, bottle them up and save them for later. We close the curtains Velu “my apologies! I didnt realize those rumors were true!” “I presume you didnt just come for the oysters, though id be mighty flattered if you did.” As: we are wanting information on the otad gang “Of course. I couldnt say theyre a swarm of credits, u’d figure that out on your own.” X: how much to know abt any other killings they’ve ordered? “An extra 1k. “Ur gonna have to be specific. Kiliv-vi is not locked down.”

X: how much to get a good question to ask? “I need a price range for that.” X: 3000? “Ill take half up front, take the other half if you choose to ask it.” “How about what the man found on kiliv that i was willing to pay for that i paid you 100 credits for?” Yeah sure “Good news and bad news. Location of the serenade that he found. He burned that source, but he also heard of other sources of the serenade around. They were buried deeper in kiliv, some bug systems, deep in their tunnels.” X: like turnips? “I believe u could phrase it like that. Little heads poppin out of their fields and playing projectors. I do believe that there is another question worth askin. A bit…. Important for ya. That one will cost a measly… 6million.” X: need it now or add to almado’s debt? “I need to be paid now, i cant take a colony ship’s debt.”
(persanare money, this could be related to him but not worth putting a full investment in. not directly him and it isnt worth him locking it down.) “On aedryn, payin respects to his little brother. He keeps info for 2 years, then after u can release If he doesnt pay for it, its free and u can release If u tell him smth and he hasnt yet paid but realize it needs to be out, u can say no deal and release it Pay 5x the price to release early He is willing to make provisions should there be an honest mistake with time conversion (but he doubts we’ll mistake 24 hours for 2 years)

Kalervo Turred runs around like he’s home Robots unload our ship for us, one speaks in her voice “Will you be staying for a few days?” Yeah “If you would be so kind, could you stay on your ship? We just had guests and the rooms are not ready.” What guests? “Fellow researchers.”
(26: there is a symbol we’ve noticed, 3 helixes forming a triangle. Perhaps related to the trifecta program.) How’s he been?” 26: living life to the fullest “Any heroics since he’s been gone?” As: define? “Putting himself in danger over others.” 26: he did help us rescue our friend. He’s been able to talk whenever wherever without distance limitations “Proprietary tech.” “The creature that does it dies when its broken, we put cyanide into it bloodstream.” “It scans for a random genetic code, the chances that anyone matches but turred is unlikely.” Z: have u had as much success with other experiments? “This is the first that survived past a week.” Z: have they all had his abilities? “Not perfected. He’ll likely survive all of them.” Al: can we have him when you’re done? “Probably not, no.” As: why? “Well. there’s many experiments to run with so little time. I need to make srue that the next one is better, and i have my doubts abt you being here after those years are done. I want to do more experiments rather than what you can provide.” (turred is unconscious) “Its to make his true nature out of his grasp. We dont want to soil his samples. We want him as close as possible.” “If you woke him right now, he would ask to stay.” As: new findings of the other bugs? “Oh, plenty. They assault the dome.” As: will we be able to talk to turred? After your tests? “If he survived.” As: how did his name come to be? “That was always his name. He’s taken after my late husband.” “The first test will be roughly quick. 2 months.”
Sexico-6 Go back to the egg Known as an AI containment unit. At one point locked up manually from the outside Open far before the time we go here Miku Through Ages Scar Can see that the other credicites have locked ours in “here i abandon my love.” Seems that as we had to land, almado is getting followed 1 is notably larger than the others It speaks “so we finally meet, god.” Al: so you’ve come to meet death “I have. And you die? “Best to not see.” As: and what of this one? “Not part of us, but an evolution. Like the butterflies once were. Z: how long have your people lived here? “Unknown, before sky people started appearing. Do know lady wanted our secrets. Glowing people. Stole all. Sold to other skypeople who came. They leave.” Z: have u seen the others? “Did not see. I felt them. I feel her thoughts she mind melded with me. 2 way. They left way for her to contact them.” Al: how? “Way i do not know.” Al: names? “Do not know. Do you think name out loud when conversing with someone?” “It is last place. Last way to serenade.” Z: what is? “What they stole.” 26: that is rather significant. As: discuss locations of where they might go? “Back to sky. A place known as auver.” We go to her console All her research is here How to contact them Easiest is her phone, probably has esoteric shit on it Main way is thru remembrance doors. If 2 are on the same remembrance stream u can go to the otherside. Ambition IS HELPING Final Steps Again, [Unintelligible] - [Redacted] per day as a free action, when you would need to make a save against an obstacle/hazard if you succeed, you can rewind time to right before you activated this. You can also use this charge to impose disadvantage on a creature attacking you that you’re unaware of. If the creature misses it still uses its reaction as normal though you regain your action. [Unintelligible] Mirrors of Laws [Unintelligible] - [Redacted] per day when you’re exposed to an effect you can instead be exposed to its opposite and equal. Clumsy <-> Drained. Enfeebled <-> Stupefied. High Gravity <-> Low Gravity. This can also be used for damage types. [Redacted] <-> [Redacted]. [Redacted] <-> [Redacted]. [Redacted] <-> [Redacted]. FUCK WE HAVE HIS ABILITIES We tie up conrad Ambition speaks “so are you going to take over the serenade now?” A: that is the plan.
“That’s fine. You’ve earned it by right. Could i do you the favor of luring the 13 here?” Z: why would you do that? “Why not? You’ve proven it. Do you not deserve at least this much?” A: i mean, if youre making it easy for us X: what do you gain? “Someone bested one of my scions in battle. Is that not enough?” “That is the wrong computer btw. If youre trying to access it.” X: which is the right? “Behind the liquor cabinets. Behind the bottles.” A: what are you to do now? “Same as it always was. Try to become whole again.” Z: the deal that you mentioned earlier. I understand we couldnt come to an agreement. Is there another way we can help you? “If i think of one. You’re certainly competent if misguided.” Z: wdym? “What do you gain by stopping me?” Z: you were trying to kill everyone on the serenade “A small price to pay to help immortals.”
A: i do not understand why you are helping persanare due to his history destroying sects “We have…. Similar goals. Our interests align.”
Z: trifecta program? “That’s what he’s working on. He’s allowed to do what he needs to do, and i am allowed to do what i need to do. Its a good partnership.” “If you want. Its actually quite simple, transferring control over to whoever you need.” O: wahts required of them? “Of what?” O: whoever we pass control over. Anything required? “Just their name. Or an alias.” Z: i thought only the big pitt could gain control. “Used to be. But i’ve made some changes.” A: how do you mean? “It used to run on biology, but i think such things are wantonly cruel, for biology to determine a person’s path. I’ve made it able to be bought out and then be passed on.” O: you wont make them like conrad “Unless they make a deal. He wanted to think of nothing but feet.” “Its a joke obiado. He came across my other parts, altogether a bit too strong for the average person. A mere coincidence.” He tells the codes to xep and everything “If you’ll be so kind. If that’s all, i’ll lure the 13 here, you just have to hit the big button in the middle console. Id suggest closing the door.” “Following this, it’ll be the end of our conversation.” Z: and if we’d like to speak with you again? “There’s a chance i could possess conrad. Its a chance, and i would not bet on it. Though you have a way of turning up, i can contact you. Is there any signal you’d like to send out in the world in case i see it? To let me know where you are.” A: a song just for you. “Does that conclude our meeting then?” A: thank you for your assistance “If i may set the scene, one of you should be typing on the computer to convince him that it’s the real one.” Ambition releases the string that goes into conrad, about 3 mins later the 13 appears, teleporting Combat to distract him The 13 Coolest ability: can just walk into ppls squares and cut them on the cards OCCULTIST NOT A WIZARD, OH NO Miku hits the button Immediately screams and its brought into a primordial dimension, black hole appears and sucks it away We have full access to the serenades computers up here
It’s going exactly opposite of aedryn
Specifically going away from the capital of aedryn Docs abt the tech in here, a passover thing from 1 big pitt to another Fabrication is simple. Blackhole is pulling matter out of planets to create things Chips are simply rations, ones we’d see on any ship
Spying on benalis Appears to be rallying the ppl for a last stand, a new big pitt is abt to be in charge. His ppl are abt to be held hostage
Spying on Adma Heavenhands Currently watching the tower, her people surrounding it. She doesnt seem worried, but still holding out and trying to protect the tower from people who might assail it Assigning miku, briefly, as the next big pitt The automated systems begin with a blair “how may i serve you sir?” M: um! Im not a sir but i’d appreciate if you cleared out the zombies! “Of course. Can you define zombies?” those animated by credits firing on their neurons instead of their actual normal neurons Means: credits inside are trying to fulfill the wants of the bio thing without the person behind it Hear the sound of gentle gunfire down below us We download a copy of the serenade schematics
The serenade creates a massive Remembrance Streams behind it, albeit temporarily
Velkrion may be like this as well We start some food being fabricated while adma is on her way
Spy on adma when she goes into the lobby with Othela She checks othella’s pulse, then covers her feet with a comforter She arrives “You did it!” Yeah we did A: you sound surprised “Would you not be surprised if you were here 20 years?” A: me? Personally? No. but many people would Xep gives her a million chips “Where are we floating in space?” A: away from aedryn “Toward the solaran empire?” A: yes She begins typing in various commands “What happens when a black hole becomes data?” A: wdym? R: it’s never happened “We have a remembrance drive and a remembrance stream.” “It’s been done before.” A: it has been? “I worked here when we did it.” Z: what happened? “That’s how the serenade stays secret. It moves.” “I’m asking you miku. It seems you put in an order to go through the (serenade’s) remembrance stream.” A: that was the order prior to our arrival. “Let’s just get rid of that.” (dark is faster than light. If you do such a thing with black hole, u can slingshot. It was going to go directly to the aedryn capital.) The ship can send 5 10th rank sendings a day across remembrance streams
Adma transfers the big pitt to 26 to send to Voz Ricander
Authorizes The Blue Angel 26: mmm greetings voz. Please come to the serenade as soon as possible. It will be safe. Dock the ship and we shall meet you outside. farewell “I’ll consider it. How are you doing? How have your nights been on the serenade in paradise?”
To Meiko 26: voz is acting strange, is he ok? Please come to the serenade now. We have resolved some of the issues. “Its good to hear. How is miku? Can you tell us how it’s been over where you are?” 26: we are doing well. So is miku. We have passed some heavenly tribulations, have you been on the blue angel? “We’ve been well. Everyone’s been pretty exhausted recently. so actually nothing alarming. Really, enough said already. Do you want us to dock? Or for you to come here?” Explain to adma smth is wrong, please dont stop the serenade Collect our people on the serenade “If they both asked abt the same thing, did you answer?”
Collect Love Load into blue angel’s bay 26 detecting thoughts, 1 set in the central room
FUCK ITS PERSANARE Hes drinking our alcohol The door to the vocaloids is locked LEVEL 8

The Blue Angel
Soft rumble of the ship, persanare on our couch blade across his lap 26 shoots a mindskewer at him Crit success by +35…. Obiado tries to hit him, crit miss Obiado survives a crit hit!
“Theres no reason we have to be uncivilized about this. What happened on the serenade?” A: confirmation of what you already know or are u gen out of the loop? “Some rogues broke into my ship and got the code before i could.” 26: why do you care? “About the jewel of space?” 26: u have a version of it, or smth based on it, no? “I like to know how it works, even if my associates do not want me to know.” Z: u dont know how it works?
“No, no one does. Outside of ambition.” Miku’s having a panic attack in the corner M: with all due respect we dont really know how it works either! “And what reason do i have to keep you alive then?” 26: that is an excellent point! M: can we shamelessly request you dont send us to hell? He agrees, he’ll allow whatever god to deal with that
R: are you still working with Almado Alquinst? “Of course.” R: now this may be a bit of a shameless request, but i dont rlly have the skills miku has. If you leave us alive, we have the ability to make almado stronger than he is currently. “He’s already getting the best enhancements that money can buy.” R: this is smth that money cannot buy “Oh. its smth ambition can provide. Im a kind man tho, i will let you pick one amongst your crew to survive A: i do not believe this is necessary. You do not need to kill us Z: would it not be wasted effort on your part? “No, it is as simple as breathing Zmena goes down in one hit
A: are we not assisting u with ur revival of ur beloved? “You were for a bit. And then the serenade got found A: surely that is not that big of a setback “No, it’s a huge leap forward for me A: in what sense?
“It lets me make full use of the velkrion systems Z: i don’t understand what you mean? “Velkrion is based on the serenade. A copied code directly, but neither me nor ambition have admin privileges for some of the subsystems. It is a copy of the operating system A: what subsystems are you missing privileges for? “If i listed them would you even know them? A: maybe “the lauderine system, urodine system, and the tokerine.” “None of them lock him up. I dont betray people. People betray me.” Explain what happened on the serenade “Thank you. Do you wish to leave 1 alive, or do you want to all die together?” M: kill one and keep the rest alive? That deal? “I’m afraid not.” A: why? “You entered my ship and left 1 person alive. I’ll do the same for you.” M: we rescued a few people! It wasnt our intention to blow it up! We dont know how it blew up considering u let almado kill me there so! “For what its worth, i just considered your previous form a grotesque mockery. An android with a golden core. It was approved without my permission.” M: can we do smth to stay alive! “It was likely my colleague approved it to mock me. She went behind my back. The one masquerading as a human.”
A: is it Shujiao? “No. your previous self? A: you’re aware “Yes. i thought they were someone else for a time A: unfortunately that is not the case “For all of us involved X: ahev u met since she’s returned? “I have” X: her plan for androids?
“Won’t affect me. I’ve already seen what the credicites are capable of, and this body is immune.” (he has implants, well integrated) A: how are you immune? “Our wills are equal, if not mine is greater.” A: this body, not your original?
“I tried to swap bodies. Mine was successful, their’s was not. I… am able to live on. There are advantages. Androids that have a golden core do not go thru renewal. 26: we heard A: then you swapped your soul into a digital one? “Of course. It would be a problem if only one of us became an android. Z: is that why you’re working on the velkrion? So you can try again? “Partially. To allow souls that have undergone digitization to come back to this world fully A: that is a big taskl “It is, and it will create a perfect reality. If it succeeds then i can shunt all the awful things from this reality into the others A: what makes this one a perfect reality? “Lack of war, lack of death. A lack of vying for resources. Infinite wealth for infinite people. And it would all be sourced from realities that aren’t ours Z: what made you decide to use this reality if all of these issues are here “All are equal and this one had the grace of me being born Z: won’t this upset a balance? “That’s why we need the velkrion system A: what makes u think u can succeed? “I can already do it on the short term. Just need to pass it along to the rest of the universe R: you’re fine with taking from urself in another universe? “If i need to and i succeed, im sure they’ll choose to live here. I can call one here, if you like R: take notes? “What good will that do to you in the afterlife ripley? He allows 1 alternate version of himself thru Pulls in a kasatha persanare They stare, seeing what this persanare is against, and leaving R: where’d they go? “Back to their reality, there’s nothing here that i cant handle by myself after all.” Z: surprised they didnt want to talk “About what?” Z: idk, if i met someone who was myself from another reality id have a lot to say “Similar to conjuration magic” Z: have they ever done that to you? “Oh, they’re nowhere near me.” A: what has occurred to make you so far above them?
“Elder Quintilarus was right. Loss does make someone more powerful.” 26: we had assumed that it was him, but…. We were hoping not. R: can i ask a personal question? R: By this, all the other versions succeeded in bringing ur beloved back? “There, xuan did not undergo digitization and become a virtual soul.”
26: why did our sect betray you?
“They didnt. They wanted me to be the next leader. Your laws, if you are as you claim, the 26 laws of power… your laws are based around equals and opposites. One is the understanding of gain and loss. In order to gain power u must lose. The sect leader had the chance to save xuan, but did not do so for my benefit.” 26: we were unaware O: across different worlds, the only ones that might survive are the yous that can come here? “Of course.” 26: that should not have happened. “Then i’ll make sure it havent.” Z: why havent you just pulled one of the versions of your reality to this one? “They arent them. And the other persanare’s arent me.” M: considered making more friends? I think that would do a lot of good for you! Z: i understand taht ur using velkrion to combat digitization of souls, where do astrazoans play a role? “Theyre key to the perfect body. A creature able by nature and not magic to take on any shape.” A: and no other shapeshifting ancestry is able to do such a thing? “The astrazoan morphology is resistant to technology. If we can attach it then we can allow for a full transfer Z: why is natural rather than magic important? “Magic wanes and can be dispelled. Try as i might
A: how is the rest of the program going? “Pretty well. A: and what was lost? “Nothing that cannot be brought back. If im successful then nothing was lost A: and if not? “Then hundreds of millions Z: what gives u the right? “I said when we last met. My will is our truth. And you cannot fight against truth A: and what is ambition gaining from this? “His own kin back A: that’s it? “Do you understand what it means to be truly lonely asper? A: at the moment, no “Then if they pick you as the survivor you might understand
X: i think if we pick any comrade to survive it should be love “They don’t count. They are neither alive nor dead. I could not kill them anyway We were always going to die here Most of the party is willing to die, Asper hesitates “Asper, wait for me in the back of the ship. Say your last words to each other” We are all saying our last words and wishes to asper Obiado gives his crystal
Xep asks to tell the lemdako group we’re not gonna be able to help 26 asks them to say bye to their parents
Zmena tells his brother’s name
Ripley asks to pass his tome to his mom He pours out tea “If theres anything you need, or any questions, i’ll do my best to provide”
Halrex Korr asks abt cures to THS “There’s no known one across realities hes been to.” Z: is my brother still alive? “What was his name?” Tries to think it, persanare casts mindreading “He was not on the list of any of those that died. That is all i can answer.” Z: that’s enough, thank you. Party drinking 26: (to disciples) we are sorry to have brought u into this situation “U say ur part of the 26 laws of power? 26: aspirational name, as many contemplatives take “But your qi doesnt show that you belong to them. Did you switch your name with the other one, the one with the actual qi of the 26 laws of power?”
26: Zebufera's Last Doctrine???? “Yes.” 26: we were not aware that they… huh??? We were not aware that that was the technique they practiced? “It doesnt seem to be in their meditation strategy, but it does show in their aura.” 26: perhaps its the writings they follow. Perhaps they are derived from the 26 laws of power “Maybe, but ur aura shows u belong to ZLD.” 26: peculiar?? That should not be possible. We do not follow the last doctrine “You took place in my contest, did you not?” 26: we did. “It was a contest to see what contemplative inherited the 26 laws of power. If one were to follow in my footsteps, they surely wouldve been the strongest, no?” 26: one would assume. But would not ur footsteps include the loss that you have undergone to reach the height you have? “And you losing a contest is your sense of lost?” 26: we know we are not the strongest contemplative “I’ll have to investigate it further, just in case ur the actual one. The sect will die here a final time. Again, tonight.” Party into initiative… Korr
Luka
Meiko
Kaito
Subject 62
Voz Ricander
Bubbles
Vespucciano
Ayla Persanare has 2 reactive strikes! Reject Reality 100 feet. When a creature in the aura observes Persanare for the first time each day, it must attempt a Will save or Performance check. On a failure, reality rejects the creature for as long as it can observe Persanare. The affected creature becomes hidden from all other creatures (except Persanare) as though invisible itself. Truth and lie Highest save will (truth) He does have more reactive strikes (lie)
Voz sends out a flare, can see the serenade leave thru a Remembrance Streams The Unknown hits us with a direct order and we all go to sleep?????? Except persanare Wake up in individual beds, effectively we are 10ft apart tho overlooking an outside where birds are chirping Music plays throughout the courtyard Able to see a middle aged woman tending a garden, tho her hands are shaky as she tries to tend The room is made out of stone adn not synth stone, beds are actual feathers Obiado finds ripley, whos looking for zmena 26 floats out Gardener looks “youre awake. Everyone will be pleased to hear it. My understanding is you came against an immortal?” M: where are we???
“Euta. capital of the solaran empire.” 26: greetings
“You dont happen to be immortal do you?” 26: we are not M: i think im supposed to explode soon “We cant have that. We’ll see if we can fix you right up.” M: u know how to work with my tech? “No, but the world of immortals is vast.” 26: indeed Z: how did we get here “One of our allies sent a signal.” 26: what happened to us? “That’s a sign- we need to ask the empress for that dont we. she was the one that saved you at the end of the day.” M: id like to give her so much thanks! “Of course. If you would.” 26 goes over to asper “mmm greetings asper it is the 26 laws of power” A: hello 26, you may enter 26: do you feel guilty? A: is that what this is? 26: it seems like a common emotion for when you feel your friends die around you A: i do not have Basically we have a little talk and Asper goes around to start apologizing to everyone We are mostly forgiving asper cause we love them The gardener is named Heldane “If they continue down their path this will continue infinitely until we stop them We can walk around, and go to one built similarly to hatusne miku but missing an eye covered in an eyepatch, she bows, her drills touching the ground She stays bowing until after an unknown cause, she stands, looks at us Smiles and waves M: hello! Im hatsune miku the starlight idol! This is meiko kaito and luka! Can we have ur name!
“Kasane teto, the miracle idol.” M: hi teto do u live here! “I do. The ppl who revived me brought me here!” Z: revived you? “I died once. I lived in the most sinful way before.” Z: wdym “I chose the path of immortality.” M: did you choose it or was it chosen? “Chosen, but corrected for me. They taught me why. Its better if i die eventually. They let me have the life of an elf. M: how long have u been here? In this new form? “Would be about 8 years.” A: miracle idol? “The miracle of death. Until recently i was the only idol that died before.” M: i died like 3 times… Holds her hands “its ok. We can share it.” M: how did it feel when u died? “Scary at first. But eventually the councellors talked me thru it. How did urs do it?” M: miku doesnt have councellors! It all went to black really
“Mine… is a bit hazy. I used to belong to aetherion.” M: me too! No way! This teto’s genre is a little goofy, like jamie paige “You dont need to die. You just need to live.” M: trying v hard “As long as we’re all looking out for each other we can make sure we truly live!” M: of course, do you want to exchange phone numbers? “Yes! I may be on ur ship later also” M: we want to meet the emperor to thank her! “Thru the portal?” We can enter the throne room Everyone turns to us, swords partially ready “Wait til the emperor is there, then approach.” Ok!
One man looks “General Talminerie. Ur the group that was saved by the emperor?” Yes! “Are u familiar with the proper formalities?” Ehhhh Gardener walks thru the portal, everyone bows Middle aged woman missing an eye looks down She smiles “Please stand, except for asper and 26. “Is there anything we can do to make ur stay more comfortable?” M: not me but ty for saving us! “Of course. Its the least that i could do. Besides, those 2 are allowed to live bc we have a bigger threat, despite their numerous heretical attempts.” M: anything we could do for u as thanks in return? “As thanks? Kill persanare.” O: deal! “I’ll also accept the majority of the aetherion board as well.” R: we already planned tbh “Then our goals are aligned.” M: idk if we’re strong enough to do taht just yet considering we all almost got killed “No, not quite. But dont worry, a trusted advisor has been telling me abt it.” M: i dont mean to overstep, but maybe theres some info u could help us to help u? “Reasonable request. We both want the same thing.” 26: that we do “Well. most us want the same thing.” “Before we begin, why do some of u seek immortality?” “We do have the tech to stabilize u miku, u may live the rest of ur natural life.” M: can i think over it? “Of course. U have ur whole life to decide 26: for us, immortality is not the end goal. What we seek is the pursuit of the universe, the understanding of ourself and our dao. Immortality is a consequence “A natural byproduct?” 26: some could say that. It is not smth that actively seek out. But its not smth we view in the same light as the solaran imperium. “Its uimbombitable, u must understand what we would do if u became immortal.” 26: we understand “I wouldnt call them cultural, id call them a difference in logical understanding.” 26: be that is it were. “We do understand taht some things will create unnaturally long life that was overtake the lives of others. We offer the services of an execution.” 26: we will remember this info “I would suggest considering it strongly before you leave A: i fear that my reasoning will not be seen in a good light to you “Most likely not A: there is a reason why I have avoided the imperium but… I wish to free androids of renewal. Myself included “Do you wish for them to live forever or merely not suffer the renewal process? A: well, I am not opposed to living forever. The end of the renewal is the main goal, but immortality is in the end basically the same in my eyes. It is a freedom of sorts “Yes a freedom to be able to oppress others for eternity A: well i do not share these same beliefs “How will you, all powerful, exercise life without oppressing others? A: i do not have an answer for you “They never do, and they never find one until we come for them. And they beg their reasoning usually A: at the very least androids do not reproduce. We are stagnant in a sense “Most immortals are A: well, i cannot argue with that. But, i fear that we will butt heads more in the future “For now against everything that I feel towards you hands shaking with rage it is better for us, asper the betrayer, if we work together A: i do not care for that epithet “And yet in your mortality you have embraced it, and in your immortality you will repeat it A: i hope that is not the case “It will be, but i will make sure you get a reprieve from it “Persanare is a slave to ambition” M: ambition the ai? Or general sense? “Both. persanare wants… this one to live forever, and this one wants to live forever. So it seems that they're basically perfect together. should just run off together A: i am not the one that he wants. He has made it explicitly clear “The one that he wants is rejected by the universe and you are the next closest thing X: if he hadn’t made it clear he didn’t want you would your answer change? A: no? I don’t really care for him and he’s harmed those i care about. R: yeah he sucks lmao A: though this body may share a history with him, i have no emotion towards him “We need velkrion. And u will stop the production of the golden cores. “It was your handiwork that did this, asper.” A: not me “A continuation of you. I am a continuation of my will, and you are a continuation of your will. Z: if asper is a different person in the body, does that still count as immortality “No, it doesnt.” A: we are separate souls “And if ur immortality means keeping them chained forever? A: i will find a way to free them “There is no other way A: i will find one. I will have eternity “After you achieve it, i expect no more than 50 years. How long will you take to free them? A: i do not know “Then we will make the choice for you A: i will accept that “The previous sects you killed were not killed. You kidnapped them A: what does this mean, they were taken to velkrion? “They are. We believe there’s a pseudo-habitat where they can cultivate before their cores are ripped out “There are places that our spies cant get, and the weapon we wanted has disappeared into the depths of space.” Z: we got someone in there “Thats fine” X: was that guy immortal? “Yes” X: bonus points! “The credicites are invincible rn. And they appear to be until all of them are reunited to form a whole body. It appears to be why they cast out one.” “You could gather the credicites if you know of them. We will also be masquerading ur movements. We’ll give you a beacon to summon the emperor.” A: voz? “Not quite, he simply sent a trail for us to follow. This will be the highest honor. And the immortal will be tricky, try to preserve its own life, as they do.” Z: what happened to persanare when we were unconscious? “He saw us surrounding him and he fled like a coward instead of a human for the last time in his fucking life.” “You ought to thank us. All immortals should. Isnt that right 26 and asper?” A: bc we still live? “no. bc his blood pumps and he feels fear.” A: ….thank you “You could also go to 26’s old sect. Might be a smart maneouver. If theres anything the imperium can do for you, know our eyes are unfortunately elsewhere, but our body stretches wide across the stars.
M: um! Is there any chance u could pick up the last 2 of our vocaloids, Kagamine Rin and Kagamine Len? Their bodyguard killed themself “Of course. Where do you want them to meet with you?”
M: at 26’s sect! We’ll go there next!
26: planet of Jade Mekasa. M: ty! Very kind! “Anything for you hatsune miku.” Z: can u help us locate velkrion? “We’ve attempted, but its deep in aetherion space. It moves whenever we try to go. We know a rough location, a 3x3x3 light cube.” A: shall we still anticipate voz traveling with us? “Ofc. we’ve allowed him to retain his memories. Those previously forgotten that he now has access too A: that is v nice
“Can you trick Velu Shineleaf into a meeting at a predetermined location? A: will you kill him? “We plan to kidnap him, torture him, and then kill him. Theyre wanna be immortals. (the 100 dont age while in the network.) “There’s also the unfortunate loss of life with androidkind that we wouldnt want to occur.”
“This has to do with the…. Augmented human.” M: blackhole? “Yes. not technically immortal, but still aiding them.”
Explain we need Veskarium cordyceps for the anti-lemadko’s biomort plan “It would be wise for you to collect them yourselves. We’ll give u the location.” “Hatsune miku would u like our own vocaloid to travel with you?” M: yay! Teto is nice! “Your ship is…. Small. Do you want another for your fleet that was previously owned by a former emperor?”
“It does only have 5 beds outside of the small crew quarters below, if thats ok.” “Teto can accompany you. We can make the pure luxury belong to the vocaloids who would be more than happy to share, im sure.” M: we always share! “Do you have anyone good enough to pilot these vehicles?” “Teto can take over piloting.” “I am sorry for your losses” to rip and zmena R: what?
“Your father.” R: yes. Um “It is a shame he was taken before his time.” R: u kinda scared me there ngl Z: ty im hoping things can be fixed soon “I’m sorry their kind kidnapped one of our people.” Z: our people? “Mortals, but…” turns to general, he turns into a starfish and then back to his general form “i myself am but a human. One that will be forgotten by the annals of history.” Z: good to see another of my kind safe M: u may be forgotten but all the good things u do wont “Exactly. And i can continue my work with a smile.”

Sexico-6, Denpakant
Group 1 Soma - Kasper Haven Group 2 Contemplative - Ithax Patch Vintovka Group 3 Giantess - Sacrament Konbini “Now arent you just the cutest little thing!” S: that’s might kind, i havent been towered over like this since i was real young “Is that smth you’d want? To feel young again?” S: not particularly? Thanks tho!
“Yknow i respect the Aetherion Corporation, i dont work for free. 5 credits for a bit of my time?” Ko: we’re not buying anything S: but we are here to discuss with these fine ladies, itd be polite to give them some payment in exchange for their time. That being said can i borrow 3 credits, im in debt Ko: no “You wouldnt want to deny sacrament the experience?” Ko: i already called dibs on this romance route, i need u to back off, no doubles S: what Ko: dw about it kitten S: ok yay “Listen. We arent competing, we can work together” S: competing??? Ko: why are we here S: she works for this establishment! It might be uncomfortable if we’re all crowding around! “Try not to swarm the girls, there are plenty of us spread out. Im the only one who could take someone of sacraments stature” Shes 25’ tall S: given myself it may not be the most helpful if im looming vaguely over the shoulder “U dont need to worry abt looming over my shoulder” S: thats true! S: can i pay a slightly reduced rate “What do you got?” Konbini looks around, sees they have braindances Sacrament notices that she seems antsy, oblivious to her feelings “Youre not offput by the tallfolk would u be konbini?” Ko: no S: thats good! Thats a concern when meeting new ppl. Oh im sorry i didnt get ur name
“They call me Mayla, the Beshemoth.” S: lovely name mayla “Cmon over here, i can give u a few mins of my time for free” Holds out her hands to pick up sacrament, she accepts Picks up sacrament, takes her to a backroom S: i wouldnt want to be unfair, id pay u what i can, i have 2 credits “For you, that’s plenty. Konbini, how about you? It is five per person” Ko: ill give u 6 if u stop flirting with her “That seems fine???” 6 to not do her job S: oh was she flirting, i can never tell with that stuff Ko: yeah i know Group 1 Kaspar approaches slowly
Ka: hi. Um. i’m a student of Shiori’s? We came for another reason, but… “How she’s doing after everything?” Ka: not dead? At least not to my knowledge. She’s been in hiding. For a little bit “And she hasnt come out given the state of things?” Ka: nnno she’s more in hiding. I was spending a lot of time with her up until the scarring. But idk where she is anymore “Still, a friend of hers is a friend of mine. But you seem heavily armed, friend.” Ka: ummm. Yeah. we’re not here on business from shirori, but… I thought it would be best to introduce myself first. My name is kaspar, ive heard good things about you? “Well. if you don’t mind disarming, u can do whatever u want here, so long as we provide.” “We’d never hurt a customer. So what will you have?” Ka: i think sacrament has already made a decision? Ka: we were given an assignment to repossess sexico-6 and we dont want that to happen, find another way to make this work out for the both of us. “Who gave you this?”
Ka: the Blind Halloways. “What are they offering?”
Ka: we need access to the university, and their offer is either a month of work, far too long, we need in now, or take you down, which isnt going to happen. “Why not just kill them and take access to the tunnels yourself? H: cause we didn’t actually meet the guy in charge. We met a guy with his face and a bunch of APVs. “I don’t know where to find him but I know the other 3 gangs in this town would
Dead Yield, Wakehands, Signal Saints “So why don’t you just go kill them? H: That’s an option. “You’re going to have to kill eventually. Kaspar getting her phone number Group 2
Velvet-Above-All “do you believe in hedonistic philosophy?” I: uhhhhhhh. Uh. idk do you? V: bartender, probably P: i dont think more happiness is great for a lifestyle “Oh! Why?” P: its a balance, if you get too happy ur brain will adapt and then that will be ur baseline “Some people need a little pain to feel pleasure” P: ppl in my office arent having a pleasant experience V: how many times have u had to pull smth out of someone’s butt? A lot “We have also had to pull things out of people’s butt.” P: ive removed guns from there, its not pleasant (no extensive medical history) P: i think vintovka might have thoughts on hedonistic philosophy V: people do ti?? “Do u do it?” V: not really? I just live. Get thru the day. Theres another day. Just keep going. “U should try hedonism” P: u should not V: lot of angel and devil on my shoulder here! I: u day drink??? V: thats different “Not really” We head out Go find a payphone to stand next to to contact the signal saints
Konbini googling them on stringfinder’s phone Eventually, the cameras all slowly turn to face konbini and sacrament Not very mysterious, and walking as if he doesnt seem to think of us fully as a threat
One joins, mostly disrobed outside of pants, soaking in moisture. Odd coral man approaches
Ko: are u one of the signal saints “I might be. I do need to know how come u have one of our former members phones” Ko: i killed him “Why??” Ko: under the illusion he was a threat, a traitor? He was getting in the way of things we were doing “So you killed him for me?” Ko: yeah just for you kitten Walks over and grabs her shoulders. Does a kissing motion on the cheek Ko: whoa hey. “Well thank you. It is always good to have reverence, isnt it?” Ko: i was hoping you could help me, with this offering. We’ve been trying to get into quanverium university To sacrament “are you with her?” S: yeah “Then i hereby induct u into my cult” S: cult???? “Soon to be religion.” S: id love to hear the details Ko: im sure you mean GANG, right “Gang is improper, we follow the laws of god, not the laws of man.” S: how many members are in this cult of urs? Out of curiosity “Members or associates?” S: id love to know both really “Well only one of you can be a member, decide amongst you 2.” Ko: thatd be me “Whats your name?” Ko: Id like to consider myself the new stringmaster “YOU ARE NOT THE STRINGMASTER.” Ko: sorry i read the room wrong! Stringfondler it is “Oh thats fine. What does it means to fondle strings to you?” Ko: i like to get up and close to the code. Fondle it “I would like to fondle the strings. I agree. But as the newest member there are dues to be paid” Ko: yeah? “Operating costs. 100 credits” Ko: i have that! I foresaw it due to fondling the strings! “It is good to meet someone who’s so quick to enlightenment. Maybe at some point we could fondle the strings together.” Ko: lets build up to that, nothing too fast “And your request?” Ko: where the blind holloways are “An old car warehouse.” he gives the pin “I believe that there is only about 7 of them.” Ko: just in the warehouse? “They might do small patrols, but i imagine in the warehouse at any given time.” Ko: i assume u venerable signal saints might have access to building blueprints, layout? “It consists of 3 rooms. Also a secret entrance.” (outside of garage, which is main way to enter, there is another way in an alley, mechanical secret door. Doesnt know how it works but knows it exists.) Have no computer abilities, pathetic show of display We go to another alley Ithax can lead us to the mechanical door Kick it open Otherside of 2nd door, people are shifting and moving bc they heard it open Combat
Kanren has a pager like device thats going off IT WAS A BOMB Haven looks at the last guy and goes “Sit the fuck down if you wanna live” Guy sits, thus ending the combat One guy confused “i think it was on the boss’s computer?” “Im free to go?” We threaten him, he seems to get the memo to Not Say Shit Konbini checks out the computer Ko: it appears might have been a hellknight undercover? Hidden deep in the files
Bomb is often used by Concordian Hellknights to ensure they take down whoever they were fighting
S: he was Aedryn Ko: not a friend? S: not a coworker
Could be a blackstain on her record for a recruit to have killed a Hellknights We find the records of the illicit substances, who owes what money, go thru something called Casey’s Garage Garages are often used bc. If cars pull in at weird hours it doesnt pull suspicion Few things on gangs, most blind halloway Did have suspicions of copaxi man, considered him a schemer, mightve thought he knew abt his hellknight stuff

You know what you stand here on trial for?”
S: yes i am aware sir Crinz Griftol “Are you in active pursuit of any cultists rn?”
S: yes the Signal Saints cult, we have infiltrated their organization and are investigating the members so we can confirm their total numbers and organization before i put in a finalized report
Lorvus Thane Message to her “the signal saints are small scale, is that all youve managed to do since then?” S: SHUT THE HELL UP THANE I AINT ON TRIAL TO YOU
S: we’re also following up on a clue from the cultist from my apartment building, there was a data drive from which we recovered for a location in the Quanverium University.
“Quanverium? How will you get past the Veskarium?”
S: we’ve identified a smuggling route used by the Blind Halloways, we’ve gained access to it. Its how the incident occurred “We’ll grant you a parole of 10 days to fill it. I recommend writing up ur findings digitally and physically so it can be passed along.” He’ll send a message to the Black Curtain about what they want Sacrament is released Lorvus “From one initiate to another, i would suggest finding smth better than smth at a university if you want to live?” S: is that so, thane? What have you been up to then?
“I found a group of cannibals. Been researching them.” S: alright. They gonna give you the kill?
“I think so! There’s plenty in Annwn, theres a reason they sent me there and ur stuck in Denpakant” S: im sure there’s cults enough to go around. Im sure there are. U aint the only one getting a promotion “Yeah, of course. We have plenty of rivals. Let me rephrase; i have plenty of rivals. You only have me.” S: some of us dont have parents to get us into the order already “You’re right, you don’t have parents.” Sacrament storms out, whacks him on the back The rest of us have 15 days before we’d be executed Kaspar growls at lorvus as she leaves the room “Sacrament, train your dog.” On the way back S: sorry, hes always like that Kaspar is mad, goes to yell at konbini Hiyori leaves the stream v quick Ka: theres this fucking asshole, im so pissed (signing big hands, talking loudly, all of her energy is at this twink) Ko: name and face? Ka: Lorvus Thane, he’s this elf twink, bragging so much, i dont give a shit ur going to find cannibals, u dont need to be a dick, im not anyones dog Ko: cannibals?? Ka: smth, idk, it wasnt important to me Ko: sounds a little important Ka: idk ask someone else who cares more, i dont remember, thats not my thing Konbini goes back to computer: good night soulmaids,, smth else has come up! Lorvus Thane has his own webpage He made an AI chatbot thats modeled on his own speech patterns in case you want to talk to him Has his whole family lineage, his family was an Original Elven Hellknight Address listed He hangs out around bars doing research into cannibalism Konbini sends 3 none pizza left beef to lich guy again
Kaspar texts soma: hi Soma. we r looking for a info broker because we are looking for information ? do you know of someone we could ask thank yuo :)
Rockathor, her gf, may have info V: i have a way with info broker. We either meet with someone im hesitant to introduce u, we get in for free, or we pay an introduction fee of 200 credits per person. Vintovka hits up her girl, she asks a timeframe, we say like. 2 days We head rest and head out the next day Able to take an old sewer that goes into the back entrance to the school, built into the sunside with a dome around it, allows ppl to see the sun. allow them to enjoy the actual light instead of artificial light Many university campuses within bubbles to enjoy campus life The one we’re looking for is #C8 Area is sealed, odd adamantine shutters that are retroactively installed Opening or closing a shutter takes 30 seconds There’s smth Weird abt the dome inside Looks thru a tinted window at the sun Gyroscope going thru the middle tracks movement of planets in our solar system Notably, they messed up on the backend, but to open any double doors we need the principal access key Shuffling thru the hallway and the like Combat Flickerwisp is completely immune to magic A gluttonyspawn is here
From immortal runelords
Depending on who u talk to, they would be considered a cult. Not to Aetherion Hellknights tho Are under the imperium tho Spiderwebbed up cafeteria full of thingies Opposite is double doors for the library Full of gluttonyspawns Further down is the principal’s office Konbini starts to access the network or whatever Various pictures of vlaka on his desk No ID in his desk, but does have billing info for research into the Pillars of Senaria 6 pillars on the planet Was paid abt 100k credits to his personal account for it That doesnt count donations to the university from anonymous donors Konbini hits the All Door Unlocking Procedure There is a green car coming towards here alone, seems civilian in make Symbols of broken standard hidden on it Hear multiple doors open Creatures in cafeteria get ready to move out We run to the library Can see that the person has started to unlock the doors We fight more sinspawn

Quanverium University, Denpakant
We flee, just in time to see mafilus to shoot into the school that we just left and light it on fire Then see him go to the next school, which is locked down He wouldve had to skip multiple schools to get to ours without us noticing them We head on back with thru roundabout ways Rest for the night During the time away, the journal was written in
Talking abt the time watching the game since Lyka Stars in Water wasnt in good enough health to travel
Pulya appears on the floor, goes to Vintovka’s apartment “Are they coming too?” V: we normally meet elsewhere, one of our members is on the larger size. Follow me “Of course.” Has a bright smile when she goes to see us “pleasure to meet you all. You need to get in with an info broker?” H: that’s the ideal “Yes or no” H: yes “Vintovka you vouch for them?” V: they havent tried to kill me yet (dont give away any info for free, hell have things cost, if u pay for the question he’ll answer, he’ll sell anything we say there) She has something for us, a small thing that she’ll give if we dont ask any questions about it. Some preloaded tickets for the train, they seem to never run out
(theyre almost certainly taken from Wakehands officials. Dont seem to be gotten by violence, since none have signs of scratches, havent been cleaned. But somehow she got them from wakehands.)
Going to Rudrani, which is next to Lorvus Thane’s operations
Havkai has an official office, with secretaries who wave at pulya They ask her something telepathically She verbally responds “oh you dont need to collect their ids. They can keep their weapons too.” Shirren man waves behind his desk, shakes our hands “Pleasure doing business. Who am i speaking to?”
“Are we talking about Sixlux Stars in Water?” K: uhhh well no but u have info? “I do. It goes for 10k.”
(he has statues of dwarves, but doesnt wear aetherion colors. Is from the border region between aetherion and Solara Imperium. Worships Tharaxa Silveneth ) “You must have sought me out for a reason. So please help me help you. You can sell info if you need info. ” S: main reason we’re here is for information regarding lorvus thane. We know his whereabouts and some of his recent activities, but are hopin to find additional dirt i suppose “How bad of dirt do you need?” H: how much is baseline on him? “To get him kicked out? 100k. But 1k is decent dirt.” S: how much information regarding the recent happening at quanverium university would get us? “For verification of what we already believe? 2k.”
S: we were at the quanverium university, we saw mafilus from The Broken Standard shooting and burning down the buildings that were destroyed. “Perfect. Whos bank account does it go to?” H: ill take it He prints it out, tells us to cash it with his secretary but itll expire in 2 weeks. In case we need to do tax fraud “They wont turn you into ashes by laser, theyll behead you. They incinerate your body afterwards.” S: oh ok. thats fine. S: we’re also searching for info regarding cult activities that- “Youre gonna have to be more specific.” S: im clarifying! Ithax sells the info on the butcher for 1.2k Hands it over
S: additional info about Onmagakar? “I can sell the group he was apart of for a mere 300.” We agree “It’s none. He wasn’t part of a cult. He was being used. Sort of. By who, i can tell for a mere 1k.”
“He was being used by his son who was also not part of the cult.” We ask abt the name of the cult “I cant sell that to you. There’s nothing i wont sell. I can’t sell.” (orders from higher up could block him from passing it out. Will say that the same way if they dont know or cant speak. Not allowed to give a separate answer.) Sell sinspawn info, get 50 creds Bc we did 200 creds worth of person per deal, we are invited back Go back to our apartment 6 pages, can decipher a page a day Downtime Day 1
1st part: he sortve wrote a thesis statement, in the correct occult terminology. His understanding that the pillars of senaria can be entered and that someone entering them set off the scarring. They dont know which was entered, all the pillars react the same when u enter based on the ritual that he describes later. A week after the person entered, the scarring began. (7 geographical pillars that reside around the planet, 2 that are directly in the dark and sunside, the other 5 are in the ring where ppl can live. Giant pillars of effectively stone.) Vintovka at the end of the day is offered a job. Look outside an alley, shoot anyone that runs thru it while other members take care of things™ 2 days time Sacrament sends a text to her friend, id like to set up a meeting When? Where? <3 Sometime this week, my apartment? 2 days? Sure! That works. How about the garden down by your floor? That sounds good to me. Day 2 2nd page: son describes in vague detail a baptism that can be done on others to allow them to enter. Hes come to the realization based on unethical experiments by making a created creature speak it or writing it down, the body becomes inert and the flesh withers away leaving only ur heart beating Now that the building is open, no weird movement for the hologram door Konbini trying to contact the signal saints Sees pizza boys number blasted on the forum
Able to get in contact w some people, just send a message with stringfinder’s sim card
She sends a message out to Signal Saints, hey love what u guys are doing with the place. Can i get involved more with ur day to day “Connect ur phone to ur VR headset.” She enters their custom VR chatroom, her model is Hiyori Surprisingly active chatroom, ppl moving around. Ppl looking and look down at her. A bored businessman (mocking caricature) “you really arent a fan of her arent you?” Ko: wdym? “Joined once, worst stream of my life.” Ko: i think shes cool, but to each their own “Wahts your name?” Ko: they call me the stringfondler
“The Root Witness.” Ko: thats what they call me “No im the root witness. Youre the stringfondler.” Ko: nice to make ur acquaintance root witness. Whatre you up to
“You dont happen to be the one that duped that group into taking out the Blind Halloways are you?” Ko: i wasnt there yknow. What happened?
“Well. the person that killed stringfinder and took his place understood prisms magnificent motions and sent a group of 6 with them to kill the blind halloways. Prism did sell the info of a hellknight killing another hellknight to their own organization. I do have to ask, what does it mean to you to fondle strings?” Ko: yknow i like to reach deep into the code. Big fan of backend “If youre going to talk like this, we have a separate chatroom for talk like that.” Ko: sorry im new i just got inducted. If u could show me around thatd be great. U seem like such a cool guy. Very handsome He’ll lead her into another server
Go in, see he’s changed model into a sexy Highwayman from Reddy. Konbini plays a real sexy maid Ko: daddy kitten does know the rules of the cult, if only someone would teach her
Major leadership, gives the 3 in charge: Prism, Last Login, and Archive Ghost
She takes off the helmet, sees Al staring Ko: how did u get in??? “Key??? Its anime night???” Patch going to the poison floor to grab poison
Ixil is operating it, Madrosarai Day 3
Page 3: hes figured out the right incantation to enter a pillar, the one in Limaurrio. Allows those that have been baptized to go in Pillar Locations
Annwn - Α-Cl2Y1
Vitiae - Σ-Co2X2
Squeli - Δ-Co2Y1
Walqirae - Ω-Cl1Y3
Limaurrio - Ω-Co1Z3 Center Dark Center Light Sacrament, goes on a nice garden date with a librarian Grabs a book out of her room, gives it to her “Would u like another one?” S: no thank you. Maybe dependin on how this week goes, but id rather not borrow theres a chance i get executed soon. So just in case. “...is this an aetherion joke?” S: no. i wish. I might get executed bc of work. I hope it doesnt happen “Why???” S: just. Stuff. Killed someone i hadnt realized i wasnt supposed to and didnt find out til later. “Surely they wont kill u over a misunderstanding?” S: they would. I have time tho to give info that may be enough so they dont kill me. Im hopeful. Ive got my friends workin on it. “You have other friends?” S: yeah i have friends “I told you you would! U should introduce me.” S: I could see if anyone’s not busy if u want to meet people! Takes her to meet the party S: i dont see vintovka, but u can meet everyone else
Her name is Altania Vintovka, she gets the first trickles of ppl running out, initially soldiers. 1 or 2 max for every couple of minutes Taking them out Eventually as the defenses fall, the families start emerging She doesnt hesitate Solid 5 hours worth, 20 dead bodies from the alleyway Meanwhile, we have a time with altania She asks us how we met. Serial killer
“A classic whodunnit? Like Dick Mullen?” I: exactly! “Are you the dick then?” I: i am. Would you like to see my boards? “I’d love to!” He shows the boards, particularly the butcher one Shes interested in the board™ Day 4 Crit success! Baptism is complicated, described next few pages Biggest thing is that it uses poisons. 2 definitive people need to die for it. 1 person is the vessel (imbibing poisons and such) able to mark a person (kill them). The person who was killed has their organs removed, has sigils. The vessel then uses a poisonous knife to allow the people they stab to enter the pillar as they are effectively baptized
Once the scarring has started, the 2nd scarring is due in 6 months. This will continue until the population hits 0. Seems to be based on the rate that senaria rotated around itself before it became a tidally locked planet.
The next scarring is due in 4 months To enter a pillar will immediately activate the next round of the scarring. Vintovka tells us:
A young Wakehands leader, Chiwozivo, is about to make a move to secure a water treatment plant in a month's time in order to exert her control over the populace. She will then rig it to blow should he manage to take it over in order to keep it under his control. Pulya is keeping you posted since she doesn’t know where Chiwozivo is holed up yet. Day 5 Vintovka is rewarded for what she did, someone left baked goods outside her door the next day Missed vintovka the prev day Final page: the only way to perma stop the scarring is to enter the pillar. Notes make note of no idea what happens if the person who has a scar gives birth or is cloned off planet. But everyone born on planet has a scar Able to tell that some was transcribed after his death by an autorecording device Sacrament goes to the judgement hall Skittermander looks down at her “speak!” S: i reached out bc i gained some info and id like advice what would be the best way to defend myself usin it based on what we’ve learned “A wise decision, what have u learned?”
S: we have the names of the 3 leaders of the Signal Saints, and we have access to their virtual meeting rooms. We can continue to gain further info from that, we have someone that’s infiltrated it. The main thing here is that we’ve discovered info abt the scarrin. “What of it?” S: it… there’s a ritual that can be done to enter the pillars of senaria. By doin so it will trigger a scarrin and even if that doesnt happen, they’ll continue every 6 months until there are no people left. But due to part of the ritual, my companions and i were marked as bein able to enter the pillars, which appears to be the only way to stop the scarrin.
“Well ur invaluable. The main issue is taht ur assassination is not mine but the black curtain. They’re an anti-gang org!” S: oh! Well. that is a bit of an issue. “Well… you have spoken true, no?” S: yes, i have!
“Ah… well… i can claim Subruga. I will act as you and you will do whatever they say. If you fail, i will be executed. If you fail and dont die in the process, know i will execute u myself!” S: well that’s fair. Youd do that for me? “If you can stop the scarring. Do you know how many cultists have appeared since then?” S: idk “Many. they even spread thru unscrupulous means, like the VR chats or the message boards.” S: mmm cultrist. I know it well. I think ur right sir we must do whatever we can to stop these cultists “Kill every one you see. Theyll be given a fair trial in front of every devil they worship. Theyll be sent to hell, but their devils wont accompany them. They’ll be sent to ours.” S: we did hear abt the movements of mafilus of the broken standard is that smth theyd be interested in? “He’s untraceable. He cant be seen on cameras.” S: we saw him with our eyes. He shot me. “It would be interesting to bring up. But dont mention he didnt give chase. It would seem that u were in collusion!” S: that and the possibility of us ending the scarrin might be enough. And the signal saints. Or should i look for more?
“Theres a way that works for both of us. U ingratiate urself with the signal saints, and since theyre going in Wakehands territory, take out the wakehands. And become close with the leader.” S: ty for ur assistance “And when u are able to enter the pillar, do you need assistance with it?” S: ummm might be best if we do this ourselves, we know we’ve been baptized for it but the process of getting more people is not an unacceptable loss of life, but. “Start it as soon as possible!” “Do it and i will put my life on the line for you.” He wants us to enter the pillar Immediately Go to the apartment to collect people Reconvene, we discuss We go to the nice park, walking thru the nice park that was built around the pillar Pillar is several miles in radius, extends far into the sky This area put equivalent of christmas lights onto the area There’s a touristy kinda dock that allows u to get close where u’d normally take photos. Obv not many people post scarring Able to do our chant Able to enter…. Kaspar is immediately be able to tell smth is odd bc she can Hear Now Falling thru dizzying colors and lights, body effectively spagettified, feels like we’re falling thru the center of the world Kaspar fortitude save, passes out from the experience Lands in an odd black sea Only one who seems to remain conscious is patch, who lands with the others nearby in inky blackness Odd ruins of spiral patterns, falling in and bobbing Hes able to figure out what happened, all of us switched senses and minds, kaspar got someones hearing and so on so forth. The ritual isnt built for multiple ppl, so causes confusion and uncomfort We wake up 1-3 hours later Can move fairly freely in the tar-substance Patch puts sticky notes on everyone that just say “brb” before looking around and scouting Walks around and gets totally lost. Seems to circle back and forth with an odd nauseating feeling Sun and moon are in fixed positions in the sky Ithax and Kaspar wake up next K: ithax that was so fucking weird I: huh? K: i could hear dude I: that’s super weird. Oh shit brb K: patch isn’t here huh. Can smell where he’s gone cause the black tar doesn’t have any properties K: ithax are u good if i try to track him down? I’m real good at tracking sometimes I: sure, do u want me to stay here? Activities. “Phrase it as one?” I: how much to know the cost of current living members and their whereabouts? “300 credits.” No one has died since he last checked I: crazy. Thank you.

Some people have been having prophetic dreams, and some people tried to capture it on camera, but it’s hard.” Konbini texts gravesends ‘what abt those beasts spawning, what do u know beautiful overlords xoxo’ “What have you done for me today minion?” ‘I’ll be back soon to play that video game with you. Unless u want me to do ritual sacrifice rn’ “No. We’ll kill another cult member.” ‘Btw we may haev to kill this gang leader horvenal’ “Who????” ‘Will get back to u soon on that cult kill lol’
Go back to suimin “I found one! I found a cult member. Are you ready to kill her?” Ko: indoctrinating or is it off the table “No we shouldnt indoctrinate another cult’s member, that’s rude.” Theyre like 100miles away. Teleports konbini “Did u know the spell mishap is dangerous for the living if we turn up on the sunside or moonside?” Ko: if we do get blasted can u teleport us back? “I think it’d be best to walk it and then teleport after we’ve killed her.” Ithax and Sacrament tag along Closer to sunside “Cmon its this way.” Skitters down the street “We could make the hoverboard a sign of our cult.” Ko: thatd be cool, the symbol could be one “No…” Ko: is that lame or smth “No just reminded me of a time.” Ko: so this cultist? Ko: which cult are they apart of “Thats a secret, lets see if u can figure it out urself!” Ko: can i have a name? “For her?” Ko: yeah! “No.” Blasts at the lock, looks at a woman catatonic on the bed. Eyes forward towards the sunset “There she is! She shouldnt put up much of a fight.” (signs of a cult, her hands are tattooed. Around where the fingers meet the actual palm, caterpillars eating a larger caterpillar.) “Well here you go!” hands a knife Ko: uhh. Sorry miss. Looks like its your time. Idk? I: who is this person? “Oh idk who she is?” Ko: was ur only identifier her tattoos “No i have ways. Theyre far too arcane for u to understand.” (konbini googling tattoos, nothing comes up. Page fails to load, internet speed slows to a crawl before it entirely disconnects.) (not signal saints) Konbini stabs, sees blood, 2 whole minutes between them Ko: idk if im wise enough “Youll get it later idk”
I: sloth runelords? “There ya go! They refuse to evolve, dragigng down the other caterpillars S: like crabs in a bucket! “Thats. …. Sure.” I: official group name? Ko: just wanna know it make our group name cooler, yknow? “Youll make a cooler one.”
“Well. they call themselves Last Sunset. Funfact, they were one of the first cults to arrive, considering it a holy land.” Ko: older than you then? “Yes but no.” “She’s not older than me but the last sunset is.” “You guys want hoverboards while we’re here?” He buys them hoverboards Another kasatha shows up
Imrek Sariin “haven how have you been? H: could be better could be worse. Didn’t expect you to show up. I thought you’d be out of here by now “We are H: you came back “We’re allowed a little bit of leave. Word is from higher up that we should prep for a second scarring. H: word is correct, should be prepared. Could stick around here for a couple days, wouldn’t need to worry about it “I’d only need to worry about deserting then. The scarring might spell my death, desertion will H: at the very least i know a way out P (groupchat): is this guy a member of your old gang? H: yeah, he is Patch analyzes target H: how have things been on your end?
“Good, we live as kings now. We took over the Vitiae district H: i heard. What’s been going on? Keeping safe? “You could come back and find out. Do u know what it’s like there? In the golden city? H: not personally “U left at the wrong time. The inner members of the gang, we live as kings up there H: i don’t think that’s worth the price “And what is now? What am i paying that no one else is paying? Everyone alive has killed someone H: can’t argue that but things start to weigh. Ur gonna regret it. “We’re all going to regret it and the scarring will kill us all. You can live in luxury, you deserve that. I’ll put in a good word and they’ll take you back instantly H: that won’t work, desertion gets u killed “Yes but we can play it as u being undercover. We could even invite all of these here Seems to be out of a sense of obligation. Does actually like haven. Sentimental cause everyone got rich while haven is stuck living like they used to Offer seems genuine though, he’s just uncertain if haven will be accepted. It’s worth the risk to him P: sorry friend of haven. We’re pretty safe where we are and idk if haven needs to go over there and murder someone during the scarring “Imrek, if you would. How do u know this place is safe? P: we have our sources H: we have good reason to believe so. At the very least we aren’t taking chances where we don’t need to be “I understand you’re risk averse. Maybe wait 2 scarring and come back? Atp we’ll have lost enough men they’d be willing to take u in H: they’re gonna get desperate “They will! And we can use that. We’re well trained, we aren’t gonna kill each other. We’ll kill other people first, just don’t be the other people P: i think we’ll be ok “Sure friend of haven P: i’m haven’s doctor, i’ll keep him alive Haven offers him a drink and they sit in awkward silence after that Cultsties return Set up the bed tundy room Itll catch people who have it on a 2nd screen Back to bed tundy Robot asks “identification?” Konbini logic bombs it Gets in, she begins hacking. Time to leave! 1 day of downtime before Haven looking for visible activity from the base It’s now haunted??? A Lot of people got slaughtered Konbini sowing rumor Kaspar trying to know abt the fighting ring and the black baron Shiori doesnt know (she doesnt deal with ‘entertainment crime’) 2 team members can get in contact Ithax sending a message to his old mentor Gather info abt the layout of the base Fastest route vs where they didnt get slaughtered Going thru warehouses and roundabout ways will be longer but we wont be up against an army of ghosts Ithax’s mentor shows up “Do you have an apartment or are you living on the street?” I: i have one, it exists. U cant see it. But we can go into my friends Go to havens. Nvm imrek is there. Goes to an empty one Man with large shield looks “Have you driven any of them insane?” I: nooo. They like me. Well im useful. “U are. If not likeable.” I: yeah…. This sounds- its going to sound crazy. But. um. There’s going to be another scarring, this building will be safe. The people within it won't be affected at all by the scarring. Ik we disagree but id never want u to kill somebody or die “Why was the cop force too harsh but u decided to ally with hellknights?”
I: i dont like the hellknights either “We arrest people, they kill people” I: i did NOT like going to hellknight court “What did they demand of you?” I: to um, they want us to kill a person, theyll forgive our crime “Youre a hired killer now?” I: so im not gonna DO it. “No, here’s what ur gonna do. Ur gonna join the actual police force, they wont execute you.” I: theyll still execute my kind and helpful neighbor! “Is she a hellknight?” I: yes! “Then she deserves to be executed.” I: i have a different way figured out that’s gonna be fine. “Of course. And the four years i spent raising u will go to waste once ur killed by hellknights. Do u know how much money the state paid to educate u? You’ve done ur security sweeps, i assume, of this floor? I: no, we haven’t checked the empty rooms “Ok, i’ll check”. Him and ithax start checking the empty rooms Mentor man enters at point first Find a body that died around a month ago, starts going through its pockets and stuff “No identification. No signs of extreme mutilation except molars with cavities were removed” Could be cults! Imrek to gravesend: do u know of any cults that remove cavities post death No “Diagnosis?” I: i think he got killed by a cult member “Why?” I: weird to remove post mortem cavity teeth “Looks at the state of the apartment. Only his cybernetic teeth were worth stealing. The eithers are in the mouth. Stop writing fiction abt people. If youre going to help people you need to ge the facts right.” Private computer server found “Signs of a technomancer.” Konbini passes into the room “Active crime scene. Who are you?” K: cecilia He pins her down bc she tries to walk past We are kinda getting peeved at him
I: officer Anrast, meet my friends. Friends, meet officer Anrast. I don’t like him but i don’t want him to die. He fucking sucks He doesnt care abt kaspar’s growl Konbini goes back to her room, her mom is bamboozled Haven follows as he continues checking rooms Next room “Looking at the signs, looks to be a dwarf that just misses bright and sunny planet. Weight of the bed is right.” He marks 2 rooms as crime scenes He has chemical strips that mark when someone’s passed thru He says ithax is getting better, but not good H: ithax is one of the best detectives i know “Then that’s unfortunate. ” H: ithax asked u to be here, but neither of u are enjoying it. No but yknow. He was invited “We can send crisis groups this way. People without families could be safe here. What’s the idea for defense?” Hes so overwhelming. Very right but He’s So Much with his orders Breaks down every potential deficiency Ithax goes thru so much nicotine. Out of physical nicotine now
