Sixlux Stars in Water doesnt move/wake up when kaspar enters Kaspar shakes her She twists, tries to cover her eyes from incoming light of the doorway K: youre here??? “Am i not allowed?” K: well its- you havent been here for months now! You disappeared with a note! Why are you here? “Bc u said its safe.” K: yeah! Was it not safe enough before? I can protect us! “Before was before the scarring. We diodnt know how unsafe itd be!” Six thinks shes a liability, tries to punch kaspar K: wtf?? “An attempt at a punch?” K: i get the point ig. Ur so smart, uve taken care of urself for so long, together we can take care of ourselves so why didnt you stay with me?? “I had a friend that needed my help. You didnt.”
K: and- our mom died six! Our mom is dead! I wouldve loved- even if i didnt need help, i wouldve loved to not be alone in our apartment with our dead mom! Idk! We dont have anything but each other now, dont we? (she begins to make some sign, kinda fidgeting and beginning the sign before the other hand stops it) “Is it not good enough that im here now?” K: i mean… ur always good enough, but i- here today is better than here tomorrow, but i wish ud been here! I found other ppl now but thats bc i didnt have anyone! U werent here six. I didnt know what to do! “Well. but now u have them instead of just me.” K: i wouldve liked to have all of you from the start. I… i like having u around, ur important to me. Ur more important than the gamers ive collected! Even so im so glad ur home, but shiori only just came back. Mac went and joined the squoxes! Like i… i was scared, and… i… idk. I guess im making it abt me. I just wish u wouldve done smth other than disappear completely “I cant change the past, but i can be here now. Sorry to return only when it was safe.” K: can you promise youll stay? “....i can promise i can try.” K: great. Ig thats the best i can ask for of anyone at this point. Where even were you?
“Over in Zal with a friend.” K: have i met this friend?
“Ibis. With Ibis.” (heard it like once or twice, maybe have seen a picture mom sent) K: well… are they safe now? “They’re gone.” K: oh… im sorry six. “Im sorry too.” She hugs, looks at the spider “You got a pet.”
K: i was killing it by being sad until like. Last week. But i got better. His name’s Baseball Kaspar lets us know in the text group chat Kaspar doesnt let us visit
Sacrament meets konbinis mom Katherine Vayne “Cecilia remember when we would make this when u were a kid?” Some sort of meat pie Ko: yeah ofc! Mom id like u to meet someone Ko: one of my new friends S: hi there Ko: she lives next door, her apartment is kinda cramped. A sleepover?
“With the hellknight???” S: hi maam im sacrament. Im a hellknight im proud of it “Why????” S: well actually its not a fun story, but ive wanted to be one since i was 6. They saved me from getting murdered “Cecilia i raised u better than this….” S: honor to meet ya maam Ko: shes taken several bullets for me!! She shakes sacraments hand “well if uve saved cecilia” S: shes my friend, im happy to do it, i feel its part of my role as a friend “Its fine, so long as u dont get her involved with the hellknight business is all i ask?” S: oh alright. Mhm. yup! She scares konbinis mom Ko: heyyy sacrament lets go ask yknow. Ithax and haven if theyd be willing to room with u S: oh i like them Leaves S: did i do bad Ko: nooo she doest like ppl much S: sorry ik ppl dont like hellknights for some reason
Al “they drew your ass on our convenience store.” Her body isnt good enough to be on the building but its on the building S: namewise its fitting “Thats probably why he did it” Ko: does it look good? “The sliding doors are your ass cheeks.” Ko: i see! Excellent work! Any advertising is free advertising! S: say al u dont find me intimidating do u “Not particularly” S: oh thats good, i think i was worried for nothin Ko: yeah shes judgemental but its fine, she cares. In her own way. S: thats good to have a mother- well i can stop the sentence there. Ko: so ur saying sacrament might have some mommy issues? S: um. Rest Go over to kaspar’s Kaspar warning their sister abt us arriving Sixlux has a slight rasp in her breath, only audible “Are these ur friends?” Ka: yes! These are the ppl that ive been sorta going around with. Haven patch ithax sacrament konbinis in the kitchen and i think vintovka is hung over P: so uh. Sixlux. Is it fine if i do a medical check up on you? Kaspar signs for him “Id rather not. Idk these ppl.” Ka: shed rather not, she doesnt know u. Sorry P: without touching, could i at least see if any damage has been done to you? “What damage could u see that i wouldnt know?” I: there’s a rasping sound to your breathing “It might be- i had to run at one point. Im not athletic. Im not as good as kaspar.” Ka: are you ok? Whyd you have to run? “Men with guns. U know how its been.” I: what have you been up to? “Trying to find a sense of community outside of here and away from here.” H: what made you come back? “Safety. And kaspar’s here.” (she left a week before the scarring) Analyze Target Finger prints r normal, but slight disruption from hand being cut open. She does have recent scarring, nothing notable. Physically weaker than sister She’s been talking with her mouth, smth her body isnt used to. Deaf ppl typically dont vocally talk, thus muscles atrophy I: what happened with the guns? “Idk, i was in the wrong place at the wrong time.” I: gang thing? Where were u
“Zal.” H: what were you doing in nenzal? “One of my friends was there, i couldnt leave.” S: stuck or smth to do? “Didnt feel i could return home until i saw on the news that it was safe.” Explain the basics of what we’ve been up to Ka: six, i peeked into ur room, and ithax went and grabbed one your journals? It was writing that u me and mom were all together and happy and like on a beach? U dont have anything set to autowrite, right? “No, it could be- didnt you have those glitch things?” Ka: yea but thats not smth they do usually. It was talking abt u and mom, and things abt us. Talking abt us watching tv when that hasnt happened “Maybe they used old entries to create a new one?” Ka: why would it do that? Idk might be nothing “Its a glitch monster.” I: im thinking abt the handwriting changes in the middle tho. Like someone trying to learn how to write as you Ka: which a could be copying ur handwriting We look at the journal, its got no new entries since she left. Theyre gone Ka: i looked everyday, it was here “Maybe it stabilized the content?” Ko: it could happen, but not likely. But could happen.
Ka: i was trying to look for u, we ran into an infobroker “Met an info broker?” Ka: trying to find into. He brokered some info “Arent they super exclusive?” Ka: didnt seem so? I asked abt u, the guy seemed to know who u were and that what uve been up to was expensive to know “Doesnt make sense. Maybe he just wanted to get as much money out of you.” “Idk how the info brokers work. I couldnt possibly figure out how that info’s so expensive.” Ka: i just wanna make sure ur notgetting caught up in (a lot of answers shes giving are technically true and possible answers. This is what an experienced spy would say. Have nothing that we could pin on them with, at least in the matter with how she mentions these things.)
Put our nervousness on Onmagakar snapping ithax’s neck and his son being relevant She doesnt react to his name/son She leaves
Gravesend walks thru the wall and wants to talk to konbini “Would u consider yourself a smart person?” Ko: yeah i would “We can make ourselves intelligent gamers. We can require an IQ test to join the test” Ko: how’d we make sure theyre smart enough “I can curse a computer, if u fail it itll evaporate ur soul” Ko: office room with a computer? “No i think we hide the computers around the community.” Ko: thats fun. U have some good ideas pizza man “Thank you cecilia.” Ko: i can get on board, do we just curse computers “I think by the end of the week i need u to curse 5 computers” Ko: idk how to do that. I can hack real good? I can put a logic bomb in one “Do you know how to damn a soul?” Ko: no sir! I cant say that i do (u need a living sacrifice over the pc tower) Ko: kill someone over a computer? “Kinda we need to do a binding circle over the motherboard” Ko: can i learn that or. Idk. also the scarring Hell figure out how to get a tome going for her Konbini checks to see if theres any computers she can take over in the building for protection There’s deep in the files, direct contact line for security system. Unlikely to go thru, but we can try Send to automated system, ask for building, whats the emergency / request We have a safe haven for coming apocalypse or that we’re abt to make a big sale Say we have a safe haven, we’re gonna charge entry (we’re not) Talk to a human!
“Tartrok! How may i help you?” K: tech support for suimin, we need some automatic turrets sent over, we’ve confirmed this is a safe area from the scarring, we think we can turn a profit if we charge entry “Would u say its highly raidable?” K: yes “Could i know who i’m speaking to?” K: [random name off payroll]
“Well Demerity your voice sounds oddly high, are you feeling alright?” K: ive been thinking of a gender change, doing voice training. How do you think? “Sounds lovely. What kind of package do you want? We could have any that annihilates anything within 300 meter radius without an id.” K: othjers? “Standard security, any full force could get thru, but itd slaughter the front lines.” K: standard sir “Understood! And how will you be paying for this?” K: send an invoice to xyz email Goes to hack a card “We dont take credit, need payment in full upfront. Only 200k credits.” She finds an account, of general savings for repair for the complex. “Understood, if this bounces back, the turrets will turn against u. Are you sure u want to use this method?” K: of course
“Well thank you very much. Armin Armaments are happy to work with you. We’ll get the contractor in.”
Others go to Vossk Irontether around the same time Tell him to lower the shutters at midnight “May we all survive this one.” Knock at the desk
“Son Vamo, here from Armin Armaments.” “Now my lord has seen it fit that you have the best in security.” “Monsieur Armin.” “Anything i could assist u with, any particular concerns in security” First 10 floors did get wiped “Is the first 10 prone to raiding?” Yeah “Could i recommend our cry for help modules there then?” They hack the comms of allies We tell abt the door thats fucked up, theyll fix it and reinforce it “Do you need anti air cannons?” “I wouldve gone with the 300 meter package, razed the entire area around here, but ur the customer and the customer is correct. For this, if you want to be passive, teh call for help package for first 3 floors, thatd get all those with a kind heart.” “If i could, id recommend a full 360 system. Middle of that courtyard, theyre accessible by heavy machinery, id recommend a missle system. Bee swarm?” Discuss it, we do a more passive system I: we run into a surprising number of magic users “We have some detect magic, if u want we can install some small plates that would let you know when magic is cast near it.” I: any cybersecurity, like turrets getting hacked? “At armin armaments we have a backend that wont get hacked, u only need to give us a call.” Side of the building is a beautiful woman, thin and not so bodacious as the other art. Kinda slim and humble, undeniably beautiful. Not pornagraphically hentai proportions P accurate anatomy To the haunted military base Ithax identified route, least haunted route Contains backup supplies for machinery Big door we go thru takes 20 mins to open, as is standard for expensive replacement gear. Not meant to be accessed quickly. Very few ppl in the base tried to use the 20min door to escape, but it connects to the center of the base The center is where the haunting will begin Security robots want identification A ghost fucks up the party We call up pizzalich to come help us He wants us to kill an atlas group member, between 2 of his picks He shows up, guards us Send out our warning signal
Next week the scarring will begin

It just seems so familiar but i can’t put a name to it Also talk about ithax & his not dad Rest During the cult hours We’re dressed in anonymous gray shadows that cover avatars Explain the entirety of the plan Set off various bombs on the railway. Too destroyed to be fixed during the next scarring, where ppl are gonna be too isolated. Can spread the good word of how wifi can save all Konbini gives us all the details Places, dates, people Theyre gonna do this as soon as the next scarring starts Theres 25ish Confirmed signal saint members, but many more unconfirmed.
Meet and fuck with The Gravesends Lathers them up with oil, presents his engraved ivory dildo with gem balls He asks if they want any of them
Black Baron meetup Encounter an urog at the front “Hm. and what are you here for? We have a friend in the tournament
(fighting a water based contemplative that is called The Flow of Life) Meet and fuck Men and women are getting ready As ppl begin lining up, odd murmur and then the sound of 1k naked butt cheeks falling to the ground 2 ppl, after having arranged it for this Lovejoy has a cooler, newer lich He says “hi” in a shaky voice Konbinis respect for him has shot up 1k points Konbini and sacrament are entranced by her Everything outside of her stops existing Both leave? Konbini can turn around for a second, sees head in hands strapped up lich crying as everyone leaves “What is your truest desire? Carnal, of course.” S: havent thought abt it before. “You dont need to think, just feel.” K: easy. (looks at sacrament) Feels the slap of a kitten on sacraments butt, not much force due to size and weight difference Sacrament wraps her tail around konbini, dismissed into their own corner while the others line up The ppl are fucking This room of vitality, where only undead are immune Some ppls hearts fill so much of vitality that they suffer a heart attack and die She puts her foot on the persons chest, kicks them to the floor, lich drags them away and another takes their place So long as they follow their lust they dont need to get too close to the danger zone Fade to black fucking Black baron Send ithax as our representative I: thanks for meeting, my name is ithax “What can i do for you?”
I: we were hoping to get ur assistance with a matter concerning your friend Horvenal “Hellknights want him dead?” I: yes “The one, your friend sacrament.” I: yes “I was warned of it.” I: we would like to not kill him, he seems lovely as a community organizer, hasnt done anything wrong? “So why not kill sacrament?” I: shes one of the 7 ppl that can stop the scarring “I thought there were only 6 now.” I: …..yes. Sorry. “Sorry for your loss. Anything to drink?” I: thatd be great “Malt liquor?” I: thanks. We’d like to… make it look like he died, let sacrament go. If sacrament dies, we all die
“Failed to mention that. Sir Escane stopped by.” I: ah. I see. Yeah, i um…. They… to my understanding, those in the business of eliminating gangs the scarring is very lucrative time to do so. “Escane’s a cruel man.” I: he is. “How about we kill him together?” I: i mean… if that’s… i’m not the strongest, but- “No, hes too strong for either of us. But know whos he’s not? I was born of one.” I: sun??? “No, an explosion.” “Youre a kind man, im a kind man, thats why i run this ring. I’m not asking for you to kill them. Im asking if theres any hellknights u dont like, attach a bomb to them, and the second they enter the hall of judgement….” “You do that, i make sure our good friend dies.” I: works for me. “Would u like to play any of the games? Anyone u’d wish to fight?” I: ah. Mm. most of the fighting i do isnt very flashy unfortunately. Not very interesting for an audience. One of my friends does martial arts with guns tho “Hmm. would they like to kill someone to take out some rage?”
I: are you related- not related, but working with mr Algranst d'Armin? “What. do i look like a fascist to you” “I give a place where the strong can fight the strong, if someone makes a little bit of money, is that so wrong?” I: i dont really sit from a place to judge “Its a consensual kill, everyone enters of their own volition.” I: yeah fair enough. My fighting style is just kinda standing for a bit and then suddenly come up with a strategy. The standing is super boring “Why not run around the corner until u get a strategy?” I: is that an option??? “Just dodge. Hold smth in front of you. Make it interesting.” I: ever thought of team combats? “The point is so that the ppl who are strong take out ppl who are strong. Teams have a killshot” I: oh yeah we have that “The sniper? Or the gladiator?” I: yeah. I mean, im happy to grab some nonlethal weapons and join once the scarring is over. It seems… i got a lot of anger to work out. I just… can’t risk dying rn. For understandable reasons. That arrangement works well for me, ill get working on it.
